The $ values are in a dense column with no row dividers. One name is purple with no explanation. The panel is crowded at the top-left, and the margin is 8px against the minimap's 18px.
findings.fix: Move it to a 24px margin. Add 4px of row padding (24px rows). Set the title to a 16px --tx-2 label and the rows in --tx-1, with only 'you' in --acc. Remove the purple unless it is a rarity. Collapse the list to one line by default.

findings.what: The minimap is 300x300px, with half of it an empty black void and tiny 8px icons. Its edge is 18px from the screen edge, and the contracts row below it is a different width and style, with a chevron that looks like a button. The icons at the top edge are clipped by the frame.
findings.fix: Crop the minimap to a 240px square with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border, at 24px from the right and top. Make the icons at least 12px. Make the contracts row the same width, 16px, --tx-2. Keep the 24px right margin shared with the ammo card.

findings.what: The timer '9:00' is 28px with a small icon in a dark circle. The extract chip is a separate pill (4px+ radius, teal text) with a floating arrow underneath. The two read as unrelated pieces, and the pill radius breaks the 4px rule.
findings.fix: Put both in one centred --ui-panel card with a 4px radius. Keep the timer at --tx-1 and put the extract row in --extract with a 1px --extract top divider. Put the arrow inside the card on the same row.

findings.where: contract item notice, above the bottom-left
findings.what: The orange bar notice reads 'contract Item nearby' with a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. It also has a second explaining clause ('gold glow marks the box'), which is an explaining sentence on screen. It floats at x=388, not aligned with the controls panel edge at x=16 above it.
findings.fix: Change it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the clause 'gold glow marks the box'. Align its left edge with the 24px margin and set it at 16px in --tx-1 with a 4px radius.

findings.what: The card is clear in hierarchy (the large 4 / 50 is the hero), but the right margin is 10px against the minimap's 18px. The 'view backpack' and '4 items $3,510' footers are 14px muted text, below the 16px minimum for anything read. 'longshot 4x scope' is light-weight 24px, which is inconsistent with the 20px row-name token.
findings.fix: Set the card's right and bottom margin to 24px, matching the minimap. Raise the footers to 16px --tx-2. Set the weapon name to 20px f-cond 600. Keep the 56px hero for the ammo.

findings.what: The slot numbers are 12px and the 'rb' chip and the '50' count are tiny. The idle slots are near-black with almost invisible gun silhouettes, so the 8 empty slots are heavy dark mass. The selected slot's amber border is correct but its fill is too similar to the --warn amber, not the lime accent.
findings.fix: Raise the slot numbers and counts to 16px. Raise the idle gun icons to about 40% opacity. Make the selected slot's border and number lime (--acc), since lime means 'selected'.

v.verdict: The hotbar now has a single clear selection and the bot roster is trimmed, but the HUD still has five unrelated panel styles, three corners of clutter, and no single hero element.

findings.where: top-left roster, bottom-left controls list and top-right minimap card
findings.what: The roster is 7 rows of 16px text with the value column and the lone purple name (fbi_surveillance_van) unexplained. The controls panel has a different border, different padding and 12-13px type that is too small for a couch. The two stacks sit 220px apart with no shared left edge or width. Together they cover most of the left third of the screen.
findings.fix: Put both panels on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, and align both to x=54. Make the controls text 16px at minimum, or fold the list to one line as the spec says. Remove the purple name, or give it a 4px rarity bar. Collapse the roster to the top 3 plus 'you'.

findings.what: The clock (9:00) is the largest text here, but the extract distance is the thing that matters. The pill is small, 16px, teal on a dark fill that blends into the map. The clock icon is a filled orange circle that competes with the pill. The down arrow floats under the pill with no anchor.
findings.fix: Make 'extract 136m' the hero: 40px --f-cond 800 in --extract. Shrink the clock to a 16px --tx-2 tag beside it. Drop the orange circle, or make it a 16px glyph. Attach the arrow to the pill, or remove it.

findings.what: The two bars use different label treatments: 'stamina' is 20px inside the bar, and 'hp 100' is a 30px bold label inside the green bar. The hp number is more prominent than the stamina label. The bars are flush to the screen edge at x≈24, outside the 5% margin. There is no gap between them, and the stamina bar's blue is nearly the same hue as the map terrain.
findings.fix: Inset both bars to x=54, with the bottom at y=1026. Make both 20px tall with an 8px gap. Set both labels at 16px --f-cond 600 in --tx-1, with the value right-aligned. Make hp the only bold one, and make stamina --tx-2.

findings.what: The selected slot 7 reads clearly with a lime/amber 2px border. The idle slots are low contrast, with weapon art at about 30% opacity that is hard to identify. Slot 1 has a white fist plus a stray 'rb' chip, while the others show nothing. The slot numbers are 12px. The bar sits at the bottom edge with 8px of bottom padding. The selected border looks amber rather than --acc lime, which breaks the 'lime = selected' rule.
findings.fix: Use #e6ff3d for the selected border and a --ui-raised fill. Lift idle icons to 55% opacity. Make slot numbers 14px minimum. Show the 'rb' chip on slots 1 and 9 only, or on none. Raise the hotbar to the 54px bottom margin.

findings.what: The card has three sizes of text (longshot 24px, 4/50 at 56px, and the small footer line), with a mix of right and left alignment. 'view backpack' sits left and '4 items $3,510' sits right at under 16px. The card is flush to the right and bottom edges (x≈1910, y≈1052), well outside the 5% margin. The '4' is bold white and the '/ 50' is grey and lighter, so the ammo hero is split in two.
findings.fix: Inset the card to 54px from the right and bottom. Align all three rows to the right edge. Set both footer items at 16px --tx-2. Set the ammo number at 56px 800 in --tx-1, and the '/ 50' at 32px --tx-2.

findings.what: The minimap is a heavy black rectangle with half of it empty. The map icons are tiny, and the white bars at right look like rendering artifacts. The 'contracts 0/8' bar has a different border and fill, and a chevron on each of the three panels points a different way. The panel's right edge is 18px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Inset to 54px. Fill the map panel with --ui-void, draw the unexplored area at 40% darker, and clip the white bars. Match the contracts bar to the standard panel (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius). Use one chevron style at 16px, always pointing the same way.

findings.what: The HUD panels are semi-opaque black, which reads fine over green but turns muddy over the orange scene. The left cluster has no common panel fill, so it looks like three separate overlays rather than one set.
findings.fix: Set every HUD panel to --ui-panel at 88% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Remove any text shadow. Use one fill token, applied everywhere.

findings.what: The 'p1' chip is a filled amber box with black text that matches nothing else on screen. It is larger than the bars' labels, and it sits 12px under the feet over a ring.
findings.fix: Reduce it to 16px in a 4px-radius amber (P1 colour) chip, with 4px/8px padding. Keep amber for P1 only and don't use it for selection.

v.verdict: The hotbar highlight, the clipped hp and stamina bars, and the left-side clutter are all as before; only the contract toast is gone. The screen has four competing text blocks and no clear first read.

findings.what: Slot 7 is a gold-filled tile that reads as rarity or amber, not lime. Slots 2-6, 8 and 0 are all the same dim grey with no hierarchy. Slot 1 has a stray 'rb' chip. The 10px slot numerals are unreadable.
findings.fix: Give slot 7 a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill, with no gold fill. Idle slots get a 1px --ui-line-hi border with the icon at 50%. Make the slot numerals 14px tx-2. Remove the 'rb' chip, or show it as a 16px hint beside the bar.

findings.what: A 9-row dense list at about 14px. The purple name is an off-palette colour. The box has a rounded border and a caret. The money column is bold and shouts louder than the names. It competes with the controls card below it.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line, 'bots 7', and open it on a key. If it stays, use 16px tx-1 names, $ values in tx-2, one row per 24px, and no purple. Put the left edge on the 96px margin.

findings.what: Stamina is a muddy blue-grey bar with 20px text. The hp bar is a full-width solid green slab with 'hp 100' as oversized text in a slightly different font. The bars have unequal weights, they sit about 24px from the screen edge, and they are cramped near the bottom edge. The hp text on green has weak contrast.
findings.fix: Make both bars 12px tall and the same width, with the left edge at 96px. Put a 16px tx-2 label above each. Show the hp number as the one hero at 32px tx-1, right-aligned. Use --ok for the hp fill and tx-2 at 40% for the stamina fill.

findings.what: The 'move / fight / gear' card shows about 18 rows of key caps, so it is permanent clutter. It is not folded to the one short line the style guide calls for (mid-bottom left, F1 to open). It also stacks directly under the bots list, which makes a left wall of boxes.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px tx-2 line, 'f1 controls', at mid-bottom left. Open it on F1 only. Remove the 'fight' and 'gear' columns from the default view.

findings.what: 'longshot 4x scope' is in the wrong place. The 4/50 hero is good, but the '4 items $3,510' and 'view backpack' lines are cramped under it and use a different font treatment from the rest of the HUD. The $3,510 also repeats the figure in the bots list.
findings.fix: Show 'longshot' alone at 20px, put '4x' in a 16px tag, and set 'view backpack' and the item count at 16px tx-2. Remove the duplicate $3,510. Make the card padding 16px and its bottom edge 48px from the screen edge.

findings.where: 'p2' tag under the player and the 'keyboard' badge, top-left
findings.what: The 'p2' chip is a cyan outlined box that floats at 22px below the character. The 'keyboard' badge is a green-outlined box jammed into the top-left corner at 2px from the edge, in a different colour from everything else.
findings.fix: Make the p2 tag 14px, cyan text on a --ui-panel fill with no outline. Move the 'keyboard' badge to a 16px tx-2 label at the 48px margin, with no outline.

findings.what: The minimap is a large, mostly empty black rectangle with a half-lit map. The contracts bar is a separate box with a chevron, directly under it. The corner is not the 1 by 1 vertical list that was ordered.
findings.fix: Shrink the minimap to about 240px and give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Put 'contracts 0/8' at 16px tx-1 as a row in the same stack, with a 24px gap. Leave the full list to the cw-trcol job.

findings.what: '9:00' is bold and in a different font from the rest, and it has a sun glyph beside it. The teal extract pill is a rounded box with a tiny arrow below it. It is correctly teal, but the two stack in different styles.
findings.fix: Set the clock at 32px f-cond 700 tx-1. Make the extract pill 16px with a 4px radius and no outline fill, teal text only. Keep a 8px gap between them.

v.verdict: The weapon bar now has one clear amber-gold selected slot and the empty-slot tooltip is gone. The screen is still crowded on the left, with a full controls card, the bots list, a feed line and the stamina and hp bars. The panels still don't share a style, and there is a stray capital letter.

findings.where: left column: controls card (x 15-370, y 537-800), bots list (x 8-368, y 143-315)
findings.what: Two big text-dense cards sit on the left of the map. The controls card is fully open even though the owner ordered it folded to one line, with F1 to open it. The bots list still lists every row. Together they take about a third of the left side. The controls card also has two column headers, 'move' and 'fight', in 14px text that is hard to read.
findings.fix: Fold the controls to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at mid-bottom left, as the owner ordered. Collapse the bots list to one header line ('7 pillager bots') by default. Both cards should use the same panel: fill #16191b at 0.92 alpha, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding.

findings.where: feed line at the bottom left (x 387-760, y 778-802)
findings.what: 'contract Item nearby' has a capital I, which breaks the all-lower-case rule. The line is also a long sentence ('gold glow marks the box') that explains too much. It is amber on grey, so it clashes with the lime accent, and its yellow left bar and icon make it look like a third panel style.
findings.fix: Change it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the 'gold glow marks the box' clause. Use the standard panel (16px text, tx-1) with a 3px --warn bar on the left. Align its left edge to the controls card at x=16, with a 16px gap.

findings.what: The selected slot is better, but its border is amber-gold, not lime. The icon is a 3-colour sprite on a brown fill. The idle slots are dark and nearly unreadable, and the slot numbers are about 12px. The empty-slot 'rb' chip is the only key hint, so the bar looks inconsistent.
findings.fix: Give the selected slot a 2px #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised fill. Raise the slot numbers to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Brighten the idle icons to about 60% opacity. Put one 16px key-hint chip on every slot or on none.

findings.where: top-right minimap and contracts card (x 1602-1902, y 18-365)
findings.what: The minimap is a large dark block of mostly empty black, with a nearly invisible border. The 'contracts 0/8' header sits on a different fill with a chevron, and the two do not match the bots list card on the left. The caret icons at the top right are about 14px and low contrast.
findings.fix: Shrink the minimap to about 240x240 and put it on the same panel (1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius). Make the 'contracts 0/8' header row 32px tall with 16px text and the same fill. Make the chevrons 16px in --tx-2.

findings.what: The hero '4 / 50' is good and reads fast, but it is crammed into a card with tiny 14px footer text ('view backpack', '4 items $3,510'). 'longshot' is right-aligned while the footer is split left and right. The card also sits flush against the screen edge.
findings.fix: Inset the card 32px from the screen edge. Set the footer text to 16px, aligned left, in --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero and set the weapon name to 20px.

findings.what: The stamina bar is blue and the hp bar is a bright green fill with a large 'hp 100'. The two use different heights and label sizes. Neither matches the weapon bar's panel style, and the green does not match the --ok token.
findings.fix: Make both bars 16px tall with 16px labels. Use --ok (#76b97c) for hp and a muted blue only for stamina. Put them on one 8px-gap stack with a 1px border.

findings.what: The p2 tag is a small teal-on-dark box that is close to the extract teal, so the player-2 cyan can be mistaken for the extraction marker. The extract pill reads well, but the 9:00 clock above it is the only large number at the top.
findings.fix: Make the p2 tag 16px on a --ui-panel fill with a 2px cyan border that matches the ring. Keep teal #47d8c6 only for extraction, and give the extract pill a 3px left bar so the two read differently.

findings.what: The list still mixes colours: 'fbi_surveillance_van' is purple while the other rows are white. The money column is the same weight as the names, so the eye gets no anchor.
findings.fix: Make every name --tx-2 at 16px, with the 'you' row in --tx-1 plus a 2px lime bar. Right-align the money in f-cond 600 tx-1. Use purple only for rarity.

v.verdict: The raid HUD is now cleaner: the controls list is gone, the bots list and contracts row are collapsible panels, and the ammo card has a clear hero number. The hp and stamina bars still look unfinished and the corner margins don't match.

findings.what: The bars are bare fills with no card or border. Their edges sit 22px from the screen edge, while the right ammo card sits 10px from it. 'hp 100' is oversized and crammed into the bar, the stamina label is low contrast on a blue-grey fill, and the two bars differ in height and style.
findings.fix: Put both bars in one --ui-panel card (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border) at a 24px margin. Make the bars 16px tall with a 16px f-cond label on the left and the value on the right in --tx-1. Use --ok for hp and a muted --extract for stamina, and align the card's bottom edge with the hotbar.

findings.what: Each corner uses a different inset. The bots card is 8px from the left and 143px from the top. The minimap is 18px from the top and 18px from the right. The ammo card is 10px from the right and 20px from the bottom. The hotbar sits 120px from the bottom-left bars. The HUD reads as unplaced pieces rather than one system.
findings.fix: Use a 24px safe margin (5% of screen is preferred) for every corner card. Anchor the bots card at top:24px, left:24px. Anchor the minimap at top:24px, right:24px. Anchor the ammo card at bottom:24px, right:24px. Anchor the hp and stamina card at bottom:24px, left:24px.

findings.what: The minimap is a 300px block with a large empty black lower half. Its icons are tiny (about 8px) and the 1px border is almost invisible. It is the biggest element in the corner but carries little information.
findings.fix: Crop it to a 240px square with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Make the icons at least 12px. Widen the contracts row to match, at 16px --tx-2, on the same 24px margin.

findings.what: The rows are 18px apart and the text is about 14px, which is under the 16px floor. The purple name has no clear meaning, and the whole list is an always-open leaderboard that competes with gameplay. The border is thin and the card is not aligned with the other cards.
findings.fix: Make the rows 24px with 16px text. Show 'you' in --acc and the other names in --tx-1 (purple only if it is a rarity). Fold the list to one line ('current pillager bots 7') by default and open it on demand, at the 24px margin.

findings.what: The timer, sun icon, extract chip and teal arrow are four separate floating pieces with no shared container. The timer is light on a busy backdrop, and the arrow hangs below the chip.
findings.fix: Put the timer and extract row in one centred --ui-panel card (4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border), with the arrow on the extract row inside the card. Keep the timer in --tx-1 and the extract text in --extract.

findings.what: Hierarchy is good (56px hero '4 / 50'), but the weapon name, 'view backpack' and the '4 items $3,510' line are about 14px and low contrast. The card touches the screen edge more tightly than any other panel.
findings.fix: Set the secondary lines to 16px --tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Inset the card to 24px and match its panel fill and border to the hp card. Right-align the '$3,510' value with the 56px number.

findings.what: The 8 empty slots are all drawn with the same dim silhouette. The slot numbers are about 11px and the selected amber slot reads as a lime-like highlight. Per the style guide, amber is warning and P1, and lime means selected.
findings.fix: Set the slot numbers to 16px --tx-2. Dim the empty slots to 40% opacity. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill, not amber.

findings.what: The tag is a black box with an amber outline and amber text. Its edges are square and it floats a little way off the sprite, so it looks like a debug marker.
findings.fix: Use a 4px radius, a --ui-panel fill, a 16px f-cond label in the P1 amber, and sit it 8px below the feet with no border.

v.verdict: The HUD is a little tidier and reads fine, but the earlier fixes mostly weren't applied. The edge margins are still ragged, the timer and extract pill are still tiny, and the cards still use different panel styles.

findings.what: Nothing here is the hero. The 9:00 clock is the largest element, 'extract 136m' sits in a small teal chip, and the orange sun icon and the arrow below it float loose. The extract timer is the number the player needs under pressure.
findings.fix: Make 'extract 136m' 40px f-cond 800 in --extract, with no chip fill. Shrink the clock to a 16px --tx-2 tag beside it. Remove the sun icon, or shrink it to a 16px glyph attached to the clock. Attach the arrow to the text or drop it.

findings.where: left roster, bottom-left bars, bottom-right weapon card and minimap
findings.what: The HUD has no shared margin. The roster starts at x=10, the bars at x=24, the minimap sits about 18px from the right edge, and the weapon card runs almost flush to the right and bottom edges. The panels also differ: the roster has a lighter border, the weapon card is near-black with no clear border, and the minimap card is another variant.
findings.fix: Use one 54px margin for every HUD block. Fill every panel with --ui-panel, give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Set the roster at x=54, the bars at x=54 with the bottom at y=1026, and the weapon card at right and bottom 54px.

findings.what: Eight rows of 14-15px text set at equal weight form a dense block that competes with the minimap. The purple 'fbi_surveillance_van' name breaks the palette, since purple means elite rarity. There is no marker that separates 'you' from the others. The heading text is a sentence that explains itself.
findings.fix: Cut to the top 3 plus 'you'. Use 16px f-cond 600 and 20px row height. Mark 'you' with a 3px --acc bar and tx-1 text, and set the other rows in --tx-2. Turn the purple name into --tx-1. Shorten the heading to 'bots 7'.

findings.what: The bars are visually loud and mismatched. The hp bar is a saturated green fill with a big 'hp 100' at about 30px, and the stamina bar is a blue fill at a different height. Both labels are cramped against the left edge. The bright green and blue clash with the lime accent and the extract teal.
findings.fix: Make both bars 20px tall with an 8px gap, inset to x=54. Put 16px f-cond 600 labels above each bar, with the value right-aligned. Keep hp in --ok, and make stamina --tx-2 at a dim fill. Remove the oversized hp text.

findings.what: The selected slot's amber border and fill read as gold, which is the rarity colour, not the lime accent. Idle icons are dark and low-contrast. Slot numbers are about 12px and the 'rb' chip appears only on slot 1, which is inconsistent. The hotbar also sits about 20px from the bottom, below the bars' baseline.
findings.fix: Give the selected slot a 2px #e6ff3d border and a --ui-raised fill. Raise idle icons to 55% opacity. Set slot numbers to 14px minimum. Show 'rb' on slots 1 and 9 only, or on none. Align the hotbar bottom to y=1026.

findings.what: The ammo is a decent hero, but the '4' is in a light weight that clashes with the '/ 50'. 'view backpack' and '4 items $3,510' are around 14px and low contrast. The footer mixes an action with a stat. The card is crowded against the bottom-right corner.
findings.fix: Set the ammo number at 56px 800 in --tx-1 and '/ 50' at 32px --tx-2. Set both footer items at 16px --tx-2, right-aligned. Move the card to 54px from the right and bottom.

findings.what: The minimap has no frame, and its edge cuts against the map. The chevrons at the top and in the contracts bar are tiny. The contracts bar is a different style from the roster, with a different border and radius.
findings.fix: Frame the minimap with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, on --ui-panel. Set 'contracts 0/8' at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Use matching 16px chevrons on both.

findings.what: The 'p1' tag is a capital-free but heavy amber box under the player. It competes with the character and has a different style from the other HUD chips. The faint crosshair ring is thin and low-contrast against the grey ground.
findings.fix: Make the tag a 16px --tx-1 label with a 3px amber (P1 colour) underline bar, and drop the filled box. Thicken the crosshair stroke to 2px and add a 1px dark outline.

v.verdict: The HUD is now clean and the controls card is gone, but the bot list, the clipped bars, the hotbar and the ammo card still ignore the style guide and fight for attention.

findings.what: The list is a big always-open card with a purple name, tight 18px rows, 14px text and a left edge at 8px. It is the heaviest block on the screen and competes with the timer and the player. This is the same problem as last time and it was not fixed.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px tx-2 line, 'bots 7', and open it on a key. If it stays open, use 16px tx-1 names, tx-2 $ values and 24px rows, and make the purple name tx-1. Set the left edge to 96px and the top to 48px.

findings.what: Slot 7 has a gold-filled border and a heavy glow, which breaks the rule that gold is only a 3px bar and lime means selected. Slots 1 to 6, 8 and 0 are dim silhouettes at about 40%. The slot numerals are about 12px. The 'rb' chip is cryptic and clipped in slot 1.
findings.fix: Give slot 7 a 2px --acc border on a --ui-raised fill and remove the gold fill. Give idle slots a 1px --ui-line-hi border with the icon at 50%. Set the numerals to 14px tx-2. Remove the 'rb' chip, or move it to a 16px hint beside the bar.

findings.what: The bars are 8px from the screen edge, with different heights and no shared margin. The stamina track is grey on grey and nearly unreadable. 'hp 100' sits inside the fill in a heavy 32px stroked type, and the bright green fill is loud and conflicts with the 'ok' green.
findings.fix: Make both bars 12px tall and 360px wide, with the left edge at 96px and the bottom at 48px. Put 16px tx-2 labels above them. Show the hp number as the one 32px tx-1 hero, right-aligned. Use --ok for the hp fill and tx-2 at 40% for the stamina fill, on a --ui-line track.

findings.what: The card is flush to the edge, about 10px from the right and bottom. It crams 'longshot 4x scope', the 4/50 hero, 'view backpack' and '4 items $3,510' into one box. The $3,510 repeats the bot list's 'you' line, and the 14px text is too small.
findings.fix: Set the right and bottom margins to 48px with 16px padding. Show 'longshot' alone at 20px and put '4x' in a 16px tag. Show 4 / 50 at the 56px hero. Set 'view backpack' and the item count at 16px tx-2. Remove the duplicate $3,510.

findings.what: The yellow-amber text on a dark pill with an orange bar sits at 8px from the left edge, between the list and the bars, and the message explains itself ('gold glow marks the box'). That is an explaining sentence. It also uses amber, which reads close to the lime accent and the gold slot.
findings.fix: Move it to the top-centre banner position, as the one-place rule says. Shorten it to 'contract item nearby' at 20px in --warn. Delete the gold glow clause.

findings.what: The minimap is a huge 300x300 black rectangle. Half of it is empty black and the bottom part of the crop looks broken. The chevron on 'contracts 0/8' is at 16px but its text is a different weight from the other panels. Panel borders are inconsistent, with different radii and line weights across the HUD.
findings.fix: Make the minimap 240px square, 48px from the top and right, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Use the same border and radius on every HUD card. Set 'contracts 0/8' at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 with 8px padding.

findings.what: The '9:00' timer is bold and fine as the hero, but the teal 'extract 139m' chip is 16px with a tiny arrow and sits tight under it. The sun icon is a glossy orange badge that does not match the flat style.
findings.fix: Put 16px of space between the timer and the chip. Make the chip 16px --extract with a 4px radius. Replace the sun with a flat 16px tx-2 glyph.

findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip is green with a bright border at 8px from the corner, in lower-case 16px type. It adds noise and uses a green close to --ok.
findings.fix: Show it as a 14px tx-2 label with no fill, at 96px, 48px. Hide it after 3 seconds.

v.verdict: The controls card is gone and the feed line is now short and shown once, but the bots list, bar, ammo card and minimap each still use a different panel, and the edge insets are tiny.

findings.what: A 7-row, 14px list of names and balances is always open. It is the loudest block on the left and it is clutter. The price column is dense, with no row dividers and no highlight on 'you'. The header says 'current pillager bots 7'.
findings.fix: Fold it by default to one 16px header row, 'pillager bots 7' (drop 'current'), with a chevron. When open, use 16px rows on a 24px pitch, a 1px #2e3337 divider between rows, 'you' in --acc, and balances in --tx-2. Put it at x=16, y=16.

findings.what: The selected slot has a gold-amber border and fill, not the lime #e6ff3d accent. It reads as rarity gold and clashes with the lime rule. Idle icons are very dim, with about 25% contrast. The slot numbers are about 11px. The 'rb' chip appears on slot 1 only, and the '50' only on slot 7.
findings.fix: Selected slot: 2px #e6ff3d border over a --ui-raised fill. Idle icons at 60% opacity. Slot numbers 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Show the 'rb' hint on none of the slots, or on every slot that has one, as a 16px chip.

findings.where: panel system: bots list, minimap, contracts bar, ammo card, weapon bar, feed line
findings.what: Each block has a different border colour, radius, fill alpha and text size (14px to 16px). The ammo card and bar are near-opaque black, the feed line is a flat chip with an orange bar, and the minimap has no border. They read as unrelated widgets.
findings.fix: Use one panel for all of them: fill #16191b at 0.92 alpha, 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius, 16px padding. Body text 16px minimum and 20px for names. Use a 3px left bar only where the colour carries meaning (--warn on the feed line).

findings.what: The card sits 10px from the right edge and 28px from the bottom, which is too tight for a TV. The 'view backpack' and '4 items $3,510' footers are about 14px and low-contrast. The weapon name is right-aligned with no relation to the footer. The 56px hero '4 / 50' is good.
findings.fix: Inset the card 32px from the screen edge. Set the footers to 16px in --tx-2 with 16px padding. Make the weapon name 20px --tx-1 and left-align it with the footers. Keep the 56px hero, with the '4' in --tx-1 and the '/ 50' in --tx-2.

findings.where: top-right minimap and contracts bar (x 1602-1902, y 18-365)
findings.what: The minimap is 300x300 and sits 18px from the edge, with no frame and a faint, cluttered interior. Its collapse chevron overlaps the map edge at the top right. The contracts bar sits below it with a different fill and a 14px chevron.
findings.fix: Shrink the minimap to about 240x240 and inset it 32px. Give it a 1px #4a5257 border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Move the chevron out of the map into a 32px header row 'contracts 0/8' with 16px text and a 16px --tx-2 chevron. Both blocks get the same fill.

findings.what: It still has the explaining clause 'gold glow marks the box'. It is small (about 16px with a 13px icon) and has a thin amber bar. It sits at x=15, which is not aligned with the stamina and hp bars, and it floats mid-left, not at the bottom.
findings.fix: Change the text to 'contract item nearby' only. Use the standard panel, 16px --tx-1, a 3px --warn bar, left edge at x=32 aligned with the hp bar, 16px above the stamina bar.

findings.what: 'hp 100' is about 30px bold on a green fill, which makes it a second hero next to the ammo number. The stamina bar's label is crowded in its 18px height. The bars sit 24px from the left edge and 12px from the bottom.
findings.fix: Make the hp label 20px f-cond 700 in --acc-ink on a --ok fill, and the stamina label 16px. Give both bars the same 24px height with an 8px gap. Inset them 32px from the left and 32px from the bottom. Keep the 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag (x 10-105, y 8-30) and p2 tag (x 895-935, y 870-898)
findings.what: The 'keyboard' tag is a small 16px chip with a different border and fill to the other panels, jammed into the corner at 8px. The p2 tag is cyan, which is correct, but its box style is a third variant.
findings.fix: Give both tags the standard panel, 16px f-cond 600, with the keyboard tag at x=32, y=32. Keep the cyan only on the p2 border or text.

v.verdict: The downed card is clear: the big timer is the focal point and the lime [f] prompt is readable. But the HUD around it is cluttered and inconsistent: stray status chips, mixed type scales, a tiny bar label, a purple zone name, and a down-state bar that is hard to read.

findings.where: downed card, top bar and timer bar
findings.what: The skill-check bar at the top (white tick plus red zone) has no label, and its relation to the 14.64s countdown and the thin grey progress bar below it is unclear. Two bars stacked above and below the timer compete, and a small red tick sits stuck to the card's top-left corner like a leftover. The 'down' title is red and the 14.64s hero is white, so what the player should act on is not obvious.
findings.fix: Keep one bar. Either drop the grey bar or merge it with the skill-check row. Label the skill-check bar with a 16px tx-2 word, remove the stray 4px red tick at the card corner, and align the card's inner padding to 24px on all sides.

findings.where: bottom-left status row (down, eye, leaf icon, concealed, in cover)
findings.what: Five chips of different shapes and colours (red outline, amber outline, teal circle, amber text, green text) sit in a row. 'down' repeats the card already centred on screen, and 'concealed' and 'in cover' are amber and green text on tinted fills at near-identical size with no clear priority. This is clutter, and the icons without labels look like a template.
findings.fix: Remove the 'down' chip, since the card already says it. Use one chip style (4px radius, 16px f-cond 600, 1px --ui-line-hi border). Reserve colour for the one chip that matters (danger or warn) and set the others in tx-2.

findings.what: 'hp 0' sits at about 36px in a dark bar that shows no fill and has no frame that reads as a bar. It almost disappears into the dark floor, and its left edge at x≈25 does not line up with the chips above. The chips (x≈25), the bar (x≈25) and the left panel (x≈8) all use different left margins.
findings.fix: Set one 5% left margin, about 48px, for the chips and the hp bar. Give the bar a 1px --ui-line-hi border on --ui-panel and show an empty-state tick or danger-red outline so it reads as 'empty'. Keep the number at 32px.

findings.what: This is a scoreboard-like panel, but it has a different type scale from the other HUD panels, with dense 14-16px rows and a title that is the same weight as the rows. 'you' and '$1,620' at row weight do not stand out. The repeated 'dead' with dashes is noisy. It sits against the room wall at x=8, outside the margin, and the chevron is tiny.
findings.fix: Drop the repeated '- dead' column and show names in tx-2 with one 'dead' tag at 16px. Make the title tx-2 at 16px and 'you' tx-1 at 20px. Move the panel to the 48px margin, and use the same 4px radius and border as the other cards.

findings.what: Slots 4-9 are dimmed so far that their icons almost vanish, and the empty slots carry no numbers beyond a tiny 16px digit. Slot 1 has a thick amber border while slot 3 has a blue tint fill, which makes two selected-looking states. Per the guide, lime is the only 'selected' colour, and amber means P1.
findings.fix: Give slot 1 a lime 2px border as the selected one. Give slot 3 a neutral 1px --ui-line-hi border. Raise the empty slots' contrast so the icons stay at about 40% opacity and the digits at 16px tx-2.

findings.what: The 12 / 24 hero is good, but the panel has a hard-edged box with a brown gradient fill unlike the other panels. 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' are at about 14px and low contrast, and they leave a thin footer row crowded against the border. 'scav pistol' at 20px is right-aligned while the footer is split left and right.
findings.fix: Fill the panel with --ui-panel, 4px radius, 24px padding. Raise the footer text to 16px tx-2 and put it on one line baseline-aligned with the panel's bottom padding. Keep the hero at 56px.

findings.where: top-centre and top-right ('9:00', 'extract 152m', 'contracts 0/8', 'c 152m', 'the long dock cache')
findings.what: Extract distance shows twice (top pill and 'c 152m' at the right), which breaks the one-place rule. The 'the long dock cache' zone label is a lilac that matches no token (closest is r-elite purple) and floats over the map with no backing. 'contracts 0/8' is a solid dark bar with a chevron, while the top-centre pills use teal outlines, so the top corners disagree.
findings.fix: Drop the duplicate 'c 152m' pill or the top one. Set the zone label in tx-2 at 20px with a text shadow, not a rarity purple. Give the contracts bar and the extract pill the same 4px radius, 16px type and border.

findings.what: '[f] self-revive, one per raid' is a good lime key cue, but the sentence explains a rule on screen and the card has uneven spacing: about 8px above the bar, 24px between the title and timer, and 16px below the progress bar.
findings.fix: Shorten it to '[f] self-revive' with 'one per raid' dropped or moved to 14px tx-2 beside it. Set 16px spacing between all rows and equal 24px outer padding.

v.verdict: the down card gets the eye first, which is right, but it is a small flat box with a clipped red tab and a stray timing bar. The HUD around it uses mixed panel styles, tiny text and several competing accents, so it reads as unfinished.

findings.what: A red sliver sits at the card's top-left corner and looks like a clipped progress or damage tag. The skill-check bar above the 'down' label has no label, so its meaning is unclear. The card also has no title band, the 'down' label is small next to the 56px hero timer, and the card has no inner padding grid.
findings.fix: Delete the red sliver or turn it into a full-width 3px --danger top bar. Put the skill-check bar directly under the timer. Use 32px 'down' in --danger, a 56px/800 timer, 24px padding, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius.

findings.where: bottom-left status chips (y945-980: down, concealed, in cover, two icon discs)
findings.what: Five chips with mixed styles sit in a row. They differ in border colour (red, amber, green), shape (pill, round disc) and fill. 'down' repeats the card above, so the state is shown twice. Amber and green are used as decoration, and the discs have no text.
findings.fix: Remove the 'down' chip because the card already says it. Use one chip style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px label, 4px radius, 8px gap. Colour only the glyph. Merge 'concealed' and 'in cover' into one stealth state.

findings.what: 'hp 0' sits on an empty dark bar with no visible fill, so it looks broken and not like a deliberate empty state. The bar is also much wider than the chips above it and its left edge does not line up with the 5% margin or with the chips. The text is amber on dark brown.
findings.fix: Show the empty state with a --danger outline and a 3px --danger segment. Set the label to 20px --tx-1. Make the bar the same width as the status row, aligned to the same 5% margin.

findings.what: The panel is dense and its type is small, roughly 14-16px. It stacks a header, a $ total, three 'dead' rows with dashes, and a footer ('0 out · 3 dead') that repeats the rows. The header 'current pillager bots 0' is a long label with a count that is hard to parse. The panel hugs the screen edge with a different radius and border from the card. The dim grey names are low contrast. The dead rows add clutter without helping the player.
findings.fix: Collapse it to a one-line 'squad 0/3' that expands on a key. If it stays open, use 16px rows, --tx-2 for dead players, no dashes, and drop the footer sentence. Put it on the 5% margin with the same panel token as the other cards.

findings.where: HUD corners (contracts 0/8 top-right, c 152m chip right, 'extract 152m' top-centre)
findings.what: Extraction distance is shown twice, as 'extract 152m' under the clock and as the teal 'c 152m' chip on the right. The contracts dropdown is a different panel style again, with a chevron and 1px outline, and the 'the long dock cache' label floats in purple with no container. The rule is one place per line, so this breaks it.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate 'c 152m' chip and keep only the top-centre extract line. Style contracts with the same panel token as the roster. Put the map label in --tx-1 or --tx-2 at 16px, not purple.

findings.what: The message 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' is an explaining sentence. It uses an amber left bar and amber text that clash with the hint line below it. It sits low-left, next to the status chips, and crowds the bottom-left corner.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby' and drop the hint sentence. Use --warn only on the small glyph and --tx-1 for the text. Align it to the 5% margin and move it up to the left feed position.

findings.what: The hotbar slots 4-9 are barely visible ghost icons, so the empty slots add noise. Slot 1 has an amber outline and slot 3 a blue one with no clear meaning, so they compete with 'selected' (lime). The ammo panel's right edge sits about 10px from the screen edge, inside the 5% margin. Its 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' lines are tiny, near 14px, and they repeat the roster's $1,620.
findings.fix: Hide empty slots or show them as 1px --ui-line outlines with no icons. Mark only the selected slot with a --acc border. Pull the ammo panel in to the 5% margin. Make its sub-lines 16px, and drop the '$1,620' repeat or keep it in one place only.

findings.what: A heavy red-brown wash covers the whole map for the downed state. It lowers contrast on every HUD element at the edges, and the plain scrim does not set the card apart from the world.
findings.fix: Use a vignette that keeps the centre readable and drops the edges to about 40% opacity. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a soft drop shadow to the card so it separates from the map.

v.verdict: This is the title menu, not the in-raid hud my last review covered, so none of that advice can be judged here. It is a clean, centred column, but the amber gradient logo clashes with the lime accent, a popup error banner outshouts the menu, and the saves block is cramped and weakly ranked.

findings.what: The error is the loudest thing on screen. It carries a solid lime fill, a red border and a two-line explaining sentence, all sitting between the mode list and the saves block. The sentence is also clutter, and the banner breaks up the column. The 'retry' fill is the only filled lime element, so it outranks the mode buttons.
findings.fix: Show it only when triggered, and move it below the saves block or into a toast. Cut the copy to 'popups blocked, allow and retry' at 16px tx-1. Make 'retry' an outlined 1px --acc button at 20px, not a fill. Use a 3px --danger left bar on --ui-panel, with no red-tinted fill.

findings.what: A 90px amber-to-orange gradient wordmark with a heavy drop shadow. It is a generic gradient-and-shadow template look, it is not in the guide's palette (--acc is lime, --warn amber is warning-only), and it fights the lime focus bar. It also has two different colours in the same hue family as the warn glyph.
findings.fix: Use a flat wordmark in --tx-1, f-cond 800, about 96px, with no gradient and no shadow. Or use flat --acc if the owner wants colour. Keep the gap to the tagline at 16px.

findings.what: There is no hierarchy. '1 player' is the main action but looks the same as the other rows, and the focus lands on '2 player arcade demo' with only a 1px lime outline and a 3px left tick. 'two player co-op (same machine)' is a parenthetical that explains. All four buttons are 56px tall with 8px gaps and the same weight.
findings.fix: Make '1 player' the primary: 64px tall, with a 2px --acc border when it is focused. Put the arcade demos in a quieter group about 24px lower, at 48px tall. Drop '(same machine)' or make it a 16px tx-2 sub-label. Put the default focus on '1 player'. Give the focused row a --ui-raised fill with a 4px --acc left bar.

findings.what: The 'saves' label is dim at about 14px. The 'pillager new' row has lime text on a lime outline, and lime is for selected only, not text. The bottom row mixes a text field (260px) and two buttons of different widths, all about 40px tall, with 8px gaps that read as crowded against the 56px mode buttons. The button labels are about 14px and below the 16px floor.
findings.fix: Raise 'saves' to 16px tx-2 with 16px below it. Set the row names to 20px tx-1 and keep lime for the focus border only. Make all three controls 48px tall with 16px text and 8px gaps. Set the field to 50% width and the two buttons to 25% each.

findings.what: The chips are small (about 14px, bold white on near-black) and the legend is wide, with a weak hierarchy between key and action. It is 5 pairs of explaining text on a menu, so it is clutter. 'f1 controls' is the only one that matters here.
findings.fix: Show only 'f1 controls' on the menu at 16px, with the chip at 24px height. Put the full legend in the raid. Keep the bottom at 32px from the edge.

findings.what: The two buttons are about 48px tall with 16px text and a 1px border, but they sit at about 48px from the right and about 33px from the top. That is close to the guide, but their gap, width and baseline do not match the 56px mode buttons. 'go fullscreen' is a low-value action given the same weight as 'settings'.
findings.fix: Give both the same 48px height, with settings first (right) and fullscreen as an icon-only 48px square. Use a 16px gap and a 32px top margin, and keep the right margin at 48px. Use --ui-line-hi for the border.

findings.where: tagline 'ascend. pillage. extract.' and version stamp (bottom-left)
findings.what: The tagline is about 18px tx-2 with wide tracking, and its contrast against the near-black is borderline, about 4:1 as it is drawn. The version stamp is about 12px, below the 14px fine-print floor, and sits at x=97 while the screen margin elsewhere is 48px.
findings.fix: Set the tagline to 20px --tx-2 (at least 4.5:1) with 24px to the first button. Set the version stamp to 14px f-body 500 and align it at left 48px, bottom 32px, on the same baseline as the key legend.

findings.what: A flat, near-empty black vignette with a 1px grey frame around the screen. The menu column is only 560px wide in 1920px, and the 600px to each side are dead. It has no game art, so it could be any template and the identity score is low.
findings.fix: Put a dim, blurred raid screenshot or a scene of the map behind it at 25% opacity, under a --scrim at .80. Remove the 1px screen border. Add a right-hand panel of 400px for news or the party if you want the width filled.

v.verdict: The picture is now a calm title screen, not the raid HUD my earlier advice was about, so that advice can't be judged; as a title it has one clear lime action and a strong wordmark, but it is sparse and the small text is too quiet.

findings.what: The wordmark is an amber-to-orange gradient with a drop shadow. That is a gradient wash, it is close to the player 1 amber, and it competes with the lime button. It is also the only identity element on the screen, and it is plain type with no emblem or art behind it.
findings.fix: Use a flat tx-1 or flat amber fill with no gradient and no shadow, at the 56px hero size or larger. Add one real piece of key art or a silhouette behind it, with a 3px lime rule under the title, so the screen reads as this game and not a template.

findings.what: It is a bare 16px tx-2 label directly under the lime button. It is neither a button nor clearly a caption, so its meaning is unclear and it looks like a stray string. Its 12px gap to the button also breaks the 8px grid.
findings.fix: Make it a real secondary button with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 20px f-cond 600 text, 48px tall, 16px under the primary button. Or move it to the top-right row beside settings. Do not leave it as loose text.

findings.what: The saves list is cramped and the controls are mixed. The 'saves' label is small and dim. The save row is 42px tall with a lime outline and 16px lime text, so it competes with the main button. The name field and the two buttons below have the same border and fill, so you can't tell the input from the actions. 'change name' and 'create a new save' sit together at equal weight. The right-hand meta is dim grey.
findings.fix: Put the block in one --ui-panel card, 24px padding, 4px radius. Make rows 56px tall with 20px names and 16px tx-2 meta. Mark the selected row with a 3px lime left bar and a --ui-raised fill, not a full lime outline. Give the input a --ui-void fill and a 1px --ui-line border. Make 'create a new save' the quiet secondary action and 'change name' a text button. Leave 24px between the label, the list and the controls.

findings.what: The tag is a teal pill jammed against the top edge, 6px from it. Its teal is reserved for extraction. It is centred at the top, unlike the corner-anchored settings buttons, and it reads as a debug label.
findings.fix: Move it to the 48px margin as a 14px tx-2 device tag with a 1px --ui-line border, or place it beside the player 2 controls. Use tx-2 instead of teal. Align its baseline with the settings buttons at y 57.

findings.what: The two buttons are equal, 48px tall, with thin borders and 16px text, and they sit 97px from the right edge against a 48px margin elsewhere. They are also less prominent than the version stamp's neighbours, so the pad focus state is unproven.
findings.fix: Move them to the right margin at x 1872 and a top of 48px. Raise the text to 20px. Show focus as a 2px lime border with a --ui-raised fill. Make the 'settings' icon-plus-label the one that stays, and move fullscreen into settings.

findings.what: The legend is 16px, with dim labels beside small white key chips whose text is about 12px. It is crowded in one line and it explains controls on screen, which is clutter on a menu. The key chips use a different style from the buttons above.
findings.fix: Remove it from the title screen, since F1 already opens the controls. If it stays, make it 14px tx-2 at the 48px bottom margin, with chips in the same 4px radius and --ui-line-hi border as the buttons, and put 24px between each pair.

findings.what: The stamp is about 13px and dim, which is under the 14px floor. It is also at x 97, which matches neither the 48px margin nor the settings buttons on the right, and its baseline is 15px off the legend's baseline at y 1042.
findings.fix: Set it at x 48 with a 14px f-body 500 tx-2 fill and a 48px bottom margin, on the same baseline as the legend.

findings.what: The tagline is dim, 18px, letter-spaced grey sitting 36px under the wordmark. It is weak against the gradient title, and the sparse empty void above and below makes the centred stack look small.
findings.fix: Set it at 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 with 16px between the title and the tagline. Scale the whole stack up about 1.15x and move it up so the centre lands at roughly y 470. Add a faint vignette or a background image to fill the empty top third.

v.verdict: The downed 'want easy mode?' prompt is clear: the lime yes button is the first thing the eye lands on. But the card is slightly off-centre and overlaps the self-revive panel, the countdown is faint, and the HUD around it is crowded, so it still looks like a prototype.

findings.where: modal card (x492-1427, y261-579) over the self-revive panel (y579-651)
findings.what: The modal sits directly on top of the self-revive panel. The panel's progress bar and 'self-revive, one per raid' hang off the card's bottom edge as if they were part of it. The card is also not centred: its centre is y420, while the screen centre is y540. The gap between the title and the buttons is large and empty.
findings.fix: Treat the modal and the self-revive as one stack. Either put the self-revive row inside the card as a 16px tx-2 footer, 16px under the buttons, or move the panel 24px below the card. Centre the card vertically. Reduce the title-to-button gap from about 100px to 32px.

findings.what: The timer is about 24px, thin, low-contrast tx-2, and pushed into the card's top-right corner. The player has to answer before it runs out, yet it has no ring, no bar and no urgency, and nothing explains what '11' means.
findings.fix: Make it a 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 number, and --danger at 5 or less. Put a 3px --acc bar along the card's top edge that shrinks over the countdown. There is already a short lime stub at x492-562, y261, which looks like a bar that is stuck at the start. Either run it as the timer or remove it.

findings.what: 'y yes' is a full lime fill with dark text, which is correct as the primary. But 'n no' is an almost invisible 1px border on the same fill as the card. The key letters 'y' and 'n' are the same weight and size as the labels and have no keycap chip, which is the opposite of how the 'f' chip is styled on the HUD. Label text is about 24px and sits far from the 56px bar's edges, so the buttons feel hollow.
findings.fix: Give 'n no' a 2px --ui-line-hi border and 20px tx-1 text, so it reads as a button. Draw the 'y' and 'n' in 16px keycap chips (1px border, 4px radius, 24px tall) before the label. Show a 4px --acc focus ring on whichever button is focused, and make the buttons 64px tall with a 16px gap.

findings.what: The title is about 32px and is left-aligned at 47px padding, while the buttons span the full width below it. The body has no secondary line or context, so the player does not know why the question appears (they are downed). The card is 935px wide for only 2 words of content.
findings.fix: Narrow the card to about 640px, or keep the width and align the title and countdown on one 24px padding baseline. Add a 16px tx-2 sub-label such as 'you are down', or drop the card to a bottom-centre banner.

findings.where: HUD behind the modal: 'player 2 joined' toast (y893-930), 'player 2' tag, ammo and hp bar
findings.what: The scrim over the HUD is too light (about 40%), so the toast, player-2 name tags and the weapon bar compete with the modal. The 'player 2 joined' toast sits on top of the character, and the 'player 2' tag appears twice (left at y332 and in the world at y866). The 'hp 0' bar is a saturated red slab, and 'down' is 36px red text with a different font weight from the rest.
findings.fix: Use --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) behind the modal, or dim everything except the modal. Put the join toast in the left feed, not on the player. Make the 'hp 0' bar a 12px bar with a 16px label, and use a 3px --danger border for the empty state instead of a solid fill.

findings.where: top-centre score block (x808-1110, y0-107) and 'extract 141m' chip (y103-133)
findings.what: The score card is clipped by the top edge, with no margin. 'extract 141m' hangs off its bottom edge as a separate small chip, with a different border colour. The score numbers are in three sizes (56, 28 and 22px), so the eye does not know which one is the hero. The goals dropdown at top-right has no matching top margin or panel style.
findings.fix: Start the card at y16, and make it one panel with three rows: the 'team score' label at 16px, the score at 56px, and the timer at 20px. Put the extract line inside the panel as a 16px --extract row. Give the goals dropdown the same 16px top margin and --ui-panel fill.

findings.where: weapon bar (y948-1060) and ammo card (x1642-1910, y868-1017)
findings.what: The bar has 9 slots in which 7 are blank dark silhouettes at about 15% contrast. They add noise, and the slot number keys are tiny at about 14px. The ammo card is a different height and bottom edge from the bar (1017 against 1060), and its 'compact smg' text is dim. The digits '30 / 180' are set in two sizes and two weights.
findings.fix: Show only the owned slots, or reduce the empty ones to a 1px outline at 40% opacity. Raise the slot number to 16px. Align the bottom edges of the bar and ammo card at y1048 (32px margin). Set '30' at 56px 800 and '/ 180' at 20px tx-2 on the same baseline.

v.verdict: This is a different screen from the one I reviewed before. It's an in-raid downed prompt where the easy-mode dialog sits on top of the self-revive prompt, the HUD is crowded, and the type sizes and panels don't match the style guide.

findings.where: 'want easy mode?' modal (x 492-1427, y 261-579) over the self-revive card (x 721-1199, y 579-651)
findings.what: The modal overlaps the self-revive card and cuts its top edge off. The card's progress bar is left hanging below the modal, so two prompts compete. A downed player cannot tell whether to press f or y/n. The modal also has no scrim, so the raid keeps competing behind it.
findings.fix: Show one prompt at a time. Either queue the easy-mode question until after the revive, or stack the two with a 24px gap. Put a --scrim (rgba(6,7,8,.80)) behind the modal. Centre the modal vertically with equal 48px padding.

findings.what: The title is a 32px bold white-ish heading, but the modal has no explanation of what easy mode changes. The empty band between the title and the buttons (y 360-430) is dead space. The countdown '12' (x 1359-1381, y 336-358) is a tiny, unlabeled grey number. The player cannot tell whether it is a timer or a count.
findings.fix: Make the countdown 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1, or turn it into a thin lime bar along the card's top edge. Replace the empty band with a 16px tx-2 line that says what changes. Cut the card height to about 220px.

findings.what: The yes button is a huge, flat lime block. The no button has only a 1px border. The two buttons are 100px tall and 405px wide, so they are far heavier than the title. The label text is 20px inside a 100px block. The 'y' and 'n' key letters are the same weight as the label, so they read as part of the word.
findings.fix: Make both buttons 56px tall. Keep lime fill on yes only. Give no a 1px --ui-line-hi border and tx-1 text. Render the key as a 16px tx-2 hint in a small bordered cap, right-aligned in the button. Show pad focus as a 2px lime outline with 4px offset on whichever button is focused.

findings.what: A short lime tick sits on the top edge. It looks like a stray progress bar, and it is not linked to the countdown. It is also 70px wide, so it reads as a glitch.
findings.fix: Make it a full-width 3px timer bar that shrinks with the countdown, or delete it.

findings.where: HUD bottom-left (x 20-430, y 940-1070) 'down' tag and 'hp 0' bar
findings.what: There are two competing red elements. 'down' is a small red-bordered tag floating at x 26-103. 'hp 0' is a 410px red bar with 36px text. The bar has a red-on-red label, which is low contrast. The bar is also far wider than the 'player 1' bar at the left (x 14-170), so the two health bars follow different rules.
findings.fix: Use one health component. Put 'down' inside the hp bar as a 16px label. Make the bar 280px wide with a 4px radius and the fill in --danger. Use tx-1 text on a --ui-void track so the label stays readable. Align to the 48px margin.

findings.where: top-centre score panel (x 809-1111, y 0-107) and 'extract 108m' pill (x 889-1032, y 103-133)
findings.what: The score panel is crammed against the top edge, with 'team score' at 16px and 'you 0 sp / pl 0 sp' at about 14px. The panel's bottom edge collides with the 'extract' pill, which is not centred on it. The panel also looks like a different component from the weapon card at bottom right.
findings.fix: Move the score panel down to y 16, and 8px of padding all round. Raise the sub-lines to 16px tx-2. Leave 8px between the panel and the extract pill. Use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, on every HUD card.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' tag (x 885-1035, y 894-929) and 'keyboard' tag (x 10-105, y 5-32)
findings.what: Two small tags use different treatments: the party tag is black with a white 14px label, and the keyboard tag is outlined in green with a bold teal label. Both read as debug labels. The 'keyboard' tag sits against the screen edge with no margin.
findings.fix: Use one tag style: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line border, 14px tx-2 text, 4px radius, 8px by 16px padding. Move the keyboard tag to the 48px margin.

findings.what: The empty weapon slots at 1, 4-9 and 0 are dim and similar, so the equipped slot is lost among them. The ammo number '25' is at the right size for a hero but is placed right against the screen edge, with only 10px of margin. The slot count '150' (16px) is tight against the slot edges.
findings.fix: Dim empty slots to 40% and drop the numbers on them. Keep a 2px lime border on the selected slot only. Move the ammo card in to the 48px margin (right edge x 1872) and match its bottom edge to the weapon bar at y 1060.

v.verdict: The downed card is now one compact stack with a clear hero timer and a single self-revive prompt, but the red down label, timing bar, hp bar and 'down' tag all repeat the same state in several places.

findings.where: hp bar bottom-left (x24-430, y1033-1067) and 'down' tag (x26-103, y935-972)
findings.what: The downed state is shown three times: the card title 'down', the 'down' tag, and a solid red 'hp 0' bar. The 'hp 0' bar is a loud, full-saturation red fill that is the heaviest object on the screen outside the card. It competes with the timer for attention and breaks the rule that danger red is a small accent.
findings.fix: Remove the 'down' tag, or drop the card title and keep the tag. Draw the empty hp bar as a 12px bar with a 1px --danger outline and no fill, with a 16px tx-2 label.

findings.where: timing strip at the card top (x838-1082, y428-446)
findings.what: This strip has no label. It holds a white tick, a red block and a dark track, and nothing says it is a revive or bleed-out timer. It sits above the title, where it reads as a stray widget. A second bar (y593-601) under the 14.65s adds to the confusion.
findings.fix: Remove one of the two bars. If the strip is a minigame, label it at 16px tx-2 and put it below the timer. Otherwise delete it and keep only the 8px bar under the number, filled with --danger and draining.

findings.what: The line is a 24px tx-1 sentence, 'self-revive, one per raid', with the key as a lime '[f]'. It is the primary action but has no key chip. The explaining clause 'one per raid' is clutter, and the text is heavier than the title above it.
findings.fix: Draw the key as a 24px keycap chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Set the label at 20px f-cond 600 and cut the clause to 'self-revive'. Show the remaining count as '1' at 16px tx-2.

findings.what: The card is dense. The bar sits 16px under the top edge, the title and the 56px timer are 24px apart, and the bottom prompt is about 10px above the bottom edge. The orange stub at the top-left (x735-770, y411) looks like a leftover progress bar or an artefact.
findings.fix: Use 24px padding on all sides. Remove the stub, or run it as a 3px --danger bar across the card top that shrinks with the timer.

findings.what: A black, square-cornered toast with a 16px label sits on top of the weapon bar. It uses a different fill and radius from the card (--ui-void, 4px) and from the other HUD panels, and it is placed where it hides gameplay and the hotbar.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed under the 'player 2' tag. Use --ui-panel with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: top-centre score panel (x808-1111, y0-107) and 'extract 152m' chip (x888-1031, y100-134)
findings.what: The extract chip overlaps the bottom edge of the score panel. The score block has three type sizes next to each other (the 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' lines are about 16px) and sits flush against the top edge with no margin.
findings.fix: Put the chip 8px below the panel. Add 16px top margin to the score panel. Set the 'you' and 'p2' lines at 16px tx-2 and keep one hero number.

findings.where: the 'goals 0/3' dropdown (x1603-1901, y24-65) and the 'c 152m' marker (x1748-1850, y470-508)
findings.what: The goals dropdown is a full-width collapsed bar with a chevron, and its type is 28px, the same as the card title. It outweighs the quiet info it carries. The 'c 152m' chip repeats the 'extract 152m' chip in a different format, with 'c' as a cryptic prefix.
findings.fix: Shrink the goals bar to 20px text in a 40px row. Write the marker as 'extract 152m' in the same chip style, or drop one of the two.

v.verdict: the easy-mode modal is gone and the downed card now reads clearly, with one hero number and a single prompt, but the card has no scrim, the player 1 label appears twice, and the bottom-left down tag and hp bar are still two separate pieces.

findings.where: HUD bottom-left (x 25-430, y 935-1068): 'down' tag and 'hp 0' bar
findings.what: The same state is shown three times: the 'down' tag, the 'hp 0' bar, and the 'down' title in the centre card. The tag floats 80px above the bar. The bar is a flat red slab with no track, so an empty bar reads as a full one. It also sits flush against the screen edge at x 25 and y 1068, which breaks the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Remove the separate 'down' tag. Make one bar 280x24 at x 48, y 1008. Use a --ui-void track with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put a 16px 'down' label inside, with the fill at 0 percent. Keep the red --danger for the label only.

findings.where: Downed card (x 721-1199, y 412-651) over the map
findings.what: The card has no scrim. The busy orange map shows around it, and the 56px hero number is the brightest element on the screen, which is correct, but the card edges blend into the walls. The tint over the whole map is a muddy purple and brown. The 3px red tab at top-left (x 735-770, y 411) is a stray fragment.
findings.fix: Add --scrim at about 0.5 alpha behind the card, or a 1px --ui-line-hi border plus a soft drop shadow. Delete the red fragment, or turn it into a full-width 3px timer bar along the top edge. Use a 4px radius.

findings.what: There are three timers: the red bracket bar (y 437), the 16.22s number, and the grey progress bar (y 597). Nobody can tell which one is the bleed-out countdown. The red bar with a white tick looks like a skill-check mini game and is unexplained. The two bars are close to the number, and the grey bar is dim.
findings.fix: Keep only one bar, under the number. Make it 8px tall with a lime or --danger fill that shrinks. If the red bracket is a real mechanic, label it with a 16px tx-2 word. Otherwise remove it. Space the rows 16px apart.

findings.what: This is the only action, and it is plain text with a lime '[f]' in brackets. The line explains itself with 'one per raid', which counts as an explaining sentence. The 20px text is roughly the same weight as the 'down' title, so the action is not clearly the main thing to do.
findings.fix: Put a 48px-tall button, 280px wide, with an --acc fill, --acc-ink text, and a 16px key cap with 'f' on the left, reading 'self-revive'. Put 'one per raid' as a 16px tx-2 tag on the right, or drop it.

findings.where: Top-left 'keyboard' chip (x 10-105, y 6-32) and 'player 1' health tag (x 15-170, y 322-352)
findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip is tucked into the corner at x 10, which is off the 48px margin and has a green border that matches nothing else. The 'player 1' label is a second tag far from the player: it appears at x 15, y 330 and also over the character at x 875, y 258. The same player is named twice, in two unrelated places.
findings.fix: Show the player name once, over the character. Move the keyboard chip to x 48, y 48 with a 16px tx-2 label and a --ui-line-hi border. Remove the left-edge health bar if the bottom-left bar covers the same thing.

findings.where: Top-centre score card (x 808-1110, y 0-107) and 'extract 145m' chip (x 888-1032, y 100-134)
findings.what: The score card is jammed against the top edge with no padding, and the 'you 0 sp / pl 0 sp' text is about 13px, below the 16px floor. The extract chip overlaps the card's bottom edge. The 'team score' label is tx-2 on a brown card, so the contrast is low. The card also shows '0 sp' as a 56px-class hero, which competes with the 16.22s timer.
findings.fix: Move the card to y 16 with 16px padding. Make the sub-scores 16px tx-1. Put the extract chip 8px below the card, not overlapping. Drop the score to the 32px title size while the player is down.

findings.what: This is a status line that floats just above the hotbar and doesn't say what it is about. It is a different black chip from the rest of the HUD: 14px text, a square border, and no accent. It also uses a capitalised-looking possessive.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed with the other lines, at 16px tx-1 on --ui-panel with a 4px radius. Or delete it if it adds nothing.

findings.what: The hotbar slots 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are dim silhouettes at roughly 25 percent opacity, so seven of nine slots are noise. The ammo card sits at x 1910, about 10px from the right edge, and the hotbar sits 18px from the bottom. Both break the 48px margin. The ammo number '60 / 360' is fine as the hero.
findings.fix: Move the ammo card to right 48px, bottom 48px. Hide empty slots, or give them a 1px --ui-line outline with no art. Keep the slot highlight in lime on the active slot only. The 'f' badge on slot 1 needs a 16px minimum.

v.verdict: The raid HUD reads clearly in places (hotbar, ammo, clock), but a big controls panel crowds the left side, the hud pieces use mixed sizes and styles, and the reload prompt is clipped behind that panel.

findings.where: reload prompt at x≈410-445,y≈536, right edge of the controls panel
findings.what: The reload tag is cut off and reads 'load'. The controls panel covers it, and it is a tiny black chip with 14px text. This is the screen's subject and it is unreadable.
findings.fix: Draw the reload prompt above the panels in z-order. Anchor it 24px above the player or the crosshair. Make it 20px f-cond with a 'reload' label and the pad glyph 'x'. Use an --ui-panel fill and an --acc border.

findings.what: A full two-column key list is open at 400x300px on a raid screen. The guide says it should be folded to one short line at mid-bottom left, and F1 opens it. It hides the map and the reload prompt, and the player sees a wall of text.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px line ('hold view: controls') at left 5%, bottom 160px. Open it only on F1 or a held view button. If it must stay open, shrink it to 280px wide, set its opacity to 0.85, and keep it clear of the player's sight line.

findings.where: controls panel type and key caps
findings.what: Section labels ('move', 'gear', 'fight') are 16px in #8a8a8a, below the 4.5:1 floor on the panel. The key caps are small, with a light outline and uneven widths ('ls', 'lb / rb', 'view hold'). The key names are inconsistent, 'I stick' looks like a capital I, and the 'view tap' and 'view hold' wording is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Set labels to --tx-2 #aaa498 at 16px with +.04em tracking. Give every key cap a fixed 56px min-width, 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Write 'l stick' with a clear lower-case L, or use pad glyphs.

findings.where: top-left 'current pillager bots' panel and top-right 'contracts 0/8' panel
findings.what: The two panels use different widths, different title weights and different chevron styles. The score list is dim, with the player row 'you' at 20px and the rest at 16px. There is a lone '0' after the title and a '0 out · 3 dead' footer that is noisy. 'dead' is repeated on every row. The player's own row has no amber P1 marker.
findings.fix: Give both panels the same --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 16px padding. Use one title size, 16px 600. Drop the '0' after the title and the 'dead' suffix. Add a 3px amber bar on the 'you' row.

findings.where: bottom-left status cluster: concealed / in cover chips and hp bar, x24-430,y910-1068
findings.what: Two different chip styles are used: amber outline and teal outline. They have 28px text, which breaks the type scale, and it is too large next to the hp bar. The hp bar is a flat bright green slab with a black outline at 100% full. 'hp 100' at 32px is cramped on the left edge of the bar. The bar has an ungrouped, loose outline and sits only 10px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Set the chips to 20px f-cond, 4px radius and 8px padding, with a warn amber or extract teal glyph only. Make the hp bar 12px high, in --ok on a --ui-line track, with '100' as 20px text. Use a 48px margin from the screen edge and align the left edge to the controls line.

findings.what: The '2 / 60' hero number is red because the magazine is low, but the card is a plain black box that adds a third bottom-right layout. It touches the screen edge at the right and bottom, with only about 10px margin. 'view backpack' and '3 items $1,620' are tiny and weakly aligned.
findings.fix: Keep the 56px hero number and add a 'low' marker in --danger. Align the card to the hotbar baseline and a 48px right margin. Use 16px --tx-2 for the footer row, spaced with 8px gaps.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extraction chip, x890-1030,y10-75
findings.what: The 8:59 clock is large and clear, but the teal 'extraction 387m' pill is a different size, with a hard 2px border. The small teal arrow under it overlaps the pill edge and is unlabeled.
findings.fix: Make the pill 16px text and 4px radius, with 8px vertical padding. Place the direction arrow inside the pill at the left. Keep the clock 32px f-cond 700.

findings.what: Slot 1 has an amber border and slot 3 has a blue fill, so two slots look selected at once. Weapon icons in the unselected slots are very dark and low contrast. The 'rb' chip on slot 1 is tiny.
findings.fix: Use one selected state, a 2px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Set idle slots to full-colour icons at 60% opacity. Put the key numbers at 16px and the 'rb' glyph at 16px on a --ui-panel chip.

v.verdict: The raid HUD has a coherent dark-panel language, but the open controls list is a big wall of text that covers the map and a world label, and the corners fight each other for attention, so it reads as a debug overlay rather than a polished extraction-shooter HUD.

findings.what: The 400x300 panel is fully open, although the spec says the list sits mid-bottom left, folded to one short line, until F1 opens it. It is also anchored mid-left instead of mid-bottom. It covers the 'ch cache' world label, which is clipped at the panel edge, and it is the largest, densest block on screen, so it pulls the eye away from play.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 32px line at x=24, y=~1000 (above the hp bar) reading 'f1 controls'. Open it only on F1. When open, keep the panel under 320x260 and make sure it never overlaps world labels (move the label or draw it above the panel).

findings.where: controls list, key caps and text
findings.what: Key caps are inconsistent in width and style ('l stick', 'ls', 'b', 'a', 'view hold', 'd-up', 'menu'). Labels at about 14-15px fall below the 16px floor. 'i stick' looks like a capital I or lowercase L, and 'ls' is a second name for the same stick. The columns are uneven and the section labels (move, fight, gear) are dim grey, about 3:1.
findings.fix: Give every cap a fixed 56x24 box with 16px f-cond 600. Raise section labels to tx-2 at 16px with +.04em tracking. Drop the duplicate rows. Align the two columns on one baseline grid with 8px row gaps.

findings.what: The header is a debug-style phrase, 'current pillager bots 0', and the footer '0 out · 3 dead' repeats the same information. Names are about 14px in dim grey. Prices are right-aligned, but the 'dead' tags are glued to the numbers with no column gap. The panel clips against the screen edge at x=8, off the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Rename the header to 'raiders'. Drop the footer line. Move the panel to x=48 and give it a 16px minimum font size. Put 'dead' in its own column in --danger at 16px. Use tx-1 for 'you' and tx-2 for the others.

findings.what: Four panels (roster, contracts, controls, ammo) share one dark fill with different borders, paddings and chevrons. The ammo panel is the heaviest, with a 56px hero, and that is correct, but the roster and controls panels are almost as heavy and so compete with it. The margins differ from corner to corner (8px, 16px, 20px) and break the 8px grid.
findings.fix: Set every HUD panel to --ui-panel at about 85% opacity with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Use a 48px outer margin on all four corners. Keep the hero weight only on ammo and the extraction timer.

findings.where: toast, 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (430-825, 777-803)
findings.what: The line is an explaining sentence, which the brief calls clutter. The amber text on dark is readable, but the toast sits tight against the bottom edge of the controls panel and touches the map's wall line. The icon is tiny.
findings.fix: Shorten it to 'contract item nearby'. Move it to the top-centre alert slot under the extraction pill. Drop the 'gold glow' clause.

findings.what: The two chips use different colours (amber and teal), different border treatments and different icon rings. The teal for 'in cover' collides with the teal that means extraction only. The hp bar below is flat and bright green with 'hp 100' in a tight, low-contrast white-on-green.
findings.fix: Use one chip style: --ui-panel fill, 16px label, tx-1 text, and a 1px border in the state colour. Take --extract off 'in cover'. Set the hp number in --acc-ink on the green bar, or move it outside the bar.

findings.what: The timer '8:59' is dim grey with a small sun icon, which weakens it as the hero number. The teal pill 'extraction 387m' is correctly teal, but it is crowded against the timer, with only about 4px between them.
findings.fix: Make the timer 32px tx-1 weight 700 and add a 12px gap above the pill. Keep the pill at 16px and align its centre to the timer's centre.

findings.what: The nine slots are all the same size. Only slot 1 has a gold border and slot 3 a blue fill, and these two highlight colours are unrelated. The selected slot should use lime, per the 'lime = selected' rule. The ammo count '37' on slot 3 is about 13px. Empty slots are nearly the same brightness as filled ones.
findings.fix: Use a --acc 2px border and a raised fill on the active slot only. Dim the inactive slots to 50% opacity, and set slot numbers and ammo counts at 16px.

v.verdict: The controls list is a big, dense, always-open block that crowds the left of the screen and clips the 'reload' pop-up, and the HUD pieces don't share a clear hierarchy or consistent panel style.

findings.what: This is the raid controls list that the guide says should be folded to one short line, opened with F1, and placed mid-bottom left. It is open and about 400x300 px. It covers a large part of the playfield and competes with the HUD for attention. It also carries a capital 'I stick' (an 'l' or 'I' that renders as a capital) and the keyboard badge says 'keyboard' while the prompts show pad glyphs, so the device is mixed.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 16px line ('f1 controls') at bottom-left, mid-bottom. Open it only on F1. When open, cap it at about 280px wide and fix the stick label to 'l stick'. Show pad labels or key labels, not both.
