findings.what: '60 / 360' is a good hero at about 40px, but 'support mg' at about 14px sits right-aligned on a different baseline from the number, and the card is jammed 5px from the right edge. The card is a different box from the score panel in padding and radius, and it floats at a different height from the bars to its left.
findings.fix: Set the number at 56px f-cond 800. Set the weapon name at 16px tx-2 left-aligned above it. Use a 4px radius and 16px padding as on the score panel. Move the card 48px from the right and bottom edges so its baseline matches the hp bar.

findings.what: The minimap is mostly black void, with blips about 6px and no readable detail. The 'goals 0/3' label is about 10px and has a chevron the size of a pixel. The map sits 10px from the top and right edges, which is a different margin from every other HUD block.
findings.fix: Crop the map to the explored area and put a 1px --ui-line-hi border on it at a 4px radius. Set the goals label to 16px tx-1 with a 20px chevron. Move the block 48px from the top and right to share the margin with the other corners.

findings.where: 'player 1' tag (487-582 x 432-453) and 'f1 controls' hint (595-652 x 585-598)
findings.what: The player tag is a floating box at the screen's left edge with two bars of about 4px and an 8px name. It overlaps nothing but has no connection to the bars at the bottom, so P1 vitals are shown twice. The 'f1 controls' hint is about 9px with a light chip in the middle of the playfield, rather than at the mid-bottom left the spec calls for.
findings.fix: Drop the 'player 1' tag when the bottom-left bars show the same data, or move it to be the label above the bars at 16px amber. Move the f1 hint to 48px from the left and 24px above the bars, set at 16px tx-2 with a --ui-raised chip.

findings.where: world labels ('crier e-18', 594-760 x 380-392) and the crosshair (670, 399)
findings.what: The enemy name tag is about 8px at low contrast on a busy green forest, so it can't be read. The crosshair is a thin 1px ring that vanishes against the foliage.
findings.fix: Set world labels at 16px tx-1 on a --scrim pill with 8px padding. Draw the crosshair at 2px with a dark 1px outline, in tx-1.

v.verdict: This is the raid HUD, not the easy-mode card I reviewed before, so that advice no longer applies. The HUD is readable and the 56px ammo count is a good hero number. It is let down by edge margins that vary, type under the 16px floor, three bottom-left bars with three different treatments, and two competing hotbar highlight states.

findings.where: bottom-left vitals (armour 40, stamina, hp 100, x22-430, y965-1070)
findings.what: The three bars have three treatments. Armour and stamina are thin bars with 20px labels, and stamina has no value. hp is a taller, fully saturated green slab with a much larger label. The armour label sits on a bright blue fill and loses contrast. The block also runs 22px from the left edge and 10px from the bottom.
findings.fix: Make all three rows the same: 24px tall, 8px gap, 4px radius, --ui-panel track. Use 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 labels sitting outside the fill, with the value right-aligned in tx-1. Keep hp as the only emphasised row (20px, 700). Indent the block to the 5% margin (48px left, 54px bottom).

findings.where: top-centre score panel (x815-1105, y0-88) and extract pill (y85-110)
findings.what: The panel is flush against the top edge with no top padding, so 'team score' at y17 reads as clipped. The 'you 0 sp / p1 0 sp' lines are about 12px, below the 16px floor. The extract pill overlaps the panel's bottom border, so the two look glued together.
findings.fix: Drop the panel 16px from the top and give it 16px padding. Set 'you' and 'p1' at 16px tx-2, with the 56px hero 'sp' number kept. Put 8px of space between the panel and the extract pill. Give the pill a 1px --extract border and 16px text.

findings.what: Slot 1 has a blue-tinted fill and slot 3 has an amber outline, so it is unclear which is selected and which is just filled. The slot numbers (about 12px) and the '150' counts are tiny and dim. Empty-slot weapon silhouettes are close to the panel colour.
findings.fix: Use one selected state: a 2px outline in the player colour, plus a --ui-raised fill. Make owned-but-unselected slots plain --ui-panel with the icon at full opacity, and empty slots at 40% opacity. Set slot numbers and counts at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, with the selected slot's number in tx-1.

findings.where: edge margins (minimap x1603-1903, ammo panel to x1910, left vitals x22)
findings.what: The minimap sits 17px from the top and right, the ammo panel 10px from the right and bottom, and the vitals 22px from the left. The guide says 5% margins, so the HUD corners do not line up with each other.
findings.fix: Put every corner group on one safe-area inset of 48px (right and left) and 32px (top and bottom). Align the ammo panel's bottom edge with the hotbar's bottom edge.

findings.what: The row is a separate dark bar stuck to the minimap's bottom edge with a different left and right inset and no border. The minimap itself has no border, so its edge is lost against the bright orange ground.
findings.fix: Give the minimap and the goals row one shared 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, with no gap between them. Use 16px f-cond 600 for the goals label and align the count to the right.

findings.what: The plate sits mid-left, unrelated to the bottom-left vitals, and carries a thin double bar whose meaning is unclear. A second 'player 1' tag floats over the character. The bars are about 5px tall, too small to read from a couch.
findings.fix: Remove the mid-left plate if it repeats the vitals. If it is the p2 or squad readout, move it into the left feed column with 16px type and 8px bars.

findings.what: The hint is a small chip jammed against the hotbar's top-left corner, so it looks like part of the hotbar. The key cap reads as 'fl' at this size, and the text is about 16px at low contrast.
findings.fix: Move it 16px left of the hotbar, vertically centred on it. Draw a 20px --ui-raised key chip, and set the label in tx-2 at 16px.

findings.what: 'auto rifle' is small and right-aligned, while the 56px number sits left-heavy inside the panel. There is a lot of dead space and no reload or magazine-state cue. The panel has no border, unlike the hotbar.
findings.fix: Give it 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the hotbar. Set the weapon name at 16px tx-2, left-aligned with the number. Put '/ 150' at 32px tx-2 on the same baseline as the 56px '25'.

v.verdict: The hud is clearly tidier: empty hotbar slots are ghosted, the selected slot has a clear outline, hp is the one bold bar and the ammo card is a clean hero number. But the selected slot uses amber where the guide says lime, the panels disagree on width and margin, and the minimap is still half empty.

findings.what: The timer 9:57 and the 0 sp score are both about 32px bold, so the hero slot is shared and the eye has no single target. The you and p2 lines sit tight against the right edge, and the weather icon floats outside the panel. The extract chip touches the panel's bottom edge with no gap, and its arrow hangs off it.
findings.fix: Set the timer to the 56px f-cond 800 hero. Set the score to 20px tx-1 and the you and p2 lines to 16px tx-2 with 24px padding on every side. Leave an 8px gap above the extract chip. Move the weather icon inside the panel or drop it.

findings.what: The three blocks do not line up. The minimap and goals bar are about 360px wide with a right margin of about 20px. The ammo card is about 255px wide with a margin of about 10px. Both margins are well under the 48px guide margin, and the right edge of the screen feels crowded. The bottom 40% of the minimap is empty black.
findings.fix: Use one 360px column and a 48px right margin for all three blocks. Crop the minimap to its content, for example 360x240. Give each block a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a --ui-panel fill and a 4px radius. Align the ammo card's top and bottom to the same grid.

findings.what: The selected slot uses an amber outline, but the guide says lime (--acc) only means selected, and amber means P1. The slot reads as a player tint, not as a selection. The slots are also uneven. The two filled slots are about 124px wide, but the empty slots are separated by about 130px, with floating numbers, so the row has no rhythm. The ghost silhouettes are still too visible against the road.
findings.fix: Use a 3px --acc outline and a --ui-raised fill on the selected slot. Give every slot a fixed 72px box on an 8px gap, with the number inside the top-left at 16px tx-2. Drop the empty-slot ghosts to 20% opacity.

findings.what: The bars are in the right order, but the labels are different sizes. Armour and stamina are about 24px, while hp is about 40px. The labels sit inside the fill with no contrast control, so the label on the light blue armour bar is weak. The three bars are about 28px, 28px and 40px high, with uneven gaps. The stack starts 28px from the left edge and 8px from the bottom, against the 96px margin the ammo card was supposed to share.
findings.fix: Make armour and stamina 14px high and hp 20px high, with a 4px gap. Put the labels at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 above each bar, with the value right-aligned. Reserve the 32px value for hp only. Inset the stack 48px from the left and bottom edges.

findings.where: player 2 tag (left, y 325-365) and f1 controls hint (y 647-675)
findings.what: The player 2 plate is a bare strip with a thin hp bar. It is small, sits in the middle of the left edge with no tie to the rest of the layout, and has no border. The f1 controls hint floats over the game at a different x from the stat stack, so it neither lines up with the bars nor sits mid-bottom as the owner ordered.
findings.fix: Move the player 2 plate to sit directly above the hp stack at the same 48px left inset, 16px label, 8px bar. Place the f1 controls hint at bottom-centre-left, with its baseline 8px above the hotbar, in a --ui-panel pill.

findings.what: The 24 is a good hero number, but the name 'burst carbine' is bigger than needed, at about 26px. The card has no mag bar, and it is not aligned to the hotbar baseline. The card edge is also too close to the screen corner at about 10px.
findings.fix: Set the name to 20px tx-2. Keep 24 at 56px f-cond 800 and / 144 at 32px tx-2. Use 24px padding. Align the card's bottom edge with the hp bar and keep a 48px margin.

findings.what: The collapse chevrons at the top-right of the minimap and on the goals row are different sizes, about 20px and 16px. The goals bar has 'goals 0/3' at 20px tx-1, so it reads as a button while the minimap header has no label at all.
findings.fix: Make both chevrons 16px tx-2 and right-align them in a 32px hit area. Give the minimap a 16px tx-2 label, 'map', to match the goals row.

v.verdict: The HUD is still drawn into a 960x540 box in the middle of a black 1920x1080 frame, with tiny type. The 'hp 100' label is still the boldest thing on screen, and the ammo card is still crowded against the corner.

findings.what: The game still renders at half size inside a black 1920x1080 canvas. The 'large' HUD size setting has no visible effect, so type is about 10px against a 20px body minimum. The HUD has no 5% margins.
findings.fix: Render the canvas at the full 1920x1080 with 96x54px margins. Apply the size multiplier (large = 1.25x) to the 1080 base, so labels reach 16px and body text 20px. Check that 'large' actually changes the result.

findings.where: top-centre score block (890,280 to 1030,350), extract chip (928,357), minimap (1250,280 to 1430,488)
findings.what: The score block is jammed against the top edge, with the 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' text beside it at about 9px. The extract chip is 11px, collides with the block's bottom edge and sits on the extraction arrow. The minimap is flush to the frame edge, and its lower half is an empty black void. The 'goals 0/3' strip is attached under the minimap.
findings.fix: Move the score block 24px below the top edge. Set '0 sp' to 56px f-cond 800 and the timer to 32px. Set the labels to 16px tx-2. Put the extract chip 16px below the block, at 16px with 8px padding. Inset the minimap 48px from the right and top, and crop or fill its empty lower half. Give 'goals' a 16px label with 8px padding.

findings.what: The 'hp 100' label is 20px bold on a bright green slab and is the loudest element in the HUD, so it competes with the ammo number. The armour and stamina bars have labels sitting inside the fill at about 11px, which is hard to read. The bar heights are inconsistent (about 12px against about 20px). The stack sits flush at x=493, only 13px from the frame edge.
findings.fix: Make all three bars 12px high with an 8px gap. Put the labels outside the bars at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, with the values at 20px tx-1. Keep hp green but drop the bold. Inset the stack 48px from the left and bottom edges.

findings.what: The card sits 4px from the right edge and 37px from the bottom, while the minimap above it uses a different inset. 'riot scattergun' is about 12px grey on near-black. The 7 / 42 reads fine, but the hero number is only about 40px.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the right and bottom edges. Align its right edge with the minimap's. Set the weapon name to 16px tx-2 and the ammo to 56px f-cond 800, with '/ 42' at 20px tx-2.

findings.what: Two small slots float in a row of faint slot numbers (1 to 0) that have no frames, so empty slots look like debris on the ground. The selected slot has an amber border, not the 2px lime --acc with a --ui-raised fill. The slot numbers are about 9px and the ammo counts about 11px.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as 64px tiles on a --ui-raised fill with a 1px --ui-line border. Give only the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Add a 3px rarity bar at the bottom. Set the slot numbers to 14px tx-2 and the counts to 16px tx-1. Put 16px between the hotbar and the player.

findings.what: The hint is about 10px, with a small key cap, floating mid-field. It is not anchored to the bottom-left, and the key cap is unclear. The 'player 2' tag is a small bar with two stacked thin bars and no clear padding. Its blue text on blue fill has low contrast.
findings.fix: Set the hint to 16px with an 8px-padded --ui-panel pill. Place it 16px above the bar stack, aligned to the 48px left margin. Make the player 2 tag a 16px label in cyan (--extract is teal; use the P2 cyan token) on --ui-panel, with 8px padding and 8px between the label and its bars.

findings.where: minimap collapse chevron (1420,290) and clock icon (1044,305)
findings.what: The chevron and the round clock icon are tiny, about 10px, and are crammed against the panel edges. They have no label, and the clock icon sits outside every group.
findings.fix: Make icons 24px with 8px padding. Put the chevron in the minimap's header row, and attach the clock icon to the score block's right edge with 8px between them.

v.verdict: The hud is readable and the ammo hero number lands well, but the margins are still 0 to 24px (not 48) and the corners don't line up. The vitals bars are still uneven, the hotbar is cluttered, and the top-centre box is cramped.

findings.what: The earlier advice is mostly ignored. The bars sit about 22px from the left edge and 2px from the bottom, with no panel or border. Heights differ: armour and stamina are about 20px, hp is about 32px. The labels are tight inside the fills and the armour text is blue on blue. hp 100 is not a 56px hero.
findings.fix: Move the cluster to 48px from the left and bottom edges. Give the three bars the same 20px height, 8px gap and 4px radius, on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line border. Put the labels in 16px tx-1 on the left and the numbers right-aligned. Make hp the only 56px f-cond 800 number, or drop the hero from hp since ammo already has one.

findings.what: Slot numbers 1-4 and 7-0 float as faint grey digits on the wall art with no slot boxes, so the row reads as noise. Only 5 and 6 are drawn as tiles. The slot-5 lime outline is the only focus cue, and it looks amber rather than lime. The 'f' key chip on slot 6 is tiny. The ammo counts (360) are about 14px.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 64px tiles with an 8px gap on --ui-panel at 4px radius. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc outline with a 2px offset. Set numbers and ammo to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1. Centre the row and lift it 48px from the bottom.

findings.where: bottom edge alignment (vitals, hotbar, ammo card)
findings.what: The three bottom clusters have unrelated baselines and margins: hp bottom is about 1068, the hotbar about 1060, and the ammo card about 1018 with a 10px right margin. Nothing sits on the 48px safe margin, so on a TV the ammo card and vitals risk overscan clipping.
findings.fix: Put all three clusters on the same 48px bottom margin, with the left and right clusters 48px from their screen edges. Make the ammo card the same height as the hotbar tiles (about 72px), right edge at x=1872.

findings.what: The score reads 'you 0 sp / p2 0 sp' at about 14px in tx-2, below the 16px floor. The 0 sp hero is about 28px and the timer is about 20px, so there are three competing sizes. The extract pill sits 10px under the box with a different fill and no consistent spacing. The weather icon floats loose to the right.
findings.fix: Set the score to 32px f-cond 800, the timer to 20px, and the you/p2 lines to 16px tx-2. Pad the box 16px. Merge the extract pill into the box as a bottom row separated by a 1px --ui-line. Put the weather glyph inside the box at 16px.

findings.what: The minimap sits only 18px from the top and 16px from the right, so it hugs the screen edge. Its border is barely visible and the collapse chevron is jammed into the map corner. The map's lower half is empty black, which wastes about 40% of the panel. The goals 0/3 bar is a different width and fill from the map panel.
findings.fix: Inset the map 48px from the top and right. Use a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both the map and goals panels. Move the chevron into the goals header. Crop the map to the explored area or fill it. Set the goals label to 16px f-cond 600.

findings.where: player 2 tag at the top-left and in-world nameplate
findings.what: The player 2 plate at the left edge (x=15) has a blue name on a dark fill with two thin bars, and it sits flush against the edge. It is a third bar style that differs from the vitals bars and the minimap panel. The in-world 'player 2' tag is about 12px, below the 16px floor.
findings.fix: Use the same bar spec as the vitals (20px, 4px radius, --ui-panel). Inset the plate 48px from the left and top. Set the name to 16px f-cond 600 in cyan (P2 colour). Raise the in-world tag to at least 16px.

findings.what: The chip is about 14px grey text on a dark pill. It sits on the wall art and next to the hotbar numbers, so it looks like a stray label. It is also not centred mid-bottom as the spec for the career raid says.
findings.fix: Set the text to 16px tx-1 on a --ui-panel pill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border at 4px radius. Align it to the 48px left margin, and put it directly above the vitals cluster on the same left edge.

findings.what: A heavy purple/orange colour wash over the map lowers contrast behind the HUD. The semi-transparent grey slot numbers and the faint gun silhouettes in the bar are lost on the wall texture.
findings.fix: Put a --scrim at 60% under the bottom 120px strip. Remove the ghost gun silhouettes or raise them to 40% opacity on a solid --ui-panel row.

v.verdict: The hotbar now shows only the two owned slots with a clear active ring, and the ammo block is a strong hero number. The rest of the HUD is still uneven: the top panel is flush against the screen edge, the three bars each have a different height, and the bottom-left corner is crowded.

findings.what: The empty slots are gone, but the digits 2 and 4-0 still float in the open with faint weapon ghosts behind them. That reads as clutter. The two cards (slots 1 and 3) sit at an irregular gap with the numbers between them, and the bar sits well above the bottom margin.
findings.fix: Remove the ghost silhouettes and the idle digits. Keep the two cards on one 8px-grid gap (16px). Dock the bar 32px above the bottom edge, so the card bottoms land near y1048. Show a key digit only inside a card.

findings.where: top-centre team score panel, x822-1098, y20-162
findings.what: The panel is now offset from the top edge, which is good. Inside, 'team score' is centred while the 'you 0 sp / p1 0 sp' column is right-aligned, and the 56px '0 sp' and the 9:57 timer are close together with no clear order. The weather chip sits 12px away and the extract pill has no gap to the panel. The corner radii and fills do not match the minimap block.
findings.fix: Left-align one column: 56px f-cond 800 '0 sp' with the 32px timer under it, and the 16px tx-2 'you / p1' rows on the right. Use 8px between the panel and the extract pill, 4px radius everywhere, and the same --scrim fill as the minimap panel.

findings.what: Armour (24px), stamina (24px) and hp (40px) are three different heights, and the hp label is 40px, much larger than the other two. The hp bar is a loud saturated green block, the loudest thing in the corner. The 'player 1' card at the left (y325-365) repeats the same hp and stamina bars in a second place.
findings.fix: Set all three bars to 24px with a 4px gap and 16-20px f-cond labels at 8px left padding. Fill hp with --ok at about 80% and switch to --danger below 30%. Drop the hp label to 20px. Remove or merge the duplicate 'player 1' card.

findings.what: The hint floats at an arbitrary spot above the hotbar's left edge and is not aligned to the bars or to the screen margin. The chip and the label are tightly packed, and the label is only about 16px.
findings.fix: Anchor it at x32, 16px above the top of the hp stack (y~920). Use a 16px tx-2 label and an 'f1' chip with a --ui-line-hi border on --scrim at .80.

findings.what: The minimap's lower half is a large empty black area, and its top-right compass icons are crowded and tiny. The goals row has a different corner radius and a different fill from the other panels. The map sits 20px from the top and 20px from the right, while the bottom-left bars sit 28px from the left.
findings.fix: Crop the minimap to its used area or fill it. Use a 32px margin everywhere. Give goals the same 4px radius and --scrim fill as the other panels. Make the compass icons 16px minimum.

findings.what: The block is a strong hero number (about 80px) but is bigger than the 56px hero token, and it sits 10px from the right edge, not on the 32px margin. The '/ 150' reserve is tx-2 but about 44px, which competes with the 25.
findings.fix: Set the 25 to 56px f-cond 800 and '/ 150' to 20px tx-2. Pull the panel in to 32px from the right and bottom edges, and keep the 'auto rifle' label at 16px.

findings.where: crosshair, enemy tag and 'crier e-18' label, x356-550, y233-260
findings.what: The 'crier e-18' tag has a different box style from every other label (hard rectangle, tx-2 text at 16px). The crosshair is thin and low-contrast on the grass.
findings.fix: Use the same 4px-radius --scrim fill as the other panels. Add a 1px dark outline to the crosshair and thicken it to 2px.

v.verdict: The HUD is still a small 960x540 window inside a black 1920x1080 frame, so the large-HUD setting is not shown to work, and inside the window the HUD is still small and has hierarchy problems.

findings.what: The game renders at 50% inside a black letterbox, the same as the previous shot. The HUD size row 'does nothing' (as the shot name says). The 'large' setting cannot be judged, and nothing here reads at couch distance.
findings.fix: Render the capture at the full 1920x1080. Make the 'large' preset scale every HUD element by about 1.5x, so the 20px body text is 30px and the 16px labels are 24px. Re-shoot with the setting on.

findings.what: '0 sp' is only about 16px and the timer is about 12px. The sub-scores ('you 0 sp', 'p1 0 sp') are about 9px and hard to read. The hero number is not 56px, and there is no accent on the number. The panel is cramped, with about 6px of padding.
findings.fix: Set '0 sp' at 56px f-cond 800 in tx-1. Set the timer at 20px tx-2. Set the sub-scores at 16px, with you in amber and p2 in cyan. Use 16px padding and move the panel 24px from the top. Do not show both 'you' and 'p1', since that is the same value twice.

findings.what: The three bars have three different heights (about 12, 12 and 20px), and the label text is about 11px and set against a busy bar fill. The hp bar is solid green and heavy, so it pulls the eye more than the ammo does. The block sits only about 13px from the left edge and 5px from the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Give all three bars a uniform 12px height with 8px gaps. Set the labels at 16px tx-1 on a --ui-panel plate. Show hp at 56px in f-cond 800, with its bar thin (8px). Move the block 48px in from the left and bottom edges.

findings.what: The two weapon slots float mid-screen, with an empty gap between 2 and 6 and faint ghost icons for slots 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 0. The slot numbers are about 9px, and nothing is aligned to a grid. The strip overlaps the players' feet and the 'player 1' tag at 970-990 x 659. The selected slot's yellow outline is the only focus cue and is thin.
findings.fix: Show only owned slots. Make them 72px square with 8px gaps, in one contiguous row centred at the bottom, 24px from the bottom edge. Set slot numbers at 16px tx-2. Mark the selected slot with a 3px --acc bottom bar and a --ui-raised fill. Remove the ghost icons and the digit row.

findings.what: '30 / 180' is a good hero number, but the card sits about 5px from the right edge and 37px from the bottom. Its baseline does not match the hp bar at left, and the card overlaps the road art. 'compact smg' is about 12px and right-aligned, so it has weak contrast.
findings.fix: Align the card's bottom edge with the hp bar's bottom edge, and sit it 48px from the right and bottom edges. Set 'compact smg' at 16px tx-2, left-aligned. Keep the number at 56px. Use a 4px radius and 16px padding.

findings.what: The minimap is large and has a big empty black lower half. The goals row looks like a native dropdown, with a chevron and 11px text. Its edge is cut by the right margin at about 11px.
findings.fix: Crop the map to its content, about 180x120 at 16px label scale. Move the panel 24px from the top and right edges. Make the goals row 16px text with a 4px radius, and use the same panel fill as the score panel.

findings.where: 'f1 controls' hint (594-652 x 593-608) and 'player 1' mini bar (487-582 x 431-453)
findings.what: The 'f1 controls' hint is about 10px and floats mid-field over the trees. The 'player 1' mini bar hangs on the left edge with no relation to the other HUD blocks and is about 10px text.
findings.fix: Anchor the hint 48px from the left and 24px above the hp bar, at 16px label size, in the bottom-left group. Either merge the 'player 1' bar into the bottom-left stack or remove it, since hp already shows.

findings.where: extract tag (927-993 x 357-372) and carrier label (722-756 x 381-391)
findings.what: The 'extract 148m' tag is about 11px teal on a dark fill, tight against the score panel with only 6px between them. The 'crier e-18' label is about 9px and unreadable at couch distance.
findings.fix: Set the extract tag at 16px with 8px padding, with 8px of gap under the score panel. Raise world labels to a minimum of 16px, or hide them unless the player is within 10m.

v.verdict: The HUD is readable, but the corner groups sit on ragged margins, the hotbar is nearly invisible against the street, and the vitals bars and score panel are still not tidied the way last review asked.

findings.what: The three bars have three heights and three type sizes: armour and stamina are thin, hp is a tall bar with a big 'hp 100'. The labels sit inside the fills, so they lose contrast on the blue and green. The block is 22px from the edge, not on the margin.
findings.fix: Make every row 24px tall with an 8px gap and a 4px radius on a --ui-panel track. Put 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 labels outside the fill, with the value right-aligned. Keep hp as the only emphasised row, at 20px 700. Inset the block 48px left and 32px bottom.

findings.what: The hotbar has no shared strip. Slots 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 0 are bare numbers floating on the street texture, and only slots 3 and 5 are filled tiles. The tiles are different in kind from the numbers around them. The selected slot's amber outline is soft, and the counts are tiny and sit low at the tile edge.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 56x56 --ui-panel tiles with 8px gaps, with empties at 40% opacity. Selected state is a 2px player-colour outline plus a --ui-raised fill. Set numbers and counts at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, and the selected slot's number in tx-1. Align the bottom edge to y=1048.

findings.where: top-centre score panel (x845-1075, y17-135) and extract pill (y145-170)
findings.what: Two numbers compete: the 'team score' 0 sp and the 9:57 timer are both bold, about the same size, and stacked in the left column. 'you 0 sp / p1 0 sp' is tiny and faint on the right. The extract pill sits 10px under the panel and its text is small. The weather icon floats outside the panel.
findings.fix: Make the 56px hero the sp number only. Move the timer to 20px 700 on its own row, or to the panel's right side. Set 'you' and 'p1' at 16px tx-2. Give the panel 16px padding. Put 8px between the panel and the pill. Give the pill a 1px --extract border and 16px text. Move the weather icon inside the panel's right edge.

findings.where: edge margins (minimap x1603-1903, ammo panel x1705-1910, vitals x22, player 1 tag x15)
findings.what: Every corner group sits on a different inset: 17px at the minimap top, 10px at the ammo right edge, 22px for vitals and 15px for the player 1 tag. The ammo panel's bottom edge (y1018) does not line up with the hotbar (y1062) or the vitals (y1070).
findings.fix: Use one safe area: 48px left and right, 32px top and bottom. Align the ammo panel's bottom edge to the hotbar baseline at y=1048.

findings.what: The minimap is a black box with no visible border. It is separated from the goals row by a gap, and the goals row is its own darker pill with a different radius. The 'goals 0/3' label is 16px but its chevron is oversized.
findings.fix: Join the map and the goals row into one panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put a 1px --ui-line divider between them. Align the count right at 16px f-cond 600 and shrink the chevron to 12px.

findings.what: The '60 / 360' number is the right hero, but 'support mg' sits in the corner at about 20px with weak contrast, and the box is cramped to the screen edge with an uneven 10px inset on the right.
findings.fix: Set 'support mg' at 16px tx-2, left-aligned. Keep 60 at 56px 800 in tx-1 and the '/ 360' reserve at 20px tx-2. Use 16px padding and the 48px right inset.

findings.where: player 1 tag (x15-170, y323-358) and 'f1 controls' chip (x437-535, y930-952)
findings.what: The player 1 tag is a stray left-edge panel with a thin bar that duplicates the vitals block, and it is cut by the screen edge. The 'f1 controls' chip is a different style again, with its own fill and key-cap look, jammed against the hotbar numbers.
findings.fix: Delete the left-edge player 1 tag, or merge it into the vitals block as a 16px label. Restyle the chip as a --ui-panel pill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px text and 8px padding. Move it 16px above the vitals.

v.verdict: The downed card is gone and the raid HUD now reads clearly, with a good hero ammo number and a quiet top centre. It is still not polished: the left side is crowded with overlapping panels, panel styles and radii vary, and the minimap is high contrast and heavy.

findings.what: The 'current pillager bots 3' panel has a 14-15px name and money list with very tight 18px row spacing. Its header is bold and white, so it competes with the hero number and the extract banner. The tx-2 / tx-1 split is missing, so every row is the same weight and the '$' column has no hierarchy.
findings.fix: Set rows at 16px f-cond 600 with 24px row pitch. Make the header 16px tx-2. Show 'you' in tx-1 and the others in tx-2. Fold the list to a single line by default, since the owner wants the corners quiet.

findings.what: The minimap is a heavy, high-contrast black block with bright white wall bars, which pulls the eye away from the player. The contracts bar below it uses 18px bold text and a different panel style: square corners, no border, and a chevron icon that does not match the one in the scoreboard.
findings.fix: Fill the minimap with --ui-panel at 85% opacity and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Draw the wall bars in --ui-line-hi, not white. Use the same 4px radius, 16px label and chevron on contracts and on the scoreboard.

findings.what: The bar is a flat, saturated green slab that sits 13px from the screen edge, which breaks the 5% margin. The 'hp 100' text is 32px with a heavy outline and sits against the fill, so it reads like a template. The bar is also much larger than the weapon slots, so it competes with the ammo hero number.
findings.fix: Draw a 12px tall bar in --ok with a --ui-line track. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 and 'hp' at 16px tx-2 above the bar. Move it to x=54 (5% margin) and align its baseline to the weapon slot row.

findings.where: 'pillager' name card (x13-170, y323-358) and 'p1' tag (x943-977, y612-642)
findings.what: The name card below the scoreboard has a third panel treatment, a blue-tinted fill with a green bar. It has no apparent purpose next to the 'p1' tag. The 'p1' tag uses an amber border on a dark fill, which looks like a different component and has a 2px radius.
findings.fix: Remove the left 'pillager' card, since the name already floats over the character. Redraw 'p1' as a 16px label chip with --ui-panel fill, a 1px amber border and 4px radius, 24px above the head.

findings.what: The toast sits mid-bottom, right over the weapon slot numbers 5-8, and it blocks the hotbar area. It uses square corners and no border, which does not match the other panels. The previous advice was to move it to the left feed, and that was not done.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed at x=54, y=370 (below the scoreboard). Use --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, 8px by 16px padding.

findings.what: The card is well placed and its hero number works, but the card hugs the right edge at 10px, not the 5% margin. 'view backpack' (14px) and '3 items $1,220' (14px) are below the 16px minimum, and the 'scav pistol' title at 22px is off the type scale.
findings.fix: Set the card's right edge at x=1824 (5% margin). Set the title at 20px f-cond 600 tx-2, and the footer text at 16px tx-2. Keep the 56px hero number.

findings.what: The slot numbers 5-8 and 0 float with ghost weapon silhouettes and no frame, so they look unfinished and add clutter. The selected slot uses an amber border, which reads as the player's colour and not lime, and it is the only bordered slot. The slot numbers are 14px.
findings.fix: Draw the empty slots as one 8% opacity strip with no numbers, or hide slots 5-0 until they are filled. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot. Set the numbers at 16px tx-2.

findings.where: zone label 'packing floor' (x870-1046, y160-182) and 'extract 62m' banner (x906-1015, y47-73)
findings.what: 'packing floor' is wide-tracked, grey-on-grey monospace-style text, nearly invisible on the brown wall, so it fails the contrast floor. It also breaks the Barlow-only rule. The extract pill is the right teal but only 16px with a hard black fill, and its arrow floats separately below it.
findings.fix: Set 'packing floor' in f-cond 600 at 16px with .04em tracking and tx-1 at 70% on a --scrim chip. Attach the arrow inside the extract pill, at the left, and give the pill a 1px --extract border.

v.verdict: This is a clean, readable dark card with a clear lime action, but it has a stray lime tick, a heavy white close box, small type, no visible pad focus and wasted row space, so it reads as a competent template and not a polished AAA screen.

findings.what: A stray 36px lime dash sits on the card's top border. It looks like a clipped or misplaced accent and is the first odd thing the eye hits.
findings.fix: Delete it. If it is meant as a header accent, make it a 3px lime bar along the full card top at x 480-1440, or a 48x3 bar aligned to the title's left edge at x 521, y 157.

findings.where: take the pack button (x 1200-1399, y 810-866) and close x (x 1375-1423, y 175-221)
findings.what: The primary button has no visible pad focus ring or lift, so a couch player cannot tell what is selected. The close box has a heavy white 1px border and a thick x that competes with the title and does not match the guide's idle border (--ui-line-hi).
findings.fix: Give the button a 2px --acc-hover outer ring with 4px offset, or a 4px white inner border, as the focus state. Make the x box 40x40 with a --ui-line-hi border, a 2px --tx-2 glyph, and a lime border on focus. Align its right edge to the 1399 content margin.

findings.what: Each row is a 64px icon, a name and a far-right quantity, with about 600px of empty space between them. Most rows have no quantity at all, so the right column reads as ragged. The rows are visually flat and weakly differentiated.
findings.fix: Right-align every quantity in a 56px-wide column and show 'x1' on single items, or narrow the card to about 720px wide. Alternatively add a 16px tx-2 type tag (weapon, heal, throwable) right-aligned at x 1399. Tint the focused row with --ui-raised.

findings.what: The title looks about 28px, below the 32px --fs-title. It sits 40px from the close box with no relation to it, and the heading plus a full-width divider make the header feel cramped against the first row.
findings.fix: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1, vertically centred with the x box at y 198. Make the header row 72px tall, with the divider at y 270 and a 16px gap to the first row.

findings.what: The 3px bars are inset 24px from the icons and sit at 0.4 alpha for grey, so they read as list bullets and not as rarity bars. Bandage and smoke are grey and look unfinished next to green and blue.
findings.fix: Move each bar flush to the icon's right edge, at x 586, as a 3px full-row-height bar in the --r-* colour. Use --r-common #9da3a8 at full opacity for the grey rows.

findings.what: The teal-bordered chip is tiny, about 14px text. It uses the extract teal, which the guide reserves for extraction only. It floats alone at the screen edge and does not align to the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Use 16px f-cond in --tx-2 with a --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Move it to x 96, y 54 (the 5% margin) or drop it from this card.

findings.what: The footer has 57px under the button against 40px side padding, so the card feels bottom-heavy. The scrim is dark enough that the blurred 'enter raid' ghost text behind is faintly visible and distracting. The card is only about 50 percent of the screen width, against the owner's order of a card filling nearly the whole screen.
findings.fix: Set the bottom padding to 40px so the card ends at y 906. Raise the --scrim to a flat rgba(6,7,8,.80) with no visible ghost text. Either widen the card to about 90 percent or accept a narrower pick-list card and say so in the guide.

findings.what: Names are about 20px semibold in --tx-1 and quantities are the same size in --tx-2 with a lowercase x, so everything has the same weight. Nothing in the list stands out, even the two weapons.
findings.fix: Make weapon names 20px f-cond 700 with a 16px --tx-2 sub-label. Set quantities in 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1 right-aligned. Keep consumables at weight 600.

v.verdict: The contracts panel is now a clean, readable list and the header is tidy, but the map still has colliding, plate-less labels and the contract rows have no focus state or accent.

findings.where: map, cache labels around the foreman office, blast freezer and strongbox (about 8 'cache' strings)
findings.what: The duplicate cache labels were not collapsed. They still cluster and overlap leader lines, for example the four stacked at the blast freezer and 'cache cache' touching at (960,380). The map reads as noise.
findings.fix: Draw one cache icon per cluster with a 16px tx-2 'x4' count and no repeated words. Give the remaining labels a 4px padded --ui-void plate at 80% and a 12px minimum gap.

findings.where: map labels (packing floor, the sump, scrap line, chill row, strongbox, hot ground)
findings.what: Labels are still bare text on busy map geometry. Several are dim grey on grey (packing floor, scrap line, chill row) and sit below 4.5:1. 'hot ground' in red on the red zone is nearly lost. Pure white labels (foreman office, blast freezer) fight with the teal and red ones.
findings.fix: Set all labels to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking. Use tx-1 for interactive or locked places, tx-2 (#aaa498) for static areas, and keep teal for extract and red for danger. Put every label on a --ui-void plate at 80%. Drop pure white.

findings.what: No row is focused or selected. There is no --ui-raised fill and no lime bar, so a pad user cannot tell where focus is, and the panel has no accent at all. Rewards are tx-2 at about 16px, so the money you care about is the quietest element in each row.
findings.fix: Fill the first or focused row with --ui-raised and a 3px --acc left bar. Set the reward to 20px tx-1 with the progress count at 16px tx-2. Make the progress bar 4px, filled in --acc to the current count.

findings.where: map, player marker and waypoint cursor (530,450) and (571,440)
findings.what: The amber arrow in its disc and the small white crosshair are weak against the dense map. The crosshair for the waypoint cursor is tiny and the player is not the clear first read. The 'seal 0%' ring sits next to the crosshair and adds confusion.
findings.fix: Draw a 2px --acc reticle at 24px for the waypoint cursor. Scale the player marker to 40px with a 2px dark outline. Move 'seal 0%' 24px away from the cursor.

findings.what: '0 of 8 done' is still wordy. The 'contracts' title at about 24px does not match the 32px --fs-title used by 'cold storage', and the panel has an unexplained dead band below the last row.
findings.fix: Change the header to '0/8' at 16px tx-2. Set the title to 20px f-cond 700 and keep it distinct from the screen title. Trim the panel padding so the last row sits 24px from the bottom.

findings.what: 'sector map' sits as a floating grey label that does not baseline-align with the 32px title. The time is brighter than the subtitle and crowds the X with about 20px of space.
findings.fix: Baseline-align 'sector map' to 'cold storage' at 16px tx-2. Set the time to 16px tx-2 with a 24px gap before the 40x40 X.

findings.where: footer, 'click to set a waypoint' and 'surveyed 3%'
findings.what: Both are 16px tx-2 text at the left with no separation, so they read as one sentence. The 'm close' key chip on the right is the only styled element. The explanatory phrase counts as clutter.
findings.fix: Shorten to a key chip plus 'waypoint'. Separate 'surveyed 3%' with a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of spacing. Keep 'm close' at 16px.

findings.where: map frame and bottom-right edge, 'peddler' label and dot at (1085,874)
findings.what: The peddler dot and label sit against the map frame and are clipped by it. The map's left edge sits at 153px while the panel gutters are 24px, so the spacing is uneven.
findings.fix: Clamp markers and labels to 16px inside the map bounds. Align the map left edge to the 32px content gutter that the header uses.

v.verdict: The minimap now has a proper header-less frame and a tidy contracts bar, but the ping markers are still tiny, the left rank list is still cramped and unbordered, and the HUD type sizes are scattered, so it reads as a competent prototype and not a polished HUD.

findings.what: Ping and objective markers are 8-12px thin glyphs with no outline, so the cyan and white ones disappear into the white wall strips. The 'n' is a 12px orphan letter at the top edge, and the collapse chevron still sits on the map.
findings.fix: Make markers 16px with a 2px --ui-void outline and a 1.5s pulse ring. Replace 'n' with a 16px tick fixed in the top-left corner. Move the chevron into the contracts header row, or drop it. Dim the wall strips to --ui-line-hi so the markers read.

findings.what: The 8-row list is 14-15px type on a 18px pitch, and it takes the largest block of the left edge. The purple name for fbi_surveillance_van is an undeclared player tint. The panel has no border, and the cash column runs against its right edge.
findings.fix: Set rows to 16px on a 24px pitch with 8px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show only you plus the 3 nearest ranks by default and fold the rest under the chevron. Use --tx-1 for every name and highlight only 'you' with --acc. Keep money as '$'.

findings.what: The HUD uses about 8 sizes: 56 for the timer, 20 for the extract chip, 14 for slot numbers, 15 for ammo, 18 for the weapon name, 56 for '30', and 28 for '/ 60', plus the hp 100 bar text. Nothing falls on the 56/32/20/16/14 scale.
findings.fix: Set the timer to 32px f-cond 700. Keep ammo '30' as the single 56px hero. Set '/ 60' to 32px. Set slot numbers, 'compact smg' and the key hints to 16px, and the '4 items $1,560' footer to 16px --tx-2. Make the 'hp 100' text 20px.

findings.where: bottom-left hp bar and 'f1 controls' chip
findings.what: The hp bar is flat green on a bleed-to-edge position at x=24, with no dark track and a 28px label that dwarfs everything else. The 'f1 controls' chip floats at x=435, aligned with nothing. The left panel is at x=8.
findings.fix: Put one 48px left margin on hp, the leaderboard and the controls chip. Give the bar a --ui-panel track, a 4px radius and a 20px label. Pin the 'f1 controls' chip to the left end of the hotbar row at 16px.

findings.what: The selected slot has a thin amber border that reads as P1 colour rather than 'selected'. The slot numbers 3 and 5-8 float at 14px in mid-grey. The empty silhouettes are barely visible, so the bar looks broken. The 'f' hint badge on slot 4 collides with the ammo count.
findings.fix: Use a 3px --acc border and --ui-raised fill on the selected slot only. Draw empty slots as 1px --ui-line outlined 72px tiles at 45% silhouette opacity. Move the 'f' badge to the top-right corner, clear of the ammo number.

findings.what: The card is the strongest block on screen, which is right, but the weapon name is right-aligned and the 'b / i backpack' footer is left-aligned in the same 14px size. Both lines sit tight to the border, with about 8px of padding.
findings.fix: Set 16px padding on all sides. Align the footer and weapon name on a common 16px baseline, with the backpack hint left and the loot value right at 16px --tx-2. Keep the 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The teal 'extract 62m' pill sits right under the 56px timer and the sun icon, and the three items stack tightly with a small arrow at its base. The pill text is about 18px and not on the type scale.
findings.fix: Set the pill text to 20px and add a 8px gap under the timer. Drop the sun icon, or move it left of the clock. Make the arrow 16px with a 2px outline.

findings.where: in-world labels (you · sentry, the seal 0%, the forge, search crate)
findings.what: The label text varies between 14 and 18px, and there are four different treatments: black pill, bare cyan, bare amber, and yellow-key chip. The bare cyan and amber labels lose contrast against the map.
findings.fix: Use one label style: a 16px f-cond chip on a --scrim fill with a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use --tx-1 text, with a coloured 2px left bar for the type.

v.verdict: The in-world pings and the compact hud are readable, but none of the earlier fixes landed: the sentry still has two stacked labels, the scoreboard is still always open, and the ammo card, hp bar and hotbar still don't share a type scale or an edge.

findings.where: sentry labels at centre ("you · sentry · 17m" over "sentry r-46")
findings.what: The two labels are still stacked and touch each other. They sit on top of the sentry sprite, the ring and the crosshair. The orange tag has no plate and is hard to read against the red cone. The text is about 13px.
findings.fix: Show one plate: --ui-panel at 85% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px f-cond 600. Write "sentry r-46" in --tx-1 and "17m" in --tx-2. Put it 16px above the sentry's head, clear of the ring. Delete the second label.

findings.what: The board is always open at about 370x170px with eight rows of 14px text. It is the biggest block of text on the screen and it competes with the action. The purple name is the only colour and means nothing. The rows are tight (18px pitch). The 'you' row looks the same as the others. The title says 'bots' and shows a count of 7, which is noise.
findings.fix: Start it folded to the header line and open it on a key. If it stays open, cut it to the top 3 plus 'you'. Use 16px rows on a 24px pitch. Give the 'you' row a 3px --acc left bar and --tx-1 text. Set the other names in --tx-2. Use one text colour, or put a rarity glyph beside the purple name. Put the money values in tabular f-cond.

findings.what: The card crowds the screen corner. The gun name is about 22px, the 30/60 hero is about 60px, and "b / i backpack" and "4 items $1,560" are about 14px in dim grey. The card edge sits about 10px from the screen edge, not 24px. It has a different margin and corner treatment from the minimap card above it.
findings.fix: Set the card margin to 24px on the right and the bottom. Use 16px --tx-2 for the gun name. Keep 56px f-cond 800 for the hero number. Put the backpack hint and the item value on one 16px line with a minimum of 4.5:1 contrast. Use 4px corners and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the minimap and contracts card.

findings.where: hotbar slots 1–8 and the hp bar, bottom edge
findings.what: The slot numbers are 14px and low contrast. The empty slots 3 and 5–8 show faint weapon silhouettes that read as clutter. The selected slot has a thin amber border and the same fill as its neighbours. The hp bar is 405px wide and runs into the hotbar's left edge. It carries a 30px 'hp 100' label in a different font style from everything else. The 'f' badge on slot 4 is very small.
findings.fix: Make the selected slot's border 3px --acc on a --ui-raised fill. Dim empty slots to 40% opacity and remove the ghost silhouettes. Set slot numbers at 16px --tx-2. Make the hp bar 12px high with a 1px --ui-line-hi frame and an --ok fill. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 inline. Set the left margin to 24px. Leave 48px between the bar and slot 1.

findings.where: minimap column, contracts bar and extract pill (top right and top centre)
findings.what: The minimap has a white-bordered sharp frame, while the contracts bar below it is a different dark box with a chevron, and the scoreboard has a third frame style. The extract pill is teal, which is correct, but its text is about 15px and the pill is tight. The clock and sun icon float with no plate.
findings.fix: Use one panel recipe on every HUD box: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 8px padding. Set the extract pill text at 16px f-cond 600, with 8px by 16px padding. Put the clock on the same plate style or leave it bare, as the other counters are.

findings.where: world labels ("the seal 0%", "the forge", "e search crate", "fl controls")
findings.what: These use four different treatments: plain teal text, plain amber text, a lime-key chip on a dark plate, and a grey chip with an 'f1' key tag. The teal and amber text have no backing and sit on busy terrain. The 'fl controls' tag shows lower-case 'f1' that reads as 'fl'. The tag is left-aligned with the hp bar by accident.
findings.fix: Put all four on one plate: --ui-panel at 80%, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600. Use a 3px colour bar on the left of the plate for the station's colour. Use a single key chip style with --acc ink on lime. Set the controls tag in the bottom-left safe area at x=24px, 24px above the hp bar.

findings.what: There are five dense dark blocks at the edges (scoreboard, minimap, contracts, ammo card, hotbar) plus the centre ping. The type runs at about five different sizes (13, 14, 15, 22, 30, 60) with no shared scale.
findings.fix: Hold every label to 16px, every value to 20px, and one 56px hero number. Use the same 24px edge margin on all four corners.

v.verdict: The layout is sound, with ammo, hotbar and hp readable. The earlier fixes were not applied, so the corners still carry mismatched widgets: the 'pillager' card, the loose hp bar, a white-bar minimap, and a toast and p1 chip that do not match the other panels.

findings.what: The bar is a flat, full-bright green slab with 'hp 100' crammed in at about 32px. It sits at x=24, outside the 5% margin, and it is the loudest element in the corner. It uses a different style from the ammo panel and the hotbar. The 'hp' label and the number do not follow the 16/20 type scale.
findings.fix: Move it to x=54 and make the bar 12px tall in --ok on a --ui-line track. Put '100' at 20px f-cond 700 tx-1 and 'hp' at 16px tx-2 above the bar. Line its baseline up with the hotbar bottom (y~1055).

findings.what: The wall bars are near-white and compete with the player marker. They are the brightest thing in the corner. The map has no panel border and its edge is hard. The 'n' and the chevron are tiny. The contracts bar below it sits at 1px spacing and has different corner treatment.
findings.fix: Draw walls in --ui-line-hi. Fill the map with --ui-panel at 85% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Keep the player arrow as the only --acc element. Set a 8px gap to contracts and make both widgets the same width, radius and border.

findings.where: 'pillager' card (x13-170, y323-358) plus 'current pillager bots 3' bar (x8-367, y143-170)
findings.what: The left side has two stray widgets. The 'pillager' card duplicates the name already floating over the character. The debug-looking dropdown has a bright border and a different left edge (x=8) from everything else. Both sit outside the margin and look like dev UI.
findings.fix: Delete the 'pillager' card. Move the bots dropdown to x=54, y=54, with --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px label text. Fold it into the pause or settings menu if it is a dev control.

findings.where: 'p1' chip (x943-977, y612-642) and name tag 'pillager' (x937-983, y504-519)
findings.what: The chip is a heavy black box with an amber border, 20px or more of padding, and it floats about 40px below the feet. It is stronger than the name tag it belongs to. The name tag is about 12px, under the 16px floor, and has a pale blue fill that doesn't match anything else.
findings.fix: Make the p1 chip a 16px f-cond 700 label with 4px radius, 8px by 4px padding, --ui-panel fill and a 1px amber border, 8px under the feet ring. Set the name tag to 16px on --ui-panel with a tx-1 label.

findings.what: The toast is a centred black box at the bottom, over the hotbar's top edge. It clashes with the hotbar and the number keys 3 to 5. It has a hard border and a different radius from the other panels.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed at x=54, y~220. Use --ui-panel, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 and 8px by 16px padding. Give it a 3s fade.

findings.what: The panel is flush to the right edge (x=1910) and the bottom, at 10px margin, not 54. 'view backpack' and '3 items $1,220' at about 14px sit close to the border. The 12 / 24 hero is good, but the panel uses a heavier fill and border than the minimap.
findings.fix: Move the panel in to a right margin of 54px and bottom of 28px. Set the footer line to 16px tx-2. Use the same --ui-panel and 1px --ui-line-hi border as the minimap, with a 4px radius.

findings.what: The labels use three different colours (blue, orange, grey) and sizes with no backing. 'the seal 0%' is a thin blue on mid-grey at about 3:1 contrast. 'packing floor' is wide-tracked, about 20px, and low contrast.
findings.fix: Set all three to 16px f-cond 600 with a 1px dark outline or --scrim chip behind. Use tx-1 for the name and tx-2 for the percent. Keep the colours for the icons only.

findings.what: The chip has a green border and green text that matches no token, and its left edge sits at x=8, off the grid. It looks like a debug tag.
findings.fix: Restyle it as a 16px tx-2 label on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Put it at x=54, y=24, or show it only for 3s after an input device change.

v.verdict: This is the in-raid hud rather than the welcome pack card my earlier review covered, so none of that advice can be judged. As a hud it is readable and mostly lower case, but too many equal-weight boxes compete and the hp bar and the corner widgets are rough.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat green slab with 'hp 100' in big dark-on-green type. It sits flush against the screen edge, so it clips the safe margin. It is also the largest element on the screen and bigger than the ammo hero number, so the hierarchy is backwards.
findings.fix: Inset it to the 5% margin (x 96, y 1000). Make it 260x16 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show 'hp 100' as a 20px f-cond 600 label in --tx-1 above the bar. Leave 56px hero for ammo only.

findings.where: top-left stack (x 8-366, y 143-168) and 'pillager' tag (x 14-170, y 325-358)
findings.what: The 'current pillager bots 3' dropdown and the player tag use different widths, fills, borders and corner treatments. The dropdown reads like a debug control. The tag is a blue-lime tinted box with a green bar, while the dropdown is near-black with a chevron. They look like two different design systems and they float apart with no shared left edge.
findings.fix: Put both on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Share a left edge at x 96. Set both to 16px f-cond 600 text. Put the player tag in the bottom-left cluster with the hp bar, in amber for P1 or cyan for P2. Move the bots control out of the raid hud.

findings.where: minimap (x 1603-1901, y 19-318) and contracts row (x 1603-1901, y 327-362)
findings.what: The minimap sits at the screen edge with about 19px of margin and a hard white-on-black wall pattern with no frame treatment. The contracts row is a different dark fill with a bright chevron. The top-right stack is two unrelated panels, and the minimap's white wall bars are the loudest high-contrast thing on screen.
findings.fix: Inset the stack to x 1776 with a 48px margin. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Tone the wall bars down to --ui-line-hi. Make the contracts row the same --ui-panel and height as the other panels, with a 16px label.

findings.what: The card is clipped almost to the right edge at x 1910, which is 10px of margin. The '12 / 24' hero number is good, but 'scav pistol' at 20px and the 14px footer 'b / i backpack' and '2 items $120' are cramped into the card. The 14px fine print sits below the 16px floor for anything read.
findings.fix: Inset the card to x 1776 with the same 48px right margin. Raise the footer to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Keep the 56px hero. Increase the padding to 16px all round.

findings.what: Slot 1 has a thick amber outline and slot 2 is a dark tile, but slots 3 to 0 are faint ghost icons with numbers floating on the map and no tile fill. The row has no shared panel, so it dissolves into the ground. Slot 1 is the only focus, in amber, which breaks the rule that lime means selected. The row also runs off the bottom edge, with tiles ending at y 1058.
findings.fix: Give all 10 slots a 64x64 --ui-panel tile with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and an 8px gap. Raise the row to y 984-1048 so it clears the bottom margin. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot instead of amber. Show the key number at 16px in --tx-2.

findings.where: 'in pillager's party' tooltip (x 885-1035, y 894-929) and 'pillager · sentry r-57 · 17m' label (x 1043-1217, y 446-477)
findings.what: The two labels use tiny 14-16px text in black pills with different padding and no border. 'in pillager's party' floats in mid-screen above the hotbar and explains what the player already knows, which is clutter.
findings.fix: Remove the party tooltip, or show it once at spawn. Make the world label 16px f-cond 600 on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 8px padding and 4px radius.

findings.where: top-centre timer and extract chip (x 884-1030, y 12-75) and 'f1 controls' chip (x 436-537, y 929-952)
findings.what: The timer '9:00' is the only hero-sized element up top, but the teal 'extract 62m' chip is smaller than the 16px floor. The 'f1 controls' hint is 16px with a grey key cap and sits low-contrast against the grey wall, so it is easy to miss. The brief wants it folded mid-bottom left, and it sits at x 436, close but not aligned with the hotbar or the hp bar.
findings.fix: Set the extract chip to 16px f-cond 600 with 8px padding and a 1px --extract border. Put the controls hint on --ui-panel and align it to the hp bar's left edge at x 96, 16px above the hotbar.

findings.where: world labels ('the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'packing floor', x 870-1690)
findings.what: 'packing floor' uses wide letter-spaced grey text that reads as a different font from the rest. The forge and seal labels are in amber and blue with no consistent rule, and they sit on busy ground with no backing. This is a third style on top of the pills.
findings.fix: Set all three to 16px f-cond 600 with +.04em tracking and a 1px dark outline or a --scrim pill behind. Use --tx-1 for place names. Reserve colour for state only, such as the seal percentage.

v.verdict: The window frame, title row and contracts list are clean and consistent, but the map still has about 10 repeated 'cache' labels, labels with no plates, tiny map type, and a contracts panel that has no focus row and no hero.

findings.where: map, cache labels (foreman office, blast freezer, top centre, sump)
findings.what: About 10 'cache' strings are scattered around the map. They overlap thin leader lines and clump into a cluster, e.g. 'cache cache / cache' beside blast freezer. This is clutter, and the earlier advice was not followed.
findings.fix: Draw one cache glyph per cluster with a 16px tx-2 'x3' count and no repeated words. Keep a 12px minimum gap between any two labels and delete the leader lines.

findings.where: map labels (packing floor, the sump, scrap line, chill row, strongbox, hot ground, the long dock)
findings.what: The labels sit directly on map linework with no plate. Grey tx-2 text on the grey room fills is low contrast ('packing floor', 'scrap line', 'chill row'). The labels are about 14px against the 16px minimum. Mixed pure white and grey, and 'hot ground' red on a red zone, are hard to read.
findings.fix: Set every label to 16px f-cond 600 +.04em on a 4px-padded --ui-void plate at 80%. Use tx-1 for places the player can act on, tx-2 (#aaa498) for static areas, and red or teal only for danger or extract. Drop pure white.

findings.what: All 8 rows have identical weight with no focused or first-row state. The player can't see where pad focus is. There is no lime anywhere in the panel. Rewards ($870) and counts (0/2) are tiny 16px at the right edge and stacked, so the reward doesn't read as the value. The 2px progress rules are almost invisible.
findings.fix: Fill the focused row with --ui-raised and a 3px --acc left bar. Set the reward to 20px tx-1 and the count to 16px tx-2. Make the progress bar 4px with --acc filling to the current count. Put the row divider on --ui-line.

findings.where: map, player marker and waypoint cursor (533,450) and (571,440)
findings.what: The amber player marker is a small arrow in a dim disc and is easy to lose among the extract rings. The white waypoint reticle is a thin 2px glyph close to 'seal 0%' and to the marker itself, so they crowd together.
findings.fix: Draw the player marker at 40px with a 2px dark outline. Draw the waypoint reticle as a 24px --acc ring. Move 'seal 0%' 24px away from the cursor and set it in 16px tx-2.

findings.where: header row: 'cold storage', 'sector map', '6pm · clear', close x
findings.what: The title (32px) is fine. 'sector map' is a floating grey subtitle on the baseline. '6pm · clear' is a heavy 24px in tx-1, so it competes with the title. The x button is a good 56px box, but it is the only boxed element and has no focus colour.
findings.fix: Set '6pm · clear' to 16px tx-2. Merge 'sector map' into a 16px tx-2 label with 16px spacing from the title. Give the x a 2px --acc border on focus.

findings.what: 'contracts' is about 22px, 'carry out servo actuator' is about 22px and 'destroy sentries' is about 22px. The header and row names are nearly the same size and weight, so the header doesn't stand out. '0 of 8 done' is also a counting sentence.
findings.fix: Set the header to 20px f-cond 700 tx-1 with a 1px --ui-line rule below it. Set the row names to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 (tx-1 when focused). Change '0 of 8 done' to '0/8' at 16px tx-2.

findings.where: footer: 'click to set a waypoint', 'surveyed 3%', 'm close'
findings.what: The 'm' key chip is lime and is the strongest accent on the screen, but it sits in the far bottom right at 16px, which pulls the eye to a minor action. 'click to set a waypoint' and 'surveyed 3%' are at the same weight, so nothing is a hero. The left text is about 14px and tight to the divider.
findings.fix: Set the legend to 16px tx-2 with 24px between items. Keep the chip but match its height to the 16px text. Raise 'surveyed 3%' to a 20px tx-1 stat so the map has one number.

findings.where: map frame and contracts panel gutters
findings.what: The map frame has a thick 2px light grey border while the contracts panel has a faint 1px edge, so the two columns read as different systems. The gap is 28px, off the 8px grid. The map and contracts panel end at y=919, but the contracts last row sits 12px above the bottom with a cramped bottom padding.
findings.fix: Give both columns a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill at --rad 4px. Use a 32px gutter between them. Set 24px bottom padding in the contracts panel.

v.verdict: The ammo hero and the hotbar read well, but the earlier minimap, type-scale and left-edge advice was mostly not applied, so the HUD still looks like several unrelated widgets.

findings.what: The markers are still tiny (about 8-10px) and sit on bright white wall strips, so the player, extract and contract icons barely read. The stray 'n' is still there at 11px, and the chevron is still crammed into the corner of the map.
findings.fix: Enlarge the markers to 16px with a 2px --ui-void outline. Dim the wall strips to --ui-line-hi at about 60% opacity. Replace 'n' with a 16px tick in the top-left corner. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius to the map frame.

findings.what: The panel is a collapsed bar with a 14px bold white label that looks like a dropdown. The label is wordy and a different style from the contracts bar. It carries no ranks and no 'you' highlight, so the list gives no information until it is opened.
findings.fix: Rename it 'ranks' or 'bots 7' at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2. Use the same panel style as 'contracts 0/8': --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 40px height. Add a lime 'you #n' on the right. Set the left margin to 48px.

findings.what: Sizes are still scattered. The timer is about 28px, 'extract 62m' about 16px, the hp number about 32px bold, the ammo '30' is 56px, and '/ 60' about 36px. The hp label is a different size and weight from the timer, so there are too many bold elements and no clear order.
findings.fix: Use 56px for ammo only. Set the timer, '/ 60' and 'hp 100' all to 32px f-cond 700 in --tx-1. Set 'compact smg', the key hints, 'f1 controls', the slot numbers and 'b / i backpack' to 16px. Set '4 items $1,560' to 16px in --tx-2.

findings.what: The hp bar is a flat mid-green fill with no track. The bar bleeds off the screen edge at x=24 and y=1040 and sits on the busy map. 'hp 100' is large bold text stamped over the bar, with a green-on-white contrast of about 2.5:1.
findings.fix: Set the bar to 24px tall with a --ui-panel track, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, inset 48px from the left and 48px from the bottom. Put the number in --tx-1 at 20px inside the bar with a 2px --ui-void shadow. Use --ok for the fill.

findings.what: The selected slot uses a thin amber border, which reads as the P1 colour instead of the lime selection colour. The empty slots 3 and 5-8 are only faint ghost gun silhouettes with floating numbers and no tile. 'f1 controls' floats above the bar and is not aligned with the slots or with hp. The 'f' badge is stuck on the corner of slot 4 beside the ammo count.
findings.fix: Draw the selected slot with a 3px --acc border and a --ui-raised fill. Draw the empty slots as 1px --ui-line tiles at 72px, 45% opacity. Put the 'f1 controls' chip at x=48 and level with the hotbar at 16px. Move the 'f' badge to the top-right corner of its slot.

findings.where: world labels ('the seal 0%', 'the forge', 'you · sentry r-46 · 13m')
findings.what: Each label is styled differently: cyan text with no backing, amber text with no backing, and a dark pill with a white label. The unbacked text is nearly unreadable on the grey and purple ground.
findings.fix: Put every world label in one 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1 pill with a --ui-panel fill at 85% opacity and a 4px radius. Give it a 3px left bar in its meaning colour: --extract for the seal, --warn for the forge.

findings.what: The timer and its icon float with no panel, over a busy wall. The teal 'extract 62m' pill is a different shape from the minimap bars. The small teal arrow under it is about 8px and easy to miss.
findings.fix: Place the timer in a --ui-panel plate with a 4px radius, matching the extract pill. Increase the arrow to 16px and make the pill the same 40px height as the 'contracts' bar.

findings.what: The ammo block is the best-organised element, but it is tight. 'b / i backpack' and '4 items $1,560' sit 8px from the edges at 14px, and the panel has a different outline weight from the minimap bars. It also nearly touches the right and bottom screen edges.
findings.fix: Add 16px inner padding and a 48px screen margin. Set the footer to 16px with the key hint in --tx-2 and '$1,560' in --tx-1. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border on all HUD panels.

v.verdict: The HUD is much calmer than before: the folded bot list and contracts bar, the single sentry plate and the quiet ammo card all read cleanly. The panels, hp bar and slot styling are still not on one recipe, and the 56px hero number and the in-world labels need tuning.

findings.what: The bar is a flat green block with 'hp 100' in oversized, blurry condensed type. It sits 24px from the left, runs off the bottom edge with no margin, and has no frame. It is the only HUD element not on the panel recipe, and its fill is brighter than anything else on screen.
findings.fix: Make the bar 12px high with a 1px --ui-line-hi frame and an --ok fill. Put it 24px above the bottom edge and 48px left of slot 1. Set 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 20px f-cond 700 --tx-1, inline.

findings.what: The selected slot (2) has a thin amber border, which breaks the rule that P1 is amber and lime means selected. Slot 3 and slots 5–0 float as bare numbers with ghost silhouettes, and the slot spacing is uneven (the gap between 2 and 4 is empty). Slot numbers are dim and low contrast.
findings.fix: Draw all 8 slots as 100px tiles on a 16px pitch. Use --ui-panel fill and a 1px --ui-line-hi border. The selected slot gets a 3px --acc border on --ui-raised. Empty slots sit at 40% opacity with no silhouettes. Set numbers at 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The '30 / 60' hero is correct, but the gun name is a bright tx-1 at about 22px and competes with it. 'b / i backpack' and '4 items $1,560' at 14px --tx-2 are below the 16px floor. The card is 14px from the right edge and 8px from the bottom, so it is cramped against the screen edge, and its corners and border don't match the minimap card.
findings.fix: Set the margin to 24px right and 24px bottom. Set the gun name to 16px --tx-2. Set the footer line to 16px with at least 4.5:1 contrast. Use a 4px radius and a 1px --ui-line-hi border to match the minimap card.

findings.where: in-world labels: 'you · sentry r-46 · 17m' and 'search crate'
findings.what: The sentry plate stacks three facts in one string with dots, and its tail overlaps the sentry's head and ring. The 'search crate' prompt has a lime key chip and a flat black plate with different padding, and it sits tight against the player sprite. Both plates are about 14px type.
findings.fix: Show 'sentry r-46' in --tx-1 and '17m' in --tx-2, and drop 'you'. Put the plate 16px above the ring. Set both plates to 16px f-cond 600 on --ui-panel at 85%, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, and 8px by 4px padding.

findings.where: top-left bot list, top-right contracts bar, and extract pill
findings.what: The bot list and contracts bars are folded and match each other, which is good, but they use different widths (360px vs 300px) and different edge margins (8px vs 20px). The extract pill is teal with a bright fill, and the clock sits bare above it. Nothing aligns to a common 24px margin.
findings.fix: Use one margin of 24px (48px at 5% safe area) for the bot list, minimap and contracts. Give the extract pill 8px by 16px padding, --ui-panel fill and a 1px --extract border. Put the clock on the same plate or move it into the pill.

findings.what: Both are bare coloured text floating on the map with no plate. 'the seal' is blue at about 14px and 'the forge' is amber, and the amber collides with the rarity gold and P1 colours. Neither has enough contrast against the busy tiles.
findings.fix: Set both at 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-1 on the standard --ui-panel 85% plate. Colour only a 3px left bar for the station type, and use --tx-2 for the percentage.

findings.what: The hint is a tiny 14px chip at the left edge that floats above the hp bar, with no alignment to the hotbar or the hp margin. The grey key chip and the label use different fills.
findings.fix: Put it on the standard plate at 16px, left-aligned to the 24px margin and centred on the hotbar's vertical line, or fold it into the hp row's top edge, with 16px --tx-2 text.

v.verdict: The ammo card with its 56px hero number is the strongest element and reads well, but the earlier cleanup was not done. The pillager card, bots panel and hp bar are all still there, and the controls list, bots panel and toast crowd the left side.

findings.what: The advice from last time was not applied. 'hp 100' is oversized, runs together as one string, and is crammed into a thick bar flush against the screen edge. It is the loudest element in the corner and competes with the ammo hero number.
findings.fix: Inset the bar to x=54. Make it 12px tall in --ok on a --ui-line track. Set '100' at 20px f-cond 700 tx-1 and 'hp' at 16px tx-2, both above the bar. Line the baseline up with the hotbar bottom, at about y=1055.

findings.where: left column: bots panel (x8-367, y143-260), 'pillager' card (x13-170, y325-360), controls list (x16-328, y457-803)
findings.what: Three separate boxes with different widths, borders and left edges stack up to about 660px of the left side. The bots panel is a dev or debug control. The pillager card duplicates the name tag and hp already on screen. The full controls list is open, although the spec says it starts folded to one short line, mid-bottom left.
findings.fix: Delete the pillager card. Move the bots panel into pause or settings. Fold the controls list to one 16px line ('f1 controls') at x=54, y~1000, and open it only on F1. Put every remaining widget at x=54 with 1px --ui-line-hi, --ui-panel and a 4px radius.

findings.where: controls list text (x28-320, y475-780) and bots rows (x16-347, y190-250)
findings.what: Key caps and labels are about 14px, which is too small for a couch at 1080. The muted rows ('crouchspammer', 'dead' rows) are dim grey on a busy map. Section labels like 'move' and 'fight' are almost invisible.
findings.fix: Set all text to a minimum of 16px f-cond 600. Use tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better on --ui-panel at 94% opacity. Section labels go in tx-1 at 16px with a 1px --ui-line divider above.

findings.what: The minimap that the previous review referred to is not in this shot. In its place is a contracts dropdown that touches the edge: its right margin is about 17px, against 54px elsewhere. It has a different radius and border from the other panels.
findings.fix: Move it to x=1866 right edge (54px margin, y=54). Use --ui-panel, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, with 16px f-cond 600 text and a 16px chevron in tx-2.

findings.what: The toast sits in the middle of the play space, near the hotbar and the extraction area. It uses a pure black fill and sans text in a different style from the other pills. It has no border and reads as a generic tooltip.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed at x=54, y~220. Use --ui-panel, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 and 8px by 16px padding. Give it a 3s fade.

findings.what: Five different pill styles: amber 'concealed', teal 'in cover', amber contract hint, teal 'extraction a available', and teal 'extract 52m'. Their sizes, fills, border weights and font sizes (16 to 22px) all vary. 'extraction a available' also looks like a typo, and the contract hint is a sentence that explains instead of showing.
findings.fix: Use one pill spec: 16px f-cond 600, 4px radius, 8px by 4px padding, --ui-panel fill, 1px border in the status colour. Fix the copy to 'extraction available'. Cut the hint to 'contract item nearby'. Merge 'extraction available' into the 'extract 52m' banner at the top.

findings.what: The selected slot 1 has a heavy amber border, but amber is the player colour. The guide says lime means 'selected', so this contradicts it. Slot 3 (the rifle) is lit as well, so two slots read as selected. Slot numbers 2 and 4-0 float in space with no slot frames.
findings.fix: Use a 2px --acc border on the active slot only. Give the empty slots 1px --ui-line frames of 56px at a 64px pitch. Show the number at 16px tx-2 in the top-left of each frame.

findings.where: world name tags (x1060-1105, y538-552) and p1 marker
findings.what: The 'pillager' tag at 12 to 14px is tiny. The enemy tags ('sentry t-13', 'buildtdifferentbrick') have different fill and colour treatments, and the name 'buildtdifferentbrick' reads as a typo. The player's tag is not clearly in amber, which breaks the P1 colour rule.
findings.fix: Set all tags to 16px f-cond 700 on --ui-panel at 85% with a 4px radius. Use an amber 1px border for P1 and --danger for hostile. Put the tags 8px above the head.

v.verdict: The lime button and amber wordmark make a clear centre, but the toast sits on top of the key-hint row, the type is small and low in contrast, and the wordmark's gradient and glow break the flat style guide.

findings.where: bottom centre: 'in pillager's party · ascend at the lift to join' toast (x 799-1121, y 1004-1040) over the key-hint row (y 1030-1055)
findings.what: The toast covers the hint row. 'mouse', 'lmb' and 'e' are cut in half and 'aim', 'fire' and 'search' are hidden. This is a clear overlap and clipping bug.
