findings.fix: Move the toast to y 940-980, 16px above the hint row. Give it a --ui-panel fill, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Keep the hint row at y 1010-1050 and make sure nothing draws over it. Use one 64px-tall bottom band for both.

findings.what: The hint labels ('move', 'aim', 'fire', 'search', 'controls') are dim grey at about 16px with no panel behind them. They are hard to read from a couch and the row looks crowded at the bottom edge. The hint row also repeats the controls list.
findings.fix: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 (#aaa498) and the key caps to --tx-1 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 24px gap between pairs. Lift the row to y 1000-1040 so it clears the 5% margin (54px). Alternatively remove the row and rely on the F1 controls.

findings.what: The wordmark has an amber-to-orange gradient and a glow. The guide bans gradient washes. Amber also reads as a second accent beside the lime button, and the two sit 24° apart in hue. P2 should read cyan, and the screen gives no sign of which player this is.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1, or flat --r-gold #ffc72e with no gradient or shadow. Add a 'player 2' tag in --extract or cyan, 16px f-cond 600, at x 96, y 96. Keep the wordmark at 96px f-cond 800.

findings.where: 'player 2 window' (x 909-1010, y 578-594) under the main button
findings.what: This is a 14px grey label of unclear meaning, jammed 12px under the button. It reads as a caption for the button, not as a status.
findings.fix: Remove it from under the button and move it to the top-left 'player 2' tag. If it must stay, make it 16px --tx-2 with 24px of space above and below.

findings.what: The 'saves' label and the row text are about 16px, and the 'saves' label is dim. The row text 'pillager new' and '0 raids · $900 · 0 xp' is small against the 56px-tall primary button above. The selected save row has a thin lime outline, and the name field and two buttons below are the same weight, so the section reads as a stack of similar boxes.
findings.fix: Raise the row text to 20px f-cond 600 and make the row 64px tall with a --ui-raised fill. Keep the lime 2px border for the selected row only. Set the 'saves' label to 16px in --tx-2 with a 16px gap to the row. Make 'change name' and 'create a new save' --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use an 8px gap and equal 56px heights for the whole row.

findings.what: The button is good and clearly primary. However, 20px dark text on a 558px lime bar is wide and plain, and the tagline above it ('ascend. pillage. extract.') is 18px muted and close to the wordmark.
findings.fix: Make the button 480px wide and 64px tall, with 24px f-cond 800 text. Leave 24px between the tagline and the button, and 32px between the wordmark and the tagline.

findings.where: top corners: 'keyboard' badge (x 912-1007, y 6-31), 'go fullscreen' and 'settings' (x 1611-1823, y 33-81)
findings.what: The teal 'keyboard' badge is a third accent colour sitting on the top edge, 6px from the screen edge. The two top-right buttons are inset to x 1823, which is not on the 96px margin used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Move the device badge to x 96, y 54 as a 16px --tx-2 label, with no teal border. Put the two buttons at x 1824 right edge with 56px height and 16px text, and align their top to y 54.

findings.what: The stamp is 12px and low in contrast. It also sits in the bottom row with the hints, which makes that row crowded. The empty field above y 740 is flat black with no depth.
findings.fix: Set the stamp to 14px --tx-2 at x 96, y 1026, and keep it clear of the hints. Add a subtle 6% vignette or a faint ground texture behind the centre column so the screen looks like this game.

v.verdict: This is a clean, calm column menu with a clear lime focus bar, but the picture is a title screen rather than the raid HUD I reviewed before. The orange-gold gradient wordmark ignores the lime accent, an error banner with a loud lime button splits the hierarchy, and the saves block is cramped and unstructured.

findings.where: error banner (x681-1239, y637-703) with 'retry' button (x1079-1229, y646-694)
findings.what: A two-line explaining sentence sits between the mode list and the saves block. Its filled lime retry button is the loudest object on screen and outranks the focused '2 player co-op' row. Lime means 'selected', not a secondary action on an error.
findings.fix: Cut the copy to one 16px line, e.g. 'player 2 is in a raid in the other window'. Make retry an outlined 1px --ui-line-hi button in tx-1, 32px tall, so lime stays on the focus bar only. Keep the 3px --danger left bar. Move the banner out of the list flow, to y~860 under the saves block, or make it a toast at top-centre.

findings.what: The title is an orange-gold gradient with a drop shadow. The style guide bans gradient washes, and it is off-palette: it sits right next to lime and reads as rarity gold. It is also the boldest element, while the guide wants boldness on the title or the main action, not both. It looks like a template logo, not a game identity.
findings.fix: Fill it with flat --tx-1 #efe9dc, or flat --acc at most, with no gradient and no shadow. Keep 800 weight and move it to the 56px hero size or slightly larger. Drop the tagline to 16px tx-2 with 16px (--sp-2) spacing under it.

findings.what: There are two stacked lime-bordered or lime-text elements. 'pillager new' has a lime border and lime text at the same time as the focused '2 player' row, so focus is ambiguous. The bottom row mixes an input-looking 'pillager' field with 'change name' and 'create a new save' at different widths. The 'saves' label is 14px and low contrast, and the row is crowded: 8px gaps and a 40px control height.
findings.fix: Use one lime focus at a time. Make idle rows a 1px --ui-line-hi border with tx-1 text. Put 'saves' at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 with 16px above the first row. Make the rows 56px high like the mode buttons. Move 'change name' and 'create a new save' to the right-aligned actions of the selected save row, or put them under a 1px --ui-line divider with 16px gaps.

findings.what: The four modes are the same weight and the same box. '2 player arcade demo' and '1 player arcade demo' are walk-up/party modes sitting at the same level as the career modes. '(same machine)' is a stray parenthetical. The primary action '1 player' is not distinguished from the others.
findings.fix: Make '1 player' the only 20px 700 row with the --ui-raised fill. Put the arcade demos under a 16px 'demo' label in tx-2 with a 24px gap. Drop '(same machine)', or show it as a 16px tx-2 sub-label inside the row. Give the focus lime left bar 4px wide and spaced evenly.

findings.what: The right margin is about 97px and the top margin is 33px. That is not the 5% margin, and it does not line up with the version stamp at x97. The 16px text is small and its weight does not match the mode buttons.
findings.fix: Set the margin to 54px: right edge at x=1866, top y=54. Make the buttons 40px high with 16px f-cond 600 tx-1. Align the left version stamp to x=54 as well.

findings.where: bottom key legend (x726-1193, y1030-1056) and version stamp (x97-235, y1041-1054)
findings.what: The legend is a loose row of keycaps at about 16px with a dim tx-2 label. It is too far from the content and reads as a generic template. The version stamp is about 12px and below the 14px fine-print floor.
findings.fix: Make the legend 16px f-cond 600, with keycaps in a 1px --ui-line-hi border, and place it at y~1010 so the bottom margin is 54px. Make the version stamp 14px f-body 500 tx-2 at x=54, y=1026.

findings.what: The 558px column floats in a big empty black vignette. There is no art, no background scene and no player colours, so it looks like a generic launcher. Nothing says top-down extraction or ARC Raiders x Zero Sievert.
findings.fix: Put a dimmed 20%-opacity raid screenshot or key art behind the --scrim at .80. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and a hero-number or last-run strip on the right, in the same Barlow Condensed, at x=1000-1240 as the save's stats (sp, raids). Keep the title block aligned at 54px on the left.

v.verdict: The toast is gone and the screen is cleaner, but it still reads as a generic centred template: the gradient wordmark, the tiny saves rows, the loose hint row and the hidden player 2 identity are all unchanged.

findings.what: The wordmark still has an orange-to-gold gradient with a drop shadow. The guide bans gradient washes, and the amber is the old accent colour that reads like P1. Nothing marks this as player 2's screen, because the top-left is empty and only a small 'keyboard' pill sits at the top centre.
findings.fix: Make the wordmark flat --tx-1 or flat --r-gold #ffc72e, with no gradient or shadow, at 96px f-cond 800. Add a 'player 2' tag in cyan, 16px f-cond 600, at x 96, y 96. Drop the 'keyboard' pill to 16px --tx-2, or fold it into that tag.

findings.what: The row text is about 15px and the save row is only 42px tall. The 'pillager new' name is lime text, which the guide reserves for focus. The 'saves' label is dim, under 16px and has no space above it. The name field and the two buttons are three identical outlined boxes, so none of them stands out.
findings.fix: Make the save row 64px tall with a --ui-raised fill and 20px f-cond 600 text. Keep the 2px lime border as the only focus cue and set the name in --tx-1. Make the 'saves' label 16px --tx-2 with a 16px gap to the row. Make 'change name' and 'create a new save' 56px tall, 16px label type, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, with an 8px gap.

findings.what: The hint row sits in the bottom 5% margin (54px) and uses a mix of sizes. The labels are about 15px in dim grey and the key caps are 12px, below the 16px minimum. The row repeats what F1 already opens, and it is clutter on a title screen.
findings.fix: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 with --tx-1 key caps and a 24px gap between pairs. Move the row up to y 1000-1040. Alternatively remove it and keep only 'f1 controls'.

findings.what: The label is 14px and sits 11px under the lime button, where it reads as a stray caption on the primary action. It is not a button and does not say what it is.
findings.fix: Move it to the top-left 'player 2' tag. If it has to stay here, set it at 16px --tx-2 with 24px of space above and below.

findings.what: The tagline is 18px in dim grey, 28px from the wordmark and 24px from the button. It adds a third text voice that does not match the 5-size scale.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Use 16px above it and 24px below it. Or delete it.

findings.what: The buttons are 48px tall and have an idle white border that is brighter than the other buttons on the screen. 'keyboard' at top centre uses a different pill style, and the three controls do not align on a common baseline.
findings.fix: Use the 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 56px height to match the saves buttons. Put all top controls on y 48-104 with 16px type. Align the right edge to the 5% margin at x 1824.

findings.what: The stamp is about 13px and is bolded condensed type, under the 14px fine minimum. It sits at x 97, which does not line up with the content column, and its baseline is a few pixels off the hint row.
findings.fix: Set it to 14px f-body 500 in --tx-2. Align it to x 96 and to the same baseline as the hint row (y 1041).

findings.what: The block is a narrow 558px column in the middle with about 360px of empty void above the wordmark and 300px below the saves. There is no world art or backdrop, so it feels like a generic template and not like Pillagers.
findings.fix: Put a darkened, blurred raid-scene backdrop behind the menu at about 30% opacity. Keep the column at 560px. Set the wordmark block at y 280-440 and tie the spacing to the 8px grid.

v.verdict: This is a raid HUD, not the title screen I reviewed before, so there is nothing earlier to compare it with. The HUD reads clearly and the ammo number is a strong hero. It has several panel styles, a bottom toast that breaks the one-place rule, and an explaining sentence.

findings.where: 'pillager joined' toast (x874-1045, y838-884), bottom-centre above the hotbar
findings.what: The one-place rule says alerts go in the top-centre banner and every other line goes in the left feed. This line sits at bottom-centre, floats over the hotbar zone and is drawn in a different panel style (grey fill, 20px). It also covers the map where the player looks.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed stack at x=16, above the contract line, as a 16px tx-1 row on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Delete the bottom-centre toast position.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x16-409, y778-805)
findings.what: It is an explaining sentence and a clutter defect. The second clause tells the player something the glow already shows. The panel also differs from the other feed lines in its 3px gold edge, its icon and its padding.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 16px f-cond 600 tx-1. Keep the 3px --r-gold bar but use the same panel as the other feed rows: --ui-panel, 4px radius, 8px padding.

findings.what: It is the largest, densest block on screen and it competes with the hero ammo number. It holds a header, a '0' count, three rows of $ amounts with 'dead' tags, and a '0 out · 3 dead' footer, all at 14-16px with a thin tx-2 grey that is hard to read over the map. The 'dead' word repeats three times. Its chevron is tiny, and its header is a different size from the 'contracts 0/8' header opposite it.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 20px line 'bots 0' by default, with the list opening on focus. If the rows stay, drop 'dead' for a --danger 8px dot, use 16px minimum and tx-1 for the names, and match the 'contracts' header (same height, same 16px 600 label).

findings.what: Slot 1 has a lime/amber focus frame and slot 3 has a big icon. Slots 2 and 4-8 and 0 are bare numerals floating over a pale ghost weapon silhouette on the orange floor, so the row has no clear edge. The numerals are around 12px, which is below the 16px floor. The slot sizes, 104 against empty, are inconsistent.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 72px square on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border, 8px gaps, and 16px numerals. Show the ghost icons at 30% opacity inside the slots only. The focused slot gets the 2px --acc border.

findings.what: The 56px+ '25' is a good hero, but '/ 24' sits in the same line in a lighter tone and reads as a fraction. That makes 25 look larger than the reserve, which is confusing. 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' are 14px grey on a dark map and are hard to read. The panel also touches the screen edge: its right edge is at x=1912, not the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Show the magazine as the hero at 56px, and the reserve as a 20px tx-2 number to its right, with no slash. Raise the footer to 16px tx-2 with at least 4.5:1 contrast. Inset the panel to x=1866 right and y=1026 bottom.

findings.where: hp bar and status icons (x24-430, y945-1070)
findings.what: The hp bar is an unrounded, fully saturated green slab with a 100 in text that crowds the left edge. It is the loudest flat fill on the screen and it uses a third bar style next to the thin pillager bar at the top. The two round status icons above it, amber and teal, are unlabeled and too close to the bar.
findings.fix: Make the bar 12px tall with a 4px radius, on a --ui-panel track with 1px --ui-line, filled with --ok. Put 'hp 100' at 20px f-cond 700 above it, aligned to x=54. Leave 16px between the icons and the bar.

findings.where: top-left 'pillager' bar (x16-170, y325-360) and nameplate at (1060-1102, y538-551)
findings.what: The player's name shows twice with no tie between the two. The top-left box is a plain label with a green line, the same bar style as the hp bar but a different weight. It floats over a wall with no panel and has weak contrast.
findings.fix: Delete the top-left name bar, because hp is already bottom-left. Keep only the world nameplate, or merge the name into the hp block.

findings.where: margins and small chrome: 'keyboard' tag (x10-105, y7-31), 'contracts 0/8' (x1605-1903), 'f1 controls' (x448-538, y931-955)
findings.what: Corner elements sit at 8-16px from the edge instead of a consistent 5% margin (about 54px at 1080). The 'keyboard' tag uses green-on-dark mono-style type that matches nothing else. 'f1 controls' is 16px tx-2 over a busy map with only a faint chip.
findings.fix: Set the HUD margin to 54px for every corner block. Restyle 'keyboard' as a 16px tx-2 label with no border. Put 'f1 controls' on a --ui-panel chip with 1px --ui-line-hi and tx-1 text.

v.verdict: A big lime button and a gold wordmark sit in the middle of a dark screen. The earlier advice was not followed, and the screen is still small, sparse and generic, with nothing marking it as player 2's.

findings.what: The wordmark still has an orange-gold gradient and a drop shadow, which the guide bans. It is the same gold as the old amber, so it competes with the lime button. It is only about 80px tall and has no player 2 identity.
findings.fix: Make it flat --tx-1, or flat --r-gold #ffc72e, with no gradient or shadow. Use 96px f-cond 800. Add a cyan 'player 2' tag at 16px f-cond 600 at x 96, y 96, or move the 'keyboard' pill there.

findings.what: It sits alone at the very top edge, touching the border. It is a green-outlined chip in a 14px-looking mono face, which is an off-system treatment. It is also the only thing that tells the player this is player 2's screen.
findings.fix: Move it into the top-left tag at x 96, y 96, in cyan. Render it as 16px f-cond 600 text with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 8px/16px padding. Put 'player 2' and 'keyboard' on one line.

findings.what: The save row is only 42px tall and has no raised fill. Its name and stats are small, about 15px. The 'saves' label is dim and tight against the row. The name field and the two buttons are 40px tall and look like three identical boxes, with no clear order or primary action. 'pillager new' is lime text, which the guide reserves for focus.
findings.fix: Make the save row 64px tall with a --ui-raised fill, 20px f-cond 600 text, and the name in --tx-1. Keep the 2px lime border as the only focus cue. Make the 'saves' label 16px --tx-2 with a 16px gap above the row. Make the three controls 56px tall with 16px label type, --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 8px gaps. Give the field a fixed width of about 50%.

findings.what: All content is a 558px-wide column in the middle of a 1920px screen. Over 60% of the canvas is empty vignette. The title block sits at y 360-440 with nothing above it for 330px, and 300px is empty below the saves. It reads as a template login form, not an ARC Raiders-style title screen.
findings.fix: Make the column 640px wide and move the whole block up so the wordmark sits at y 260-360. Alternatively, add one piece of art behind it, such as a character silhouette or the undercroft entrance, at 20-30% opacity on the right half.

findings.what: The key caps are 14px and the labels are dim grey at about 15px. The row sits 25px from the bottom edge. It is a tiny legend that cannot be read from a couch, and it repeats what 'f1 controls' already offers.
findings.fix: Set the labels to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2, with --tx-1 key caps and a 24px gap between pairs. Move the row up to y 1000-1040. Alternatively, keep only 'f1 controls'.

findings.what: It is 14px muted text tucked 11px under the lime button. It reads as a button caption, not a label. It is also unclear what it means.
findings.fix: Remove it, since the top-left 'player 2' tag covers it. If it has to stay, set it at 16px --tx-2 with 24px of space above and below.

findings.what: It is about 18px and mid-grey, and it is crammed between the wordmark and the button with only 25px of space. It adds clutter.
findings.fix: Set it to 16px f-cond 600 in --tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Use 16px above it and 24px below it. Or delete it.

findings.what: These are two identical outlined boxes at 48px tall, and the label text is about 15px. They are 96px from the right edge, which does not match the 5% margin used elsewhere. They carry the same weight as the save controls.
findings.fix: Use one 16px f-cond 600 text style in --tx-2 with no box until focused. Place them at the 96px margin, aligned with the top-left player tag at y 96. Or make 'settings' a 48px icon button.

v.verdict: The HUD hasn't changed since the last review: the same scattered panels in three different styles, with the 'pillager joined' toast still bottom-centre and the ammo block unchanged.

findings.what: It still sits bottom-centre above the hotbar. It uses a black fill with no border, which matches no other panel, and it uses 20px text where the others use 16px. The earlier advice was not followed.
findings.fix: Move it to the left feed at x=16 as a 16px tx-1 row on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Delete the bottom-centre toast slot.

findings.what: It is still a dense 5-row ledger. The names are tx-2 at about 14px. The 'dead' tags are the same grey as the dollar amounts, so amounts and status blur together. The header is not styled like the 'contracts' header opposite it. The screen also has no hero element.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 20px line, 'bots 0', and open the list on focus. If the rows stay, make names 16px tx-1 and replace 'dead' with an 8px --danger dot. Give the header the same 32px height and 16px 600 label as the 'contracts' pill.

findings.what: '25 / 24' is shown as one hero number, so the magazine and reserve are the same size and the slash is noise. The 25 also reads higher than the 24 reserve. The 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' footer is about 14px tx-2 on dark and is hard to read from a couch. The panel is only about 8px from the right and bottom edges.
findings.fix: Show the magazine at 56px 800 tx-1 and the reserve beside it at 20px tx-2, with no slash. Raise the footer to 16px tx-2. Inset the panel to x≤1866 and y≤1026.

findings.where: 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x16-409, y778-805)
findings.what: It is an explaining sentence, which the rules count as a defect. It is also a third panel style: a bar, an icon and two text weights. The icon is tiny.
findings.fix: Cut it to 'contract item nearby' at 16px 600 tx-1. Use the same --ui-panel row as the other feed items, with the 3px --r-gold bar and 8px padding.

findings.what: Slots 2, 4-8 and 0 are only floating numerals over faint ghost icons that cross the map. Only the two filled slots read as slots. The slot spacing is uneven (x=555, 780, then about 112px steps). The fist slot has a thick amber border, and amber is the P1 colour rather than the lime selection colour.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as 72px squares on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Show ghost icons inside the slots at 30% opacity. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Use 16px numerals.

findings.what: The label and bar for the pillager at top-left float over the map with no panel, 3px from the bar. The bottom hp bar is a saturated green flat fill with a 32px+ label that is bolder than the hero ammo, so two elements compete. The hp bar is also flush against the bottom edge (y1070 of 1080).
findings.fix: Give the hp bar 16px 600 label text, a 24px height, and a bottom inset of at least 32px (bottom edge at y≤1048). Put the 'pillager' bar in the same panel as the bots list or drop it.

findings.where: keyboard chip (x8-105, y8-32), 'f1 controls' (x448-538, y930-955) and status icons (x24-110, y942-982)
findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip uses a green-bordered pill that matches nothing else. 'f1 controls' sits on its own over a building. The two circular icons use amber and green outlines with no labels, so they are unreadable and add a fourth border style.
findings.fix: Restyle the chip as the --ui-panel row with a --ui-line-hi border. Set 'f1 controls' in 16px tx-2 on the same panel, aligned to the hotbar baseline. Give the icons the --ui-panel fill and 1px --ui-line-hi borders, at the same 40px size and 8px gap.

findings.what: The teal extract pill is about 16px, small, and the clock above it at about 28px is the only large top element. The extract pill is not at the 16px floor with enough weight to read as a hero timer. The navigation arrow beneath it is a tiny teal triangle that is easy to miss.
findings.fix: Set the clock to 32px 700. Make the extract pill 20px 600 --extract on --ui-panel with a 1px --extract border and 8px padding. Enlarge the arrow to 16px.

v.verdict: The toast and the gold-glow sentence are gone, so the screen is cleaner, but the bots panel, ammo block and hotbar are still unresolved and the hp bar shouts louder than anything else.

findings.what: It is still a 5-row table that fights the 'pillager' nameplate just below it. The header is 16px and tight, the names are dim grey and the 'dead' tags are tiny. The $ values are dimmer than the header, and the 'current pillager bots 0' title wastes a line.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 20px 'bots 0' pill with the same 32px height as 'contracts 0/8', and open the list on focus. If the rows stay, set names to 16px tx-1, replace the word 'dead' with an 8px --danger dot, and use the --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: A 406px solid green bar with a 'hp 100' label in a larger size than any other HUD text. It is the loudest element on the screen, it sits flush with the bottom edge (about 10px margin) and it lacks the panel treatment the other HUD blocks have. Its label is not in the type scale.
findings.fix: Shrink it to 280x16px on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 20px 700 tx-1 label ('100') and keep the --ok fill. Inset it to y<=1032 (48px margin) and align its left edge to x=48 with the ability icons.

findings.what: The block is still very close to the right and bottom edges (about 8px). '25 / 24' pairs a large number with a similar-weight slash and reserve, so the eye does not know which one is the magazine. 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' are cramped at the bottom edge.
findings.fix: Show the magazine at 56px 800 tx-1 and the reserve at 20px tx-2 with no slash. Set the footer to 16px tx-2 with 16px padding. Inset the panel so it ends at x<=1872 and y<=1032.

findings.what: Slots 1 and 3 are big filled tiles and slots 2 and 4-0 are bare numerals floating over the map. The selected slot 1 has an amber border, so selected and P1 colour are confused. Slot 3 shows a bright icon and a blue ammo bar, which makes the row ragged. The ghost weapon silhouettes behind the numerals add clutter.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px squares on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot only. Use 16px numerals at the top-left of each slot and remove the ghost silhouettes.

findings.what: The name sits on a busy wall with a small cyan underline bar, and it is 20px against the 16px of the bots panel. It is detached from the hp bar at the bottom and its purpose is unclear.
findings.fix: Remove it, since the world nameplate already says 'pillager', or dock it into the hp plate at the bottom left at 16px 600 tx-1.

findings.what: The clock at about 28px is close to the 20px extract chip, the sunrise icon is a pale disc with an orange glyph, and the chip's teal border is thin. The teal text is on a dark teal fill, so it reads a little murky.
findings.fix: Set the clock at 32px 700 tx-1. Set the chip at 20px 600 --extract on --ui-panel with a 1px --extract border and 8px padding. Leave a 16px gap between the two and set the icon at 24px.

findings.what: It sits in the middle of the map, out of line with the hotbar. The keycap is a different style from 'keyboard' at the top-left and from the slot numerals.
findings.fix: Anchor it mid-bottom left as ordered, at 16px 600 tx-2 on a --ui-panel plate with the same keycap style as the 'keyboard' chip. Align its baseline to y=1040 with the hotbar.

findings.what: It is the only element with a chevron and a wide empty body, and the label is 18px, off the type scale. It has no connection to the bots panel's chevron style.
findings.fix: Set the label to 20px 600 tx-1, cut the width to about 200px and match the bots panel's chevron size (16px, tx-2). Use the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius on both.

v.verdict: This is now a raid HUD, not the player 2 title, so the earlier title advice no longer applies. The HUD is readable, but its corners use different treatments: a bare green hp bar, dark panels, loose floating digits and a tiny keyboard pill.

findings.what: It is a raw bright-green slab with 'hp 100' at roughly 36px on top of it. It matches no panel treatment used by the weapon card at bottom-right or the roster at top-left. It also touches the screen edge and takes the biggest, brightest area of the HUD.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius, 48px from the left edge and 32px from the bottom. Make the bar 12px tall and keep the fill --ok. Show 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1.

findings.what: The slot numbers float on the map with no slot boxes. They are dim, and they collide with the world art and the wall tops. Slots 1 and 2 are drawn as boxes, so the row reads as broken.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots as 104x104 --ui-panel boxes at 55% fill with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Use 16px --tx-2 numbers inside the top-left corner. Alternatively, hide empty slots entirely.

findings.what: It is tiny, pushed into the corner at 10px from both edges, in green on dark green. It matches neither P2 cyan nor any other element, and it sits outside the 5% margin.
findings.fix: Move it to x 96, y 48 as 16px f-cond 600 text. Use cyan for player 2 and amber for player 1, with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 8px/16px padding. Or drop it once the raid has started.

findings.what: The panel has 14-15px text and the title 'current pillager bots 0' competes with 'you $120'. It repeats 'dead' on every row, and the '0 out · 3 dead' footer repeats it again. The rows are dense, grey and low in contrast. The panel is also stuck 8px from the edge, so it sits closer to the edge than every other element.
findings.fix: Use 16px f-cond 600 text with 32px rows, and inset the panel 48px. Colour the 'dead' rows --tx-2 and drop the word, showing a red x glyph instead. Show only the footer total, in --tx-1. Make the title 16px --tx-2 and the 'you' row 20px --tx-1.

findings.where: pillager name/hp plate (x 15-170, y 325-360) and the plate over the P1 character (x 818-865, y 538-558)
findings.what: The same plate is drawn twice. The left-edge copy lands on top of a wall, has a thin bar and unclear meaning, and sits right under the roster as a stray box. The in-world plate is 12px, so it is not readable from a couch.
findings.fix: Delete the left-edge plate, since hp is already at bottom-left. Make the in-world name plate 16px with a 4px bar. Give p2 a cyan plate to match its ring.

findings.what: '25 / 24' is odd, because current ammo is higher than the reserve. 'b / i backpack' and '2 items $120' are about 14px and low in contrast. The card runs to 8px from the right edge and is 100px taller than it needs to be.
findings.fix: Fix the data so the two numbers cannot show the larger one first. Make the small lines 16px --tx-2. Inset the card 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom. Colour 'items $120' in --tx-1 and shrink the hero number to 56px.

findings.what: A closed accordion with a chevron looks like a web form control, so it doesn't fit a console HUD. It uses a different size and border from the roster panel on the left, and the 8-12px corner margin is off the grid.
findings.fix: Give it the same panel and 16px label spec as the roster. Use a 4px radius and a 48px right margin, and show a key hint instead of a chevron. Right-align it to the card spec.

findings.what: The hint sits alone at an odd position beside the hotbar, 14px type, with a faint key cap that blends into the map. It floats between the hotbar and the left HUD with no alignment to either.
findings.fix: Dock it to the left edge at x 48 and align its baseline to the hotbar's bottom. Use a 16px --tx-2 label with a 1px --ui-line-hi key cap.

v.verdict: The scene reads well and the hero ammo number is strong, but none of the earlier hud fixes were applied: the bots panel, hp bar, hotbar and the duplicate 'pillager' plate are all unchanged, and the bottom edge still has no margin.

findings.what: Panel is unchanged. It is a dense 5-row table in 14-16px type with the word 'dead' repeated 3 times and a '0 out · 3 dead' footer. The panel fill and border differ from contracts 0/8 and the ammo block, and the label 'current pillager bots 0' is long.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 32px 'bots 0' pill matching 'contracts 0/8' and open it on focus. If the rows stay, use 16px tx-1 names, replace 'dead' with an 8px --danger dot, drop the footer line, and use --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The bar is still a full-bright 406x34px green slab with 'hp 100' in oversized text, pressed against the bottom edge (about 10px margin). It is the loudest element on the screen and competes with the ammo hero number. It is also not aligned with the ability icons at x24, and the 24px left inset breaks the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Make it 280x16px on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ok fill. Use a 20px 700 tx-1 '100' label. Position it at x=48 and y<=1032.

findings.what: The hotbar is still uneven. The selected fist slot is a 104px tile with a 2px gold-orange border, slot 3 has a different frame, and slots 2 and 4-0 are bare numerals over ghost weapon silhouettes. Slots touch the bottom edge at y1060. The selected border is amber, not --acc lime, which breaks the rule that lime means selected.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px squares on --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border only. Use 16px numerals at the top-left, remove the silhouettes, and end the bar at y<=1032.

findings.what: '25 / 24' sets the reserve at nearly the same weight as the magazine with a slash, so the reading is ambiguous and the mag/reserve split is unclear. The panel is only 8px from the right edge and 26px from the bottom. The 14px footer 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' are too small and too close to the border.
findings.fix: Show the magazine at 56px 800 tx-1 and the reserve at 20px tx-2 with no slash. Set the footer to 16px tx-2 with 16px padding. Inset the panel so it ends at x<=1872 and y<=1032.

findings.what: It sits on top of a wall, is cut by the bots panel above, and carries a small, low-contrast green bar. It duplicates the world nameplate over the player at (1080,545) and reads as a stray label.
findings.fix: Remove it, or dock it into the hp plate at bottom left at 16px 600 tx-1.

findings.where: bottom-left toasts 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' (x15-410, y778-805) and 'f1 controls' (x448-538, y930-955)
findings.what: The toast is an explaining sentence, which is a defect under the rules. Its yellow/gold left bar and text use mixed colours, and it sits at a different x from the other left-edge items. The 'f1 controls' chip floats over the world with no panel, 14-16px text and low contrast, and it is not mid-bottom left as ordered.
findings.fix: Shorten the toast to 'contract item nearby' and drop the explanation. Put both on --ui-panel with 1px --ui-line-hi borders at x=48. Set the controls chip at 16px tx-2 on a panel, anchored to the bottom-left row.

findings.where: top-centre clock and extract chip (x905-1030, y10-75)
findings.what: The 8:56 clock and the extract chip use different treatments (bare 28px text next to a teal outlined pill). The moon icon is oddly placed, and the chip's teal outline is hard to see against the purple area tint. The 'chill row cache' label at x1388-1518 is a pale purple 20px text with a glow, which is a one-off colour.
findings.fix: Put the clock in one --ui-panel plate with the extract chip below it, both on the 8px grid. Fill the chip with a --extract 2px border and 16px text. Set the zone label in tx-1 at 20px with no glow.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag (x8-105, y8-32) and contracts dropdown (x1604-1904, y18-55)
findings.what: Both are small, with 14-16px text and different border styles. The keyboard tag has a green tint border while contracts uses a grey border and caret. Margins are 8px, not 48px.
findings.fix: Use the same plate style (--ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius) for both, 16px tx-1 text, and move them 24px or more in from the edges.

v.verdict: The raid HUD reads fine at a glance, with a clear ammo hero number and a good top-centre clock and extract banner. The previous advice on the hp bar, empty hotbar slots, keyboard pill, roster and name plates was mostly not applied, and the corners and edges are still crowded and inconsistent.

findings.what: The hp bar still has no panel and sits flush against the screen edge with the fill running through the 'hp 100' text. The text is a different size from the other HUD text and sits on a flat green slab with weak contrast. The bar is not in a card like the ammo block, so the two bottom corners look unrelated.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, 48px from the left and 32px from the bottom. Make the bar 12px tall in --ok. Set 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1, outside the bar.

findings.what: The empty slots are bare floating digits with ghost weapon silhouettes drawn over the map. They have no slot frame and are hard to read against the busy terrain. They look unfinished next to the two framed slots 1 and 2, and their digits are 14px or smaller.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 104x104 --ui-panel box at 55% fill with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap. Put 16px --tx-2 numbers in the top-left corner. Delete the ghost weapon icons, or hide the empty slots entirely.

findings.what: It sits tight to the screen edge, with no inset or consistent margin. The text is about 15px with a tight 18px row pitch. Names, $ values and a 'dead' word are crowded into one dense block. The caret is tiny. The panel adds a lot of clutter in the top-left. The title 'current pillager bots 0' is bolder than it needs to be.
findings.fix: Inset it 48px from the edges. Use 16px f-cond 600 text with 32px rows. Colour dead rows --tx-2 and replace the word 'dead' with a red x glyph. Show only the footer total, in --tx-1. Make the title 16px --tx-2 and the 'you' row 20px --tx-1.

findings.where: 'keyboard' pill (x 10-105, y 7-31), contracts dropdown (x 1605-1903, y 19-55), top-left and top-right corners
findings.what: The keyboard pill is pinned to the corner with a green border that matches no player colour. The contracts box is a different style, with a different border, size and chevron. The two corners use unrelated treatments, with no shared margin and no shared card.
findings.fix: Drop the pill once the raid starts, or restyle it in amber for P1 and cyan for P2. Give it a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and 8px/16px padding. Restyle contracts as a --ui-panel card with 16px f-cond 600 text. Keep both 48px from the edges.

findings.what: The card runs to the screen edge, with only about 8px margin on the right and 26px at the bottom. The hero '25 / 24' is good, but the weapon name, 'b / i backpack' and '2 items $120' are all about 16px with similar weight, so they compete. The card is also clipped by the screen edge more than the other HUD elements.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom. Set the hero at 56px f-cond 800, the weapon name at 20px --tx-1, and the footer at 16px --tx-2. Move 'b / i backpack' to a single key-hint chip.

findings.where: P2 pillager plate (x 15-170, y 325-360) and in-world name plates (x 818-865, y 538-558)
findings.what: The left-edge 'pillager' plate duplicates the hp bar at bottom-left, so the same information is shown twice. The in-world 'pillager' plate has a tiny 3px bar and about 12px text, which is below the 16px floor. Neither plate is tinted cyan to match P2's ring.
findings.fix: Delete the left-edge plate. Make the in-world plate 16px text with a 4px bar. Tint P2's plate cyan to match its ring.

findings.what: The hint floats over the map with a small translucent chip and 16px text. It sits unaligned with the hotbar and has no clear baseline relationship to the slots. It also competes with the slot 1 gold border.
findings.fix: Align it to the hotbar's left edge, 16px above the slots at x 556. Use a --ui-panel chip with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, with the 'f1' key in --tx-1 and the label in --tx-2.

findings.what: The pink-purple label is a loose location title floating on the map, in a colour that matches nothing in the palette. It reads as a stray element and competes with the top-centre banner.
findings.fix: Draw it in --tx-1 at 20px f-cond 600 with a dark 60% shadow plate behind it. Or show it only for 2s on entry and fade it out.

v.verdict: The hotbar and ammo block are cleaner, but the bots panel, hp bar and controls card are still unresolved, and the lower-left corner is crowded with three competing panels of different sizes and styles.

findings.what: The panel is still fully open: 8 rows, a mixed 14-16px text size, grey 'dead' tags, a purple name, and a footer line. It is the largest block on screen and says nothing the player acts on. The title 'current pillager bots 0' is long and inconsistent with the 'contracts 0/8' pill. The panel also sits at x8, off the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Fold it to a 32px 'bots 0' pill at x48, matching the contracts pill. Open it on focus. If rows stay, use 16px tx-1 names, replace 'dead' with an 8px --danger dot, drop '0 out · 7 dead', and use a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The hp bar is a bare, flat green strip with a 'hp 100' label in a larger display style that overlaps the fill. It is jammed against the bottom edge (y1070 of 1080), sits at x24 and not 48, and has no plate or border. It looks like a different UI from the ammo panel.
findings.fix: Make it 280x16px on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a --ok fill, and a 20px 700 tx-1 '100' label to the left. Place it at x48 with its bottom edge at y<=1032.

findings.what: Only 3 slots are drawn as tiles. Slots 4-0 are bare grey numerals that float over the wall art with poor contrast and no tile, so the bar reads as unfinished. The tiles also run to y1060, which is under the 48px margin. The selected slot uses an amber border (--warn hue), not --acc lime, which breaks the rule that lime means selected.
findings.fix: Draw empty slots 4-0 as 72px --ui-panel squares with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps, or hide them. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border and no amber. Use 16px tx-2 numerals at the top-left of each tile and end the bar at y<=1032.

findings.what: The block is the right hero, but the '/ 60' slash and the tx-2 reserve compete with the 30. The panel runs to x1912 and y1054, almost touching the screen edge. The footer 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' sit tight at 14px against the panel edge, and 'b / i backpack' is a hint that explains rather than informs.
findings.fix: Show the magazine at 56px 800 tx-1 and the reserve at 20px tx-2 with no slash. Give the footer 16px tx-2 with 16px padding, and drop 'b / i backpack'. Inset the panel so it ends at x<=1872 and y<=1032.

findings.what: The 6-section, 2-column key list is fully open, so it is clutter. The spec says it should be mid-bottom left and folded to one short line, opened with F1. The tiny 14-16px mixed text, the 'fight' and 'raid' section labels and the dense key caps leave it hard to read from a couch. It also adds a third rounded dark box next to the bots panel.
findings.fix: Fold it to a single 32px line, 'f1 controls', at x48, bottom-left above the hp plate at y~990, and open it on F1 only. When open, set labels to 16px tx-2 and key text to 20px tx-1 on --ui-panel.

findings.where: top-right minimap and contracts pill (x1603-1902, y18-362)
findings.what: The minimap is a large dark rectangle with mostly empty black below y200 and a nearly unreadable arrow and markers. Its frame is not the same as the other panels, and the pill below uses a different edge treatment. The chevrons are tiny.
findings.fix: Crop the minimap to a square at 240x240, use a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel, and hide the unexplored black. Make the pill the same width and give it 16px label text and a 16px chevron.

findings.where: top-centre score panel and extract chip (x861-1060, y18-172)
findings.what: The score card puts '105 sp' (about 28px bold) between a small 'score' label and a '10:00' timer of nearly equal size. Nothing clearly leads, and the timer should be the hero. The teal 'extract 141m' chip is a different shape from the card and sits directly under it, so the two read as separate styles.
findings.fix: Make the timer the one 56px 800 tx-1 hero. Set 'score 105 sp' to 20px tx-2 above it. Match the chip to the card: 4px radius, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 16px label, and a 8px gap.

findings.what: This is a small amber chip with 14-16px text over the pale ground, and it floats without anchoring. It uses --warn amber, which gets confused with the selected-slot amber, and its contrast is weak against the sand ground.
findings.fix: Use 20px 700 tx-1 text on a --ui-panel plate with a 3px --r-gold bar on the left. Raise it 16px above the player, and fade it out after 1.2s.

v.verdict: The in-raid HUD still reads as separate default-styled overlays, not one system: the corner cards sit 8-20px from the edges, the hotbar and hp bar are unpanelled, and the controls list and roster eat the left side.

findings.what: The full list is open, 311x345px, on top of the playfield. About 18 key chips and labels compete with the action. It is the largest block on screen after the roster, and the 'full list' footer repeats its own contents. The style guide says it should be folded to one line, mid-bottom left, with F1 to open it.
findings.fix: Fold it to one 16px --tx-2 line (e.g. 'f1 controls') in a 32px-high chip at x 48, y 1000. Open it only on F1, as a 56px-inset card. Delete the 'full list' footer row.

findings.what: This is still the bare green bar with no panel. The 'hp 100' text sits inside it at about 30px, in a different weight from the other HUD numbers, and it hugs the screen edge (24px left, 10px bottom). It is also the only element with a saturated fill, so it reads as a debug bar.
findings.fix: Put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius, 48px from the left and 32px from the bottom. Make the bar 12px tall in --ok. Put 'hp' in 16px --tx-2 and '100' in 32px f-cond 700 --tx-1 above or beside the bar, not on it.

findings.what: Slots 1-3 are 104px cards, but 4-0 are faint grey digits floating on the wall with no slot boxes. The row looks unfinished. Slot 3's 'f' chip and the '60' counts are about 14px. The hotbar is also off-centre, since the 0-slot row runs on past x 1470.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel boxes at 55% fill with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap, centred on x 960 and 32px from the bottom. Put 16px --tx-2 numbers top-left. Put counts at 16px f-cond 600 --tx-1. Keep the lime/amber ring on the active slot only.

findings.what: Seven '- dead' rows are listed in the same 16px size as the live 'you' row, which has the $1,620 balance. The title 'current pillager bots 0' is the boldest line, and the collapse chevron is tiny. The panel sits 8px from the edge and has a different corner radius from its neighbours. This is clutter that shows no live information.
findings.fix: Collapse it by default to one line, '0 out · 7 dead', in a 16px chip at x 48, y 48. Make the dead rows --tx-2 with a red x glyph instead of the word 'dead'. If it stays open, set the 'you' row to 20px --tx-1 and the title to 16px --tx-2, and inset the panel 48px.

findings.what: The hero '30' is about 60px and nearly matches the 56px hero token, which is good, but the card sits only 10px from the right and bottom edges. The weapon name is 22px, the footer is 14px and the 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' texts are cramped at the card base. The card has a different border from the top-right panels.
findings.fix: Inset the card 48px from the right and 32px from the bottom, with 16px padding. Weapon name 20px --tx-1, hero 56px f-cond 800, footer 16px --tx-2. Turn 'b / i backpack' into one key-hint chip and drop the repeated '$1,620'.

findings.what: The minimap is 297px wide and has a large black void in the lower half. It bleeds off the top at 18px and the right at 20px. Its markers are about 10px and too small to read. The contracts bar is a different style (white text on dark with a chevron) and a different height from the roster header.
findings.fix: Inset both 48px from the top and right. Crop the minimap to the map content, or fill the void with the terrain. Use the same --ui-panel card, 4px radius and 16px f-cond 600 header for contracts as for the roster, with a 32px row height.

findings.what: The pill is lime-outlined and sits at the corner, inside the 5% margin. It has no border or radius consistent with the other cards. It repeats a state the player already knows and uses the accent for something that is not selected.
findings.fix: Remove it once the raid starts, or show it for 3s on spawn. If it stays, use a 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius and --tx-2 16px text. Use amber for P1 and cyan for P2, since lime is reserved for selected.

findings.where: score card (x 861-1059, y 18-135) and 'extract 141m' chip (x 905-1015, y 146-172)
findings.what: The score card is a well-made centre anchor. The hero '105 sp' is about 30px, not 56px, and the timer at 20px sits at the same weight just below it. The extract chip is teal, correct for extraction, but its 16px text is tight, with 4px padding, and it overlaps the building roof art. The floating '+105 sp hot' amber toast at (1010-1090, 798-820) is tiny and low-contrast against the sand ground.
findings.fix: Set '105 sp' to 56px f-cond 800 --tx-1, and set the timer to 16px --tx-2. Give the extract chip 8px/16px padding and a --ui-panel fill at 90%. Set the toast in 20px with a --ui-void 70% backing.

v.verdict: The bots panel is gone, the controls card is folded to one line, and the modal has a clear lime primary action, but the hotbar and ammo block still clip the bottom edge and the bars are still blunt.

findings.what: The empty slots 1,3,5-0 are floating grey numerals scattered over the road with no tile. The selected slot has an amber border (it should be lime, since lime means selected). The row also sits at y1055, too close to the bottom edge, and the slot names are different sizes.
findings.fix: Draw every slot as a 72px --ui-panel square with a 1px --ui-line border and 8px gaps. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border instead of amber. Put 16px tx-2 numerals inside the top-left corner. End the bar at y<=1032.

findings.where: hp and armour bars, x24-430 y965-1070
findings.what: The bars are flat, unframed fills sitting 24px from the left edge and about 10px from the bottom edge, so they sit off the 48px margin. The 'hp 100' label is a thick, oversized condensed face that fights the bar. The armour bar's blue-on-blue label has low contrast.
findings.fix: Make each bar 280x16px at x48 on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 20px 700 tx-1 numeral to the left. Keep the bottom edge at y<=1032 and leave 8px between the two bars.

findings.what: The '24 / 144' pair has the same weight and size on both sides, so the reserve competes with the magazine. The panel sits 10px from the right edge, out of line with the margin. The gun name is a bit small for a block this size.
findings.fix: Show the magazine at 56px 800 tx-1 and the reserve at 20px tx-2. Inset the panel so it ends at x<=1872 and y<=1032. Show the gun name at 20px 600 tx-1 and left-align it with the magazine number.

findings.what: The title is not aligned with the buttons and there is a large dead gap between the title and the buttons. The countdown '12' floats in the top right with no meaning. The lime progress sliver at the top-left (x493-562) is barely visible. The 'no' button's 1px border is too dim for a couch, and its focus state is not clear. The yes fill is a big lime slab with a heavy block of dark text.
findings.fix: Tighten the vertical spacing to 24px between the title and the button row. Make the title 32px 700. Render the countdown as a 16px tx-2 label such as '12s', or turn it into a full-width 4px --acc timer bar along the card's top edge. Give 'no' a 2px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-raised fill. Make both buttons 64px tall.

findings.what: The 105 sp number and the 10:00 clock are about the same size, so the eye is not told which one is the hero. The 'you 105 / p2 0' split is crowded to the right. The weather icon floats outside the card edge at x1157 with no frame.
findings.fix: Show the timer at 20px tx-2, keep the score as the single 56px hero, and put the player split on one 16px tx-2 line under it. Move the weather icon into the card or into the top-right stack with a matching 32px tile.

findings.what: The pill is 16px tx-1 on a faint dark chip. It floats in the middle of the road with a 4px gap to the hotbar and does not align with the hp bar or the other left-edge items. Its contrast over the busy ground is weak.
findings.fix: Place it at x48 above the armour bar, around y~930, 32px tall, on a --ui-panel fill with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Use a 16px 600 label with the key in a small bordered chip.

findings.where: top-right minimap and goals, x1603-1900 y18-368
findings.what: The minimap is a plain black rectangle with sparse markers and a chevron stuck in its corner. The 'goals 0/3' row is joined to it but uses a different border and radius. The minimap's right edge is only 20px from the screen edge.
findings.fix: Give the minimap and the goals row the same --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Put the goals row 8px below the minimap and align both at x<=1872 using the 48px margin.

findings.where: pickup toast '+105 sp hot' and 'shield' tag, x1000-1100 y793-820 and x938-982 y910-925
findings.what: The toast is a small amber label on a dark chip, with hot amber used as text where warn amber is the only allowed use. The 'shield' tag below the player is clipped by the sprite and overlaps the ground, so it is hard to read.
findings.fix: Make the toast 20px 600 with a --ui-panel plate and an 8px padding, and use tx-1 text with a small --warn 'hot' tag. Move the 'shield' tag 8px below the sprite with a --ui-panel plate and 16px tx-1.

v.verdict: The controls list is now a single chip and the roster is gone, so the HUD is much calmer, but a flat easy-mode modal with no scrim sits on a busy map and the bottom HUD is still unframed and misaligned.

findings.what: There is no scrim, so the busy map shows around the card. The card is a flat black rectangle with no 1px border, and a tiny lime tab sits on its top-left edge. The 32px title is small and left-heavy. The '12' countdown at top-right is an unlabelled 20px grey number. About 60px of dead space sits between the title and the buttons. The 'want easy mode?' prompt is a question with no context, which feels off-style.
findings.fix: Add a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer behind the card. Give the card a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Delete the lime tab. Make the title 32px f-cond 700. Make the countdown a 16px --tx-2 'auto no in 12' label. Tighten the title-to-buttons gap to 24px.

findings.what: The filled lime yes button is 100px tall and about 406px wide, and its text is only 20px. The black ink on lime reads fine, but the button is heavy next to the slim title. The 'no' button is a thin outline with --tx-1 text, so focus is clear but the pair feels crude. There is no radius and the 'y' and 'n' key hints sit inline in the label text, not in a chip.
findings.fix: Make both buttons 64px tall with 4px radius, and set the label at 24px f-cond 700. Put 'y' and 'n' in 16px key chips, left-aligned inside each button. Give 'no' a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a --ui-raised fill. Keep the lime fill on 'yes' only.

findings.what: The bars are still flat, unframed strips glued to the screen edge at 24px, not the 48px margin. The labels sit on the fills ('hp 100' at about 32px on green, 'armour 60' on blue), and the two bars are stacked with a 12px gap. The armour bar's blue is not in the token palette.
findings.fix: Inset the bars to x 48 and 32px from the bottom. Put them in one --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Make the bars 12px tall, with 'hp' and 'armour' in 16px --tx-2 and the values in 20px --tx-1 above the bars. Use --ok for hp. Recolour armour to --r-rare.

findings.what: Slots 2 and 5 are drawn at different heights and styles. The active slot has an amber ring and rounded corners, the other has none. The empty slot numbers (1, 3, 4, 6-0) float as loose 16px grey text over the road texture, and the empty ghost weapon icons are barely visible. The bar is off-centre against the 960 axis, and its numbers are low in contrast. The 'f' badge on slot 5 is a stray glyph.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel boxes at 55% fill with a 1px --ui-line border and an 8px gap, centred on x 960 and 32px from the bottom. Put the numbers inside each box at top-left in 16px --tx-2. Keep the lime or amber ring on the active slot only. Turn the 'f' into a 16px key chip.

findings.what: The card has a clear hero number, but it is jammed 10px from the right edge and sits 63px above the bottom, which does not line up with the hp bar baseline at y 1070. The weapon name is right-aligned at about 28px, so it competes with the hero. The '/ 180' is nearly as large as the 30.
findings.fix: Inset 48px from the right and set the bottom edge at y 1048, matching the hotbar. Make the weapon name 20px --tx-2. Keep the '30' at 56px f-cond 800 and set '/ 180' at 24px --tx-2. Add 16px padding and a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: Three type sizes of score (105 sp at about 40px, you 105 sp, p1 0 sp) sit crowded in a 330px box. The score and the clock read as one stack, and the right-hand column is shoved against the panel edge. The weather icon floats outside the panel at x 1157. 'p1 0 sp' uses a different grey from 'you'. The 'extract 141m' chip hangs 10px below it and looks like a separate widget.
findings.fix: Use one 56px hero for '105 sp' in f-cond 800 and move the clock to 20px --tx-2 beside it. Make 'you' and 'p1' 16px --tx-2 rows with P2 cyan and P1 amber dots. Move the weather icon inside the panel at the right. Attach the extract chip to the panel with an 8px gap and the same border.

findings.what: The chip is now one line, which is good, but it floats at x 410, unrelated to any margin, and sits on the road art with no panel. It collides visually with the hotbar numbers at the same y band. The 'f1' key chip and 'controls' label are 16px and the contrast is mid.
findings.fix: Move the chip to x 48, y 1000 above the hp card, or align it with the bottom of the hp card. Fill it with --ui-panel at 80% and a 1px --ui-line border. Make the label 16px --tx-1.

findings.where: top-left 'keyboard' tag and minimap (x 10-105, y 8-32; x 1603-1902, y 18-318)
findings.what: The device tag is a tiny chip tucked in the corner at 8px from the edge. The minimap is a plain black rectangle with a rounded-off corner and no border, and its top-right player markers are tiny and overlap the 'n' label. The collapse caret is a dim 16px glyph. Its right edge sits at 1902 while the margin is 48px.
findings.fix: Move the tag to x 48, y 32 in 16px --tx-2. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border with 4px radius and inset it to the 48px margin (right edge x 1872). Remove the overlapping 'n' label, or place it outside the map.

v.verdict: The score card, hotbar and ammo block are readable, but the hud is still crowded with five competing panels, the edge margins are inconsistent, and the earlier hotbar, hp bar and ammo-panel fixes were not applied.

findings.what: The earlier advice was not followed. The slots are uneven (72px fist, 100px gun tiles), the selected slot still has an amber border, and the bar runs to y1058. The faded slots 4-0 are just numerals floating on the wall texture, and the '60' counts are tiny.
findings.fix: Draw all slots as 72px --ui-panel squares with 8px gaps and a 1px --ui-line border. Give the selected slot a 2px --acc border. Use 16px tx-2 numerals in the top-left corner. End the bar at y<=1032. Draw empty slots 4-0 as dim 72px squares or drop them.

findings.what: The bar is a bare green strip with an oversized, tightly kerned 'hp 100' that overlaps its left end. It has no plate or border, it is 406px wide, and it sits 10px from the screen bottom and 24px from the left edge, which breaks the 5% margin. It does not match the panel language used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Make it a 280x16px bar at x48, bottom edge y<=1032, on a --ui-panel plate with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Put the '100' as a 20px 700 tx-1 numeral to the left of the bar, and use 16px tx-2 for 'hp'.

findings.what: Two large panels of left-edge text compete with the score card. The bots roster is a seven-line '- dead' list that is dim and carries no gameplay value. The controls panel is a 4-column wall of keys that stays open and covers the play area. Together they leave the left half of the screen cluttered, and the panel edges do not align (x8 vs x16).
findings.fix: Collapse the roster to a single 16px line such as '0 out · 7 dead' and drop the per-player rows. Fold the controls to one short line mid-bottom-left as the style guide orders, opened with F1. Align every left panel to x48.

findings.what: The panel runs to x1910 and y1050, which is 10px from the screen edge. The '30 / 60' hero is good, but the gun name at 20px is right-aligned and the footer text 'b / i backpack' and '3 items $1,620' is 14px and too small. The panel is the same shape as the others but has a different internal padding.
findings.fix: Inset the panel to end at x<=1872 and y<=1032. Left-align the gun name with the magazine number at 20px 600 tx-1. Raise the footer to 16px tx-2 and drop 'b / i backpack', since the hotbar and controls already cover it.

findings.what: The minimap and the contracts panel are stacked with two different internal paddings and 16px headers. The contracts panel has 16-20px lines with the run-goal text tight against the border, and its heading row 'contracts 0/8 goals 0/3' is mixed weight with the carets floating at the far right. The panel is dense (about 10 lines) and weighs more than the score card.
findings.fix: Show only the active contract and goal in 20px tx-1 and move the rest into the pause view. Use 16px tx-2 section labels, 8px row gaps and 16px inner padding. Add 8px between the minimap and the contracts panel and align both to x1872.

findings.what: The card has three stacked items of similar size ('score', '105 sp', '10:00'). The timer at 20px+ white competes with the 105 sp number, and the weather icon sits loose outside the card at x1085. The 'extract 141m' teal pill below it has a different border and radius from the card.
findings.fix: Show the timer at 20px tx-2 and the score as the single 56px hero. Move the weather icon into the card or the top-right stack as a 32px tile. Give the extract pill the card's 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The 'contract item nearby · gold glow marks the box' toast is an explaining sentence with a 14px amber bar. It sits just right of the controls panel and just above the hotbar row, and it uses amber text instead of tx-1. The '+105 sp hot' floating tag has a different box style from every other panel.
findings.fix: Shorten the toast to 'contract item nearby' in 20px tx-1 with a 3px --warn bar, and centre it in the top-centre banner or the left feed, never both. Match '+105 sp hot' to the 4px-radius --ui-panel style.

findings.where: crosshair and wall hotbar numerals, x935-985 y515-565
findings.what: The thin grey crosshair ring is low contrast against the dark building and disappears in the middle of the screen. The 4-0 slot numerals sit on the wall texture at roughly 3:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Draw the reticle in tx-1 with a 2px dark outline and a 4px centre dot. Put numerals 4-0 on a --ui-panel plate or remove them.

v.verdict: The modal is gone and the HUD is now a real set of cards (score, ammo, hotbar, minimap), but the left side is crowded with two big text panels, the hotbar numbers 4-0 float loose on the wall, and the bottom edge of the screen has no shared margin.

findings.what: The full controls list is open in the raid and fills about 310x350px of the left side, while the roster panel sits right above it. This is the clutter the owner asked to remove. The order says it should be folded to one short line, with F1 opening it.
findings.fix: Collapse it to a single 16px line at the bottom left, 'f1 controls', inset 48px from the left edge and 32px from the bottom. F1 opens the full list. Never show the full list open on arrival.

findings.what: Only slots 1-3 are drawn as boxes. The numbers 4 to 0 float on the wall at x 900-1460 with no boxes, so the bar looks broken and off-centre. The active ring is amber, which the guide reserves for P2/P1 colour and lime for selected. The key chip 'f' sits on top of the gun art in slot 3.
findings.fix: Draw only the filled slots, centred on x 960, or draw all 10 as 72px boxes with an 8px gap. Delete the floating digits. Move the 'f' chip to the top-right corner of the slot, 16px. Use a 2px --acc ring on the active slot.

findings.what: The hp bar has no card, no border, and sits 24px from the left, with a bare 'hp 100' at roughly 32px in a heavier weight than anything around it. It competes with the ammo '30' and sits on a different left and bottom margin than the other cards. Armour is missing, and the bar is the only thing at this edge with no panel.
findings.fix: Inset to x 48 and bottom 32px, and put it in a --ui-panel card with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Make the bar 12px tall, set 'hp' at 16px --tx-2 and the '100' at 20px --tx-1 above it. Use --ok for the fill.

findings.what: The 'current pillager bots' panel is a long list of seven dead names, which is 7 lines of low-value information, and the 'you' row shows '$1,620' next to it. The 8 rows are 16px grey on dark and the names are hard to read. Names are in several colours (purple for one), and the panel is flush at x 10, off the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Fold it to the header line plus '0 out · 7 dead' by default, with the chevron to expand. Move it to x 48. Set the names in --tx-2 at 16px and remove the purple colour. Keep '$1,620' on the 'you' row only.

findings.what: The card sits at x 1646-1910, so its right edge is 10px from the screen edge and its bottom is 28px, with a tight inner padding. It repeats '$1,620' from the roster. The '/ 60' is nearly as heavy as the '30', and the card has no visible border.
findings.fix: Inset 48px from the right and align the bottom to y 1048, matching the hotbar. Set '/ 60' at 24px --tx-2 f-cond 600, and drop the '3 items $1,620' line, or make it 16px --tx-2. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.what: The minimap is a dark box whose lower half is empty black with white bars, and it sits 19px from the right edge. The contracts bar beneath it has a lone chevron. The chevron on the minimap points up and sits over the content.
findings.fix: Inset to 48px from the top and right. Fit the map content to the box, or crop the box to 16:9. Use a 1px --ui-line-hi border on both cards, and share the same 4px radius.

findings.where: score card (x 861-1059, y 18-135) and extract chip (x 905-1015, y 146-172)
findings.what: The score card puts '105 sp' at about 28px, which is below the 56px hero size, and the timer 10:00 is the same size as the score, so there is no hierarchy. The extract chip below it is a teal pill that looks detached from the card and is only partly readable at 16px.
findings.fix: Make '105 sp' 56px f-cond 800 and the timer 24px --tx-2. Dock the extract chip to the card's bottom edge as one unit, 8px gap, in --extract at 16px.

findings.what: A small amber pill floats mid-screen as a world label. It reuses the same amber as the hotbar ring and the font is 16px or smaller, so it reads as a second 'selected' state.
findings.fix: Use 20px --tx-1 text with a --ui-panel pill at 80% fill, and use --warn only for a 'hot' glyph. Keep the amber for the active slot only.

v.verdict: The HUD is much calmer than before: the roster and controls clutter is gone, the contracts stack is collapsed to a goals chip, and the corners are anchored. The bottom strip is still loose, though. Bars and slots don't share a baseline, and the hotbar is cramped and low-contrast.

findings.what: Only two slots are real panels, and they sit at different sizes and heights from the faint 1-0 numerals floating on the road. Empty slots have no frames, so the row reads as two orphan cards. The bar also runs to y1058, past the safe margin. The numerals are dim grey, roughly 2:1 contrast. The selected slot's amber border breaks the rule that lime means selected.
findings.fix: Draw all 10 slots as 72px --ui-panel squares with 8px gaps and a 1px --ui-line border, ending at y<=1032. Use a 2px --acc border on the selected slot. Put 16px tx-2 numerals inside the top-left corner. Draw empty slots at 40% opacity.

findings.where: hp and armour bars, x24-430 y965-1070
findings.what: The bars are stacked flat with no plate, so they float on the busy ground. Armour is a saturated blue stripe and hp a saturated green slab, with no border and different heights. They start at x24, which breaks the 48px margin. hp reaches y1070, close to the bottom edge. The 'hp 100' text is large and tight against the bar edge, and it is the loudest thing in the corner.
findings.fix: Put both on one --ui-panel plate at x48 with 16px padding, a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 4px radius. Make each bar 16px tall with an 8px gap. Use a 20px 700 tx-1 numeral to the left of the bar and a 16px tx-2 label. End the plate at y<=1032.

findings.what: The panel is flush against the right edge (x1910, 10px margin) while the minimap sits at x1603-1902, so the right column has no common edge. The gun name is right-aligned at about 20px and the 60 / 360 is 56px, so hero and body are fine. But the '/ 360' reads as heavy as the 60, and the panel is bigger than it needs to be.
findings.fix: Set the panel right edge to x1872 and the bottom to y<=1032, matching the minimap edge. Make '/ 360' 20px 600 tx-2 so only the 60 is hero. Use 16px padding.

findings.what: A 330x137 panel holds a 56px-class total plus 'you' and 'p2' lines and the timer, all in the centre. It is the largest thing on the HUD and competes with the ammo hero number. The timer has the same weight as the score. Three sizes of white text sit with no accent. The player colours (amber for P1, cyan for P2) are not used on the 'you' and 'p2' lines.
findings.fix: Cut the panel to 240x96. Make the score 32px 700 tx-1 with a 16px tx-2 'team score' label above it, and the timer 20px 600 tx-2. Move 'you' and 'p2' into 16px rows coloured amber and cyan. Anchor the panel at y24.

findings.where: minimap and goals chip, x1603-1902 y18-370
findings.what: The minimap has a thick dark frame and shows a mostly black, empty lower half, so it wastes space. The map chevron and the tiny 'n' and icons at the top are cramped and about 8px, unreadable. The goals chip is attached with no gap, and its border and radius don't match the minimap's.
findings.fix: Crop or shrink the minimap to 280x240. Raise the icons to 16px minimum or drop them. Leave an 8px gap before the goals chip. Use the same 4px radius and 1px --ui-line-hi border on both, and align them at x1872.

findings.where: extract chip and arrow, x890-1030 y165-235
findings.what: The teal chip is tucked directly under the score panel with only about 10px of gap and looks glued on. The arrow below it floats unlabelled.
findings.fix: Leave 8px from the score panel and centre the chip on the panel's axis. Use 16px 600 teal text. Keep the arrow, but move it onto the player's heading ring.

findings.what: The chip sits at x410, which aligns with nothing, and it overlaps the road-wall texture at the same height as the hp bar tops. The 'f1' keycap is small, about 14px.
findings.fix: Align it at x48, directly above the hp plate with an 8px gap. Use a 16px label and a 1px --ui-line border.

findings.where: '+105 sp hot' pickup tag and 'shield' label, x1000-1100 y795-930
findings.what: The amber tag sits on a translucent dark box over the tan road, so contrast is mediocre. It uses a warn amber as a fill-like highlight and is small, at about 18px. The 'shield' label under the player is tiny and clipped at the bottom edge by its own plate.
findings.fix: Use a --ui-panel plate at 90% opacity with 8px padding and a 16px 700 --warn text. Raise the 'shield' label 4px so it clears its plate.

v.verdict: The controls list is now folded and the roster panel is gone, but the bottom edge is still cluttered with floating hotbar digits, unframed bars and a 'keyboard' chip, so the HUD reads as scattered.

findings.what: Empty slots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 0 are bare floating digits over the wall texture, and only slots 3 and 6 are boxes. The row has no clear edges and its pitch is uneven. The active slot (3) has an amber ring, but lime is meant to mean selected.
findings.fix: Draw only the filled slots as 72px boxes with an 8px gap, centred on x 960, and delete the floating digits. Make the active ring 2px --acc. Move the 'f' chip to the top-right of the slot at 16px.

findings.what: The two bars are unframed and sit 24px from the left edge. The labels 'armour 60' and 'hp 100' are large bold text that fights the bars, and the green and blue are fully saturated. The bars sit directly on the busy wall texture and are not in a panel.
findings.fix: Put both in one --ui-panel card (1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius) inset 48px left and 32px bottom. Make the bars 12px tall. Set the labels at 16px --tx-2 and the numbers at 20px --tx-1. Make hp --ok and armour a quiet blue.

findings.what: The panel is the largest block on screen and competes with play. It shows 'you 105 sp' and 'p1 0 sp' beside a 105 sp hero total, so the same number appears twice. The 10:00 timer sits in the same stack as the score. The panel's left and right padding is uneven. The row 'you 105 sp' / 'p1 0 sp' is tiny (about 16px) and clipped close to the panel edge.
findings.fix: Cut the panel to the hero '105 sp' at 56px and the 10:00 timer at 20px, and show the per-player split only on a hold. Pad 16px evenly and use a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

findings.where: 'keyboard' chip (x 8-105, y 8-32) and 'f1 controls' chip (x 410-537, y 922-950)
findings.what: The 'keyboard' chip is a pixel-like bold green label jammed into the top-left corner with a 2px margin. It reads as debug text and is off the 48px margin. 'f1 controls' floats at x 410 over the wall with no tie to any other element. It is not at the left margin, and the key chip's rounded tag is a different style from the other panels.
findings.fix: Fold 'keyboard' into the f1 line, or hide it after 3 seconds. Set 'f1 controls' at 16px --tx-2, x 48, 16px above the hp card. Use the same 4px radius and border on every chip.

findings.what: The card is 10px from the right edge, not the 48px margin, and its bottom (y 1017) does not line up with the hotbar or the hp bar (y 1068). The '/ 150' is nearly as bold as '25', so the hero number does not stand out. The card has no clear border.
findings.fix: Inset to x 1872 and bottom y 1048. Set '25' at 56px 800 and '/ 150' at 24px 600 --tx-2. Add a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show 'auto rifle' at 16px --tx-2.

findings.what: The small amber chip has 6px padding and sits in the middle of the field. Amber text on a dark chip over the sand tile is low in weight. It is not in the right-hand pickup stack the guide specifies.
findings.fix: Move it to the right pickup stack above the ammo card, at 16px --warn on --ui-panel with 8px padding.

findings.what: The map is a black square with no frame. The tiny player icons in the top-right corner overlap the collapse chevron, so it looks unfinished. It sits 18px from the edge, not the 48px margin.
findings.fix: Inset to 48px and add a 1px --ui-line-hi border with a 4px radius. Move the icons 16px from the corner and the chevron to the bottom-right.

findings.where: 'extract 141m' tag and 'shield' label (x 890-1030, y 166-198; x 937-983, y 910-925)
findings.what: Teal tags stack tightly under the score panel with about 10px of gap. The 'shield' label under the player is tiny (about 14px) and clipped against the bubble.
findings.fix: Leave a 16px gap under the score panel. Set 'shield' at 16px with 8px of clearance below the bubble.
